title: Teachers at Mt. Holly KinderCare
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Teacher we will:

  • Invest in you and your career at KinderCare as you create a world-class experience in our classrooms
  • Reward your commitment to our children and families as your journey continues with us

When you join our team as a Teacher you will:

  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Physically able to lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $16.50 - $16.50 Hourly

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.


.

KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

title: Tranportation Aide
description:
Job Address:

2 Hospital Plaza
Grafton, WV 26354



Taylor Healthcare Center, a member of the CommuniCare Family of Companies is currently recruiting for a Full Time Transportation Assistant to join our team.

PURPOSE/BELIEF STATEMENT:

The position of Transportation Assistant exists to assist residents with transportation to and from inside facility and outside physician appointments and events in a safe manner and in accordance with established procedures. This position must work effectively with team members in ensuring that work is accomplished and quality care is delivered, supporting their team members and celebrating team successes. While focusing on delivering quality resident care, the position must also manage the resources that are available to them in their job.

JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Enjoy working with seniors.
  • Both transporting residents and shuttling employees.
  • Transport and assist residents, per facility vehicle, to outside physician visits in a safe manner.
  • Transport Employees
  • Assist with transporting residents within the facility to scheduled specialty appointments, i.e. podiatry, audiology, optometry, dental, etc.
  • Assist with transporting residents to and from scheduled in-house activities.
  • Provide one on one monitoring for residents deemed an elopement risk on outside visits.
  • Perform basic nursing care procedures for residents as required.
  • Create a clean, comfortable, and safe environment for residents and assure that their needs are met.
  • Maintain resident documentation records.
  • Maintain and work within established departmental, center, and corporate policies and procedures, objectives, quality improvement program, and safety, environmental, and infection control standards.
  • Attend and participate in scheduled training, educational classes, and orientation programs to maintain certification and enhance quality of care.
  • Perform other related activities as assigned or requested.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • High school graduate or G. E. D. equivalent
  • Must possess a current, valid Driver’s License in State of employment.
  • 5-7 Years experience.
  • Graduate of an approved Nurse Aide Training Program or be eligible to enter such a program and graduate and pass a state test within 120 days from date of employment.
  • Must possess Red Cross First Aid Certificate.
  • Prior work/life experiences involving independent decision making
  • Prior work/life experiences, preferably in healthcare or a service industry
  • Compassionate and enthusiastic personality

Benefits

As a CommuniCare employee you will enjoy competitive wages and PTO plans. We offer full time employees a menu of benefit options from life and disability plans to medical, dental, and vision coverage from quality benefit carriers. We also offer 401(k) with employer match and Flexible Spending Accounts.

About Us

A family-owned company, we have grown to become one of the nation’s largest providers of post-acute care, which includes skilled nursing rehabilitation centers, long-term care centers, assisted living communities, independent rehabilitation centers, and long-term acute care hospitals (LTACH). Since 1984, we have provided superior, comprehensive management services for the development and management of adult living communities. We have a single job description at CommuniCare, "to reach out with our hearts and touch the hearts of others." Through this effort we create "Caring Communities" where staff, residents, clients, and family members care for and about one another.

title: Application Support Engineer - Graduate-level
description:
Hi, we’re Penfold - we’re on a mission to help everyone save enough to be comfortable in later life! 🚀

There’s over a trillion pounds sitting in UK pensions – but most of it is with legacy providers offering outdated products and poor service. We’re here to change that.

Penfold is building the pension of the future – a modern, tech-first platform that makes saving for later life easy, engaging and accessible for everyone.

We’re a growing team of 70+ builders across London and Tallinn, backed by some of the world’s leading FinTech investors. Having raised £25M+, we manage £1bn+ in pensions for over 100,000 savers and thousands of businesses — and we’re on track for profitability next year.

As one of our first 100 hires, you’ll play a key role in shaping our culture and have loads of opportunity to grow, progress and make your mark.

About the role -

We’re looking for an engineer starting out in their career, who wants to grow their technical skillset whilst also adding value to the business.

The role will be a split of ~50% first line support, ~50% build work. You will be investigating and helping to resolve customer issues, whilst working on automating our processes to reduce support volume. We have reduced support volume by 5% last year despite our user base growing over 25%.

The plan for this role is to work in a 50/50 cadence of support/build work for ~a year and then to move into a Product team as a Product Engineer, or to reduce the support workload to a small amount and spend more time on product work. Our last two Application Support Engineers are now in our Product teams as an Associate and a SWE I engineer!

You will be joining another Application Support Engineer who works with the same 50/50 cadence and be managed by our Team Lead who looks after our Scaling function that’s responsible for building internal tools that enable us to scale the business

Your responsibilities

  • Supporting our Customer Support, Operations and Growth teams to ensure critical tasks are completed within our SLAs
  • Reviewing and improving our production support process
  • Identifying key tasks to automate and automating as many Business-As-Usual tasks as possible so you can focus on high-value problems
  • Using our monitoring tools to identify performance issues and working with our Platform Engineer to resolve them
  • Collaborate with the product team to provide feedback on user experience and identify areas for improvement
  • Provide training and support to the wider team on technical issues
  • Create technical documentation for our internal knowledge base

Skills and Experience:

We do not require previous work experience; however, we do need a baseline level of software development knowledge in order for you to be as effective in your role as possible. This includes:

  • Knowledge of Javascript/Typescript
  • Knowledge of SQL databases (PostgresQL is a plus)
  • Good communication skills
  • A data-driven mindset - you are able to interrogate metrics and analytics to inform decisions

What We’re Looking For

  • A motivated engineer who wants to grow their technical skillset in the early stages of their career
  • An engineer who can communicate with non-technical stakeholders and helps them to understand issues
  • A data-driven person who can spot opportunities through analysis to improve processes and help to implement them
  • Someone who wants to grow into a Product Engineer role

Be prepared to work hard! Ultimately, we’re looking for smart, hardworking & motivated people who get stuff done & are committed to contributing to a great team. So, if you’re excited about what we’re doing, get in touch – definitely don’t be put off if you don’t tick every box!

Our application process:

  • Initial chat with our HR team
  • Hiring manager chat (Head of Engineering)
  • Technical interview (TS & SQL based, AI allowed)
  • Team interviews - two interviews, one with two members of our Engineering team and one with two of your key stakeholders in Customer Support/Operations(this is as much for you to get a better sense of us!)

Benefits:

We’re working hard to create a working environment where people feel empowered to do their very best work, make a big impact, and enjoy what they do. Specifically, our benefits package includes:

  • A competitive salary; we proactively review salaries to make sure you get what you deserve
  • Meaningful share options, you’ll own a part of Penfold and share in our success
  • 10% pension contribution each month that you don’t need to match (on top of your salary)
  • Medical insurance, through Vitality
  • Unlimited holiday, we’re interested in your output, not how many holidays you go on!
  • Hybrid working, we like people to come in to our office (so it would be great if you lived in the London area) at least a couple of days a week to collaborate, but we trust you to get your work done in whatever environment suits you
  • Great community office space, plenty of people come into our wonderful private office near Borough Underground station.
  • Free tea, coffee, soft drinks and snacks
  • Free company lunch every week (e.g., Borough Market, Mercato Metropolitano)
  • Laptop and any WFH equipment you need
  • Option to buy a bike tax free, and spread the cost (using the cycle to work scheme)
  • Learning and Professional Development – we conduct regular 360 feedback and focus on role progression that suits each person. We support everyone with courses, events and coaching to help everyone reach their goals
  • Quarterly company socials, and regular meet-ups throughout the year too!
  • Plus a host of other benefits – see here: https://getpenfold.com/careers

—
We are 100% committed to building a diverse and representative team. Whatever your race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability - we want to hear from you. If you have questions about the role or the company or the interview process, please let your recruiter know and we’re happy to answer these anonymously if that makes you feel more comfortable.

We’re all about giving every candidate the best chance to shine. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the job description, application, or selection process, just let us know — we’d be happy to help. When it comes to hiring, we focus only on your skills, experience, and how you live our values.

As part of our hiring process, we may record your interview and use AI tools to generate notes. This helps us capture details accurately and ensures a fair review by our hiring panel. By attending an interview with Penfold, you consent to the use of recording and AI-generated notes for this purpose. If you have any concerns or would prefer not to be recorded, please let us know in advance.

As we’re a regulated business, any offer (and ongoing employment) depends on passing the usual pre-employment and regulatory checks, which are started before your first day.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Algoteque is gearing up for complex software development projects combining modern electronics, embedded technologies, and next-generation mobility solutions. We are expanding our engineering network and looking to connect with Embedded Software Engineers who are passionate about developing reliable, high-performance software for connected, intelligent, and automated devices.

Responsibilities

  • Developing, integrating, and optimizing embedded software for automotive, mobility, and high-tech products.

  • Designing and implementing software components for microcontroller-based and embedded systems.

  • Writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in C and/or C++.

  • Working on hardware-software integration, debugging, testing, and performance optimization.

  • Collaborating closely with hardware, systems, and electronics engineers to ensure seamless system integration.

  • Implementing and troubleshooting communication interfaces and embedded communication protocols.

  • Analyzing technical requirements and translating them into robust software solutions.

  • Supporting software verification, validation, and debugging on target hardware.

  • Contributing to software architecture and technical design decisions.

  • Working with development and debugging tools, version control systems, and CI/CD environments where applicable.

  • Participating in cross-functional engineering teams and supporting the development of innovative connected and automated products.

Requirements:

  • Strong programming experience in C and/or C++ for embedded systems.

  • Hands-on experience with microcontrollers, RTOS, or Embedded Linux.

title: Power Platform Administrator / Run Support Engineer
description:
Summary: The Power Platform Administrator / Run Support Engineer plays a crucial role in the management and supervision of the Power Platform infrastructure and applications. Responsible for ensuring operational stability and addressing platform issues, this position serves as the frontline support for a scalable migration volume within the organization.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Manage day-to-day operations in the Power Platform Admin Center.

  • Configure, maintain and monitor DLP policies, connector libraries, and environment capacity.

  • Set up and maintain monitoring dashboards using CoE Starter Kit and Azure Monitor.

  • Handle licensing and platform capacity signals; manage environment and application-related issues.

  • Maintain application inventory and support model documentation.

  • Support transition-to-run activities and manage operational controls.

  • Escalate platform issues to Architects or the Platform Owner when necessary.

Key Requirements:

  • Hands-on experience administering Power Platform Admin Center.

  • Knowledge of DLP and connector governance.

  • Experience using CoE Starter Kit for monitoring dashboards.

  • Understanding of Power Platform licensing and operational constraints.

  • Familiarity with incident handling and run backlog management.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Entra ID and access management.

  • Background in operational reporting and telemetry.

  • Proven capability in improving operational incidents into actionable backlog items.

As a leader in Engineering and IT Services, we support a company in their technological and sustainable transformation.

OVER 57,400 EMPLOYEES IN 30+ COUNTRIES, TO SUPPORT MORE THAN 6,500 CLIENTS WORLDWIDE.

We operate in all sectors: Aeronautics, Space, Defence, Security & Naval, Automotive, Rail & Mobility, Energy & Environment, Life Sciences & Health, Industrial Equipment & Electronics, Telecoms, Banking, Finance & Insurance, Retail, Services & Medias, Public Services & Government.

We carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies worldwide.

Our motto: Building Tomorrow’s World Today!

This role focuses on building, scaling, and maintaining the IKP infrastructure to ensure reliability, performance, and scalability for internal customers worldwide.

Role description

  • Own the vulnerability position and maintain a consolidated view of all open findings across CDN, WAF, hosting, CMS, and application layers.

  • Triage incoming findings by validating, deduplicating, and assessing their exploitability, then assign priorities and remediation deadlines.

  • Challenge false positives and overstated severity ratings with evidence to focus engineering efforts on high-risk areas.

  • Drive remediation by translating findings into actionable tasks for platform, Akamai, Azure, and Sitecore engineers.

  • Collaborate with team leads to schedule remediation within sprints and change windows without disrupting ongoing projects.

  • Provide hands-on technical support for complex fixes, including WAF rule tuning, patching, dependency upgrades, and mitigation design.

  • Track remediation progress and verify that fixes resolve the findings rather than just suppressing symptoms.

  • Own the patching cadence and currency of the platform estate, including operating systems, runtimes, CMS, and third-party components.

  • Plan and coordinate patching campaigns across regions and maintenance windows.

  • Identify and reduce structural causes of recurring vulnerabilities, such as unsupported versions, unmanaged dependencies, and configuration drift.

  • Produce reports on vulnerability and patching status for leadership and risk functions.

  • Evidence remediation against internal security policy timescales and support audit and regulatory requests.

  • Represent the platform in security governance forums, remediation reviews, and risk acceptance discussions.

  • Escalate issues effectively when necessary.

Requirements

  • 6–8 years of senior hands-on engineering experience (technical credibility with engineers is essential).

  • Experience in vulnerability management or security remediation at scale in production environments.

  • Working knowledge of web infrastructure, including CDN, WAF, TLS, DNS, HTTP security headers, and common web attack mitigations.

  • Cloud platform experience, preferably with Azure (patching, configuration baselines, identity, and network controls).

  • Ability to interpret, reproduce, and assess scanner findings within the architecture, not just relying on tool ratings.

  • Familiarity with vulnerability scoring and prioritization frameworks and ability to articulate risk clearly for non-specialists.

  • Proven ability to drive work through non-direct reports using influence, clarity, and follow-through.

  • Strong written English and confidence working with stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones.

  • Experience with WAF policies and security controls.

  • Experience with Sitecore or comparable enterprise CMS.

  • Scripting and automation skills (Python, PowerShell, or similar) for tooling integration and reporting.

  • Familiarity with regulated financial services environments and operational resilience expectations.

  • Relevant certification (e.g., CISSP, OSCP, Azure Security Engineer Associate) or comparable practical expertise.

title: Klaviyo Migration & Rollout Consultant
description:
co.brick talents — powered by AI, powered by people.

About the Project We are currently partnering with a dynamic, international client to find a highly experienced Klaviyo Migration & Rollout Expert. In this critical role, you will lead a strategic technology migration from Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) to Klaviyo, followed by a comprehensive rollout across multiple international markets and business entities.

If you have a proven track record of transitioning enterprise marketing ecosystems, deep expertise in Shopify integrations, and a strategic mindset for global email marketing architecture, we want you to drive this digital transformation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Migration Leadership: Spearhead the end-to-end migration from Salesforce Marketing Cloud to Klaviyo, ensuring a seamless transition with minimal disruption to ongoing operations.

  • Asset & Data Transfer: Migrate and optimize existing marketing processes, intricate customer data structures, campaign assets, and automated flows.

  • Global Rollout Strategy: Plan, manage, and support international Klaviyo rollouts across various business entities and localized markets.

  • Segmentation & Architecture: Design and implement highly effective customer segmentation strategies and advanced target-group logic to drive engagement.

  • Data Centralization: Support the architecture and centralization of customer and performance data to ensure single-source-of-truth analytics.

  • Technical Execution: Take a hands-on role in data mapping, system integrations, extensive QA/testing activities, and orchestrating a flawless go-live execution.

What We Are Looking For

  • Migration Expertise: Proven experience successfully delivering complex Klaviyo migration projects. Direct experience migrating specifically from Salesforce Marketing Cloud is highly preferred.

  • E-commerce Ecosystems: Strong, hands-on experience with seamless Shopify and Klaviyo integrations.

  • Global Scale: Demonstrated experience working on international or multi-market rollouts, understanding the nuances of cross-border data and localization.

  • Strategic Deep Knowledge: A profound, practical understanding of:

    • Advanced customer segmentation

    • Automated marketing flows and triggers

    • Customer lifecycle management (CLM)

    • Customer journey design and optimization

  • Language Skills: Exceptional communication skills in English (written and spoken) are mandatory. Proficiency in German is considered a significant plus.

Project Details & Engagement

  • Start Date: ASAP

  • Location: 100% Remote (Please note: Candidates must be based in the EU)

  • Capacity: Full-time engagement is highly preferred (Minimum 50% capacity/availability required)

  • Project Language: English (German is a bonus)

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
AI Software Engineer

rozwój aplikacji AI full stack z agentem

Miejsce pracy: Warszawa lub praca zdalna

to kameralny zespół rozwijający rozwiązania AI dla biznesu i instytucji publicznych. Łączymy rozwój własnych produktów z doradztwem i integracją systemów. Szukamy osoby, która pomoże nam dostarczać bezpieczne, użyteczne i stabilne oprogramowanie.

Co będziesz rozwijać

  • TWIN:DESK – środowisko pracy z AI, dokumentami, wiedzą organizacji, cyfrowymi bliźniakami i agentami.

  • PROXY:AI – platformę dostępu do modeli i narzędzi AI, kontroli uprawnień, bezpieczeństwa, kosztów i audytu.

  • CDF – oprogramowanie wspierające wdrożenia AI: procesy, reguły, zatwierdzenia, dokumentację i dowody audytowe.

Jak pracujemy

Oprogramowanie wytwarzamy z użyciem agentów. Inżynier przygotowuje wymagania, kontekst i plan zmian, prowadzi implementację z agentem oraz sprawdza kod, testy i działanie aplikacji. Odpowiada za poprawność rozwiązania i potrafi samodzielnie zdiagnozować problem. Szukamy osoby z mocnymi kompetencjami backendowymi w Pythonie, gotowej rozwijać także interfejs i sprawdzać działanie całej funkcji.

Zakres obowiązków

  • Rozwój funkcji od API i modelu danych po działający interfejs użytkownika, z wykorzystaniem Codexa.

  • Analiza wymagań, definiowanie kryteriów odbioru oraz przygotowywanie planów, instrukcji i kontekstu dla agenta programistycznego.

  • Implementacja i integracja aplikacji LLM, RAG, agentów AI i usług MCP, z kontrolą stanu, uprawnień i kosztów.

  • Rozwój procesów biznesowych, reguł, formularzy, zatwierdzeń i obsługi dokumentów w produktach. Budowa mechanizmów izolacji danych, kontroli dostępu, bezpiecznych integracji oraz rejestrowania działań systemu.

  • Przegląd i poprawianie kodu generowanego przez AI; testy automatyczne, ewaluacja jakości odpowiedzi i weryfikacja zmian w przeglądarce.

  • Diagnozowanie błędów, refaktoryzacja, aktualizacja zależności, dokumentowanie zmian oraz współpraca przy architekturze i wdrożeniach.

Nasze oczekiwania

  • Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w programowaniu w Pythonie oraz praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu aplikacji wykorzystujących LLM.

  • Praktyczna znajomość API webowych, np. FastAPI, programowania asynchronicznego, SQL, transakcji i migracji baz danych.

  • Umiejętność pracy z Codexem lub podobnymi agentami: dzielenie zadań, przygotowanie kontekstu, ocena zmian i samodzielne debugowanie.

  • Znajomość JavaScript lub TypeScript, HTML i CSS pozwalająca rozwijać i weryfikować interfejs: formularze, stan aplikacji, integracje API i obsługę błędów.

  • Rozumienie RAG, wyszukiwania wektorowego, wywoływania narzędzi przez agentów oraz zarządzania stanem i zatwierdzeniami użytkownika.

  • Umiejętność projektowania kontroli dostępu, ochrony sekretów i izolacji danych oraz rozumienie zagrożeń związanych z użyciem LLM.

  • Praktyczna znajomość Git, testów automatycznych, Dockera i podstaw Linuxa; umiejętność diagnozowania problemów na podstawie logów.

  • Umiejętność przekładania potrzeb użytkowników na zadania i kryteria odbioru oraz odpowiedzialność za jakość dostarczonej funkcji.

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie z bazami wektorowymi, grafowymi i rozwiązaniami kolejkowymi.

  • Praca z lokalnymi modelami i vLLM, wdrożeniami on-premises, CI/CD oraz pomiarem jakości, wydajności i kosztów AI.

  • Integracje SSO/OIDC i MCP, polityki RBAC/ABAC, testy przeglądarkowe oraz dbałość o dostępność i spójność interfejsu.

Oferujemy

  • Przejrzyste i stabilne formy zatrudnienia według Twoich preferencji.

  • Pracę nad własnymi produktami AI oraz projektami dla dużych instytucji sektora publicznego i prywatnego.

  • Szkolenia wewnętrzne i dofinansowanie kursów zgodnych z kierunkiem kariery i zainteresowaniami.

title: Lead Teachers at Bensenville KinderCare
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Lead Teacher you will:

  • Lead, coach and mentor less experienced teachers in your classroom; model behaviors and provide feedback
  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Possess active Child Development Associate (CDA) Credential or meet NAEYC candidacy requirements
  • Approved state trainer (preferred)
  • 2-3 years Early Childhood Education Experience (preferred)

  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Use a computer, lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Be able to make physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children

Range of pay $16.85 - $21.60 Hourly

title: Mentor/ka Design - Wolontariat
description:
Cześć!

Jeśli masz 3–4 h tygodniowo i chcesz wspierać początkujących designerów w projektach dla organizacji pozarządowych, rola Mentora/ki UX/UI jest dla Ciebie.

Jesteśmy fundacją, która pomaga innym fundacjom odnaleźć się w cyfrowym świecie. 👾

Budujemy społeczność osób rozwijających się w IT, które chcą przy tym wspierać innych. Pomagamy NGO i sobie nawzajem w znajdowaniu ścieżek prowadzących do własnych celów.

Realizujemy projekty z obszaru stron internetowych, brandingu, aplikacji mobilnych, strategii marketingowej i automatyzacji. Design jest jednym z filarów każdego z nich.

O projekcie „Strona od Nowa"

W projekcie „Strona od Nowa" tworzymy od zera nowoczesne strony internetowe dla organizacji pozarządowych, które nie mają zasobów, żeby zrobić to samodzielnie. Każdy zespół (Design, Dev, PM) pracuje z jedną fundacją przez ok. 6 miesięcy: od warsztatów i makiet, przez projekt graficzny, po wdrożenie.

Działamy w pełni zdalnie i elastycznie. Rozwijamy się i robimy coś dobrego 💜

Twoja rola jako Mentora/ki UX/UI

Jako mentor/ka będziesz:

  • prowadzić designerów przez cały proces projektowy: od warsztatów z fundacją i badania potrzeb, przez strukturę informacji i makiety UX, po finalny interfejs,

  • wspierać ich w tworzeniu layoutów, systemów wizualnych i gotowych ekranów,

  • pomagać w pracy z siatkami, hierarchią wizualną, typografią i kolorystyką,

  • konsultować decyzje projektowe w oparciu o potrzeby NGO i ich odbiorców,

  • prowadzić regularne review makiet, ekranów i komponentów w Figmie,

  • dbać o spójność, logikę i jakość projektów,

  • pomagać designerom przygotować projekt w formie czytelnej dla developerów.

Nie ma tu presji komercyjnej. Skupiasz się na prowadzeniu zespołów i podnoszeniu jakości ich pracy.

Nasze wymagania

  • ponad 5-letnie doświadczenie w UX/UI designie (komercyjne, produktowe lub agencyjne),

  • bardzo dobra znajomość Figmy (komponenty, auto-layout, style, siatki),

  • umiejętność pracy z design systemami lub tworzenia ich od zera,

  • znajomość procesu projektowego: wireframy, prototypy, podstawy researchu i testów z użytkownikami,

  • wyczucie typografii, spacingu, hierarchii i responsywności,

  • umiejętność tłumaczenia decyzji projektowych i dawania klarownego feedbacku,

  • komunikatywność i gotowość do pracy z kilkoma zespołami,

  • 3–4 h tygodniowo realnej dostępności.

Co zyskasz

  • doświadczenie jako Mentor/ka UX/UI i Art Director,

  • wpływ na poziom i standardy designu w całym programie,

  • rozwój kompetencji liderskich i mentorskich w bezpiecznym środowisku,

  • współpracę z zespołami Design, Dev i PM,

  • możliwość kształtowania procesów projektowych w projektach NGO,

  • elastyczne godziny i pełną pracę zdalną.

title: Administrator – Trust
description:
At INTRUST Bank, People Come First. Guided by strong character qualities—such as respect, compassion, humility, positivity, and initiative—we work to support one another, serve our customers, and strengthen our communities. Here, your career matters. You’ll find an environment where you’re encouraged to grow, empowered to lead at any level, and supported as you build a meaningful career with a trusted organization.


Job Summary: The Trust Administrator provides essential support in the administration of personal and institutional trust and investment accounts, ensuring efficient, compliant, and high-quality client service. Directly supporting and working closely with Trust Advisors, this role manages a wide range of administrative, operational, and client service functions that uphold fiduciary responsibilities and regulatory standards. The Trust Administrator collaborates with internal teams and external partners to maintain account workflows, resolve inquiries, and enhance the client experience. Promotes an environment of teamwork within the department and across the bank. Represents INTRUST Bank in all they do in the community and is focused on the development of new business relationships. Must maintain strict standards of confidentiality and perform duties in a manner supporting INTRUST’s Character Qualities.


Essential Functions: All expectations described in the job description’s essential functions are necessary to be successful in this role, performed with or without a reasonable accommodation.

  • Provide administrative support to Trust Advisors in managing personal and institutional trust and investment accounts.
  • Maintain and update trust account records, process account openings, distributions, and terminations.
  • Coordinate account workflows and monitor key deadlines to ensure timely and compliant service.
  • Execute fiduciary responsibilities including discretionary distributions, asset oversight, and account maintenance.
  • Process daily transactions such as cash movements, bill payments, and asset transfers.
  • Respond to client inquiries with professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Draft correspondence and prepare reports, presentations, and client meeting materials.
  • Collaborate with internal departments such as Investments, Legal, Compliance, and Operations to resolve client issues.
  • Maintain relationships with external contacts including attorneys, CPAs, and assisted-living facilities.
  • Apply knowledge of trust and estate concepts including relevant laws and investment strategies.
  • Assist with tax documentation, valuations, and regulatory filings.
  • Monitor account activity for compliance with trust provisions, applicable laws, and internal policies.
  • Support account reviews, audits, and documentation of fiduciary decisions.
  • Identify and escalate potential compliance or risk issues to Trust Advisors or management.
  • Participate in team meetings, training, and provide backup support to other Trust Administrators as needed.


Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field preferred. Minimum of 2 years of experience in trust administration, wealth management, or investment services preferred. Familiarity with trust principles, investment management, and estate planning concepts is highly desirable.


Required Skills and Knowledge: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a strong client service orientation. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities with strong organizational and time management skills. High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, compliance, and confidentiality. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and trust accounting systems (e.g., SEI, FIS, or similar). Foundational knowledge of fiduciary principles, trust structures, and estate planning concepts.


Required Licenses and/or Certifications: Any industry designations specific to the Wealth Management business is a plus.


Physical Demands: Extended period(s) of time may be spent viewing a personal computer, sitting, standing, and walking. Occasional lifting up to 25 lbs. The physical demands necessary for this role should be performed with or without a reasonable accommodation.


Working Conditions: Normal office conditions.


This job description summary is not intended to be an employment contract, nor is it intended to state or imply these are the only activities to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other duties as assigned or requested by their supervisor.


INTRUST Financial Corporation and its subsidiaries, including INTRUST Bank, are Equal Opportunity Employers whose policy is not to discriminate unlawfully against any qualified employee or applicant for employment on the basis of protected military or veteran status, disability, race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, pregnancy, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state or federal law; except where an individual’s protected category constitutes a bona fide occupational qualification.

title: Ekspert Solution Architect (m/k)
description:
PSE Innowacje to spółka technologiczna Grupy PSE – operatora systemu przesyłowego. Od 2012 roku tworzymy systemy informatyczne wspierające prowadzenie ruchu sieciowego i niezawodną pracę Krajowego Systemu Elektroenergetycznego (KSE). Realizujemy też prace badawczo-rozwojowe dla branży elektroenergetycznej. Od naszego oprogramowania zależy stabilna praca sieci przesyłowej, a w konsekwencji dostawy energii w całej Polsce. Transformacja energetyczna, rozwój OZE i integracja z europejskim rynkiem energii stawiają przed nami ambitne wyzwania technologiczne – odpowiadamy na nie, łącząc inżynierską solidność z nowoczesnymi praktykami, w tym z wykorzystaniem AI.

📍 Miejsce pracy:

  • Wrocław,

  • Praca hybrydowa.

🛠 Kluczowe obszary odpowiedzialności na tym stanowisku:

  • Tworzenie docelowej architektury aplikacyjnej i roadmapy technologicznej dla systemów wspierających pracę Krajowego Systemu Elektroenergetycznego

  • Definiowanie standardów architektonicznych dla API, integracji, danych, bezpieczeństwa, chmury i CI/CD

  • Wyznaczanie zasad bezpiecznego wykorzystania narzędzi AI w procesie wytwarzania oprogramowania – od projektowania, przez implementację i testy, po przeglądy kodu i dokumentację

  • Projektowanie rozwiązań opartych na modelach AI zgodnie z wymaganiami infrastruktury krytycznej (ochrona danych, audytowalność, uruchamianie na własnej infrastrukturze)

  • Prowadzenie przeglądów architektonicznych oraz ocena nowych technologii, prototypów i PoC – również tych opartych na AI

  • Identyfikowanie, priorytetyzowanie i redukcja długu technicznego w portfelu aplikacji – także z wykorzystaniem AI w modernizacji i refaktoryzacji kodu

  • Koordynowanie decyzji architektonicznych między zespołami, Solution Architectami i Tech Leadami oraz współpraca z właścicielami produktów i biznesem

  • Mentoring architektów i liderów technicznych

📝 Nasze wymagania:

  • Minimum 7 lat doświadczenia w IT, w tym co najmniej 3 lata w roli Solution Architecta, Lead Architecta lub Senior Tech Leada

  • Doświadczenia w projektowaniu złożonych systemów rozproszonych oraz praktycznego doświadczenia programistycznego (preferowana Java)

  • Bardzo dobrej znajomości notacji UML i C4 oraz praktycznej znajomości Sparx Enterprise Architect

  • Umiejętności komunikowania architektury odbiorcom technicznym i biznesowym

  • Znajomości stylów architektonicznych (Microservices, REST, Event-Driven) i protokołów komunikacyjnych (HTTP, AMQP, Kafka)

  • Praktycznej znajomości baz danych SQL (np. Oracle)

  • Doświadczenia z platformami kontenerowymi, np. Docker, Podman, K8s lub Nomad

  • Doświadczenia w ustanawianiu standardów architektonicznych, prowadzeniu przeglądów architektury i zarządzaniu długiem technicznym

💎Dodatkowym atutem będzie:

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z asystentami i agentami AI w wytwarzaniu oprogramowania

  • Znajomość wzorców rozwiązań opartych na LLM, np. RAG czy architektury agentowe

  • Doświadczenie w projektach dla energetyki lub innych sektorów infrastruktury krytycznej

🚀 Z naszej strony zapewniamy:

  • Stabilne zatrudnienie na podstawie umowy o pracę.

  • Konkurencyjny system wynagrodzeń, składający się z wynagrodzenia podstawowego oraz atrakcyjnego systemu premiowego.

  • Indywidualny budżet szkoleniowy, przyznawany na podnoszenie kwalifikacji i wspierający rozwój zawodowy.

  • Klarowną ścieżkę rozwoju zawodowego.

  • Elastyczne godziny pracy i możliwość pracy zdalnej/hybrydowej.

  • Pakiet benefitów pozapłacowych . prywatna opieka medyczna, karta Multisport oraz ubezpieczenie na życie na preferencyjnych warunkach, dodatkowe świadczenia w ramach ZFŚS.

  • Dodatkowy dzień wolny z okazji Dnia Energetyka – 14 sierpnia.

  • Pracę w przyjaznej atmosferze i wsparcie zespołu nastawionego na dzielenie się wiedzą oraz doświadczeniami.

  • Wewnętrzny program mentoringowy wspierający zarówno nowych jak i obecnych pracowników.

  • Program onboardingowy pozwalający na szybką i przyjazną adaptacje do pracy.

  • Udział w projektach greenfield mających strategiczny wpływ na sektor energetyczny w Polsce i w Europie.

Chcesz dołączyć do naszego zespołu? Aplikuj już teraz 💻

title: Data Analyst
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Insight Generation & Business Strategy: Partner with cross-functional leadership (Product, Growth, Finance, Operations) to identify trends, diagnose churn/growth drivers, and discover high-value business opportunities.

  • Analytics Engineering & Data Modeling: Write clean, modular, and version-controlled SQL models (using tools like dbt) to transform raw data into well-structured, production-ready tables.

  • Modern Visualization & Storytelling: Design intuitive, dynamic dashboards and narrative reports (using Lightdash, Looker, Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI) that drive decision-making rather than just display metrics.

  • Data Quality & Governance: Establish data definitions, document metrics in a central data catalog, and ensure high standards for data accuracy, testing, and reliability.

  • AI & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI-assisted analytics workflows and automated pipelines to speed up data exploration and deliver real-time operational alerts.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: 2–5 years of experience in a data analytics, product analytics, or business intelligence role.

  • Advanced SQL & Modeling: Strong mastery of SQL (window functions, CTEs, performance optimization) and familiarity with modern data transformation practices.

  • Modern Data Stack: Hands-on experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks) and BI/semantic layer tools.

  • Business Acumen & Storytelling: Ability to translate complex quantitative findings into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Analytical & Statistical Mindset: Solid understanding of basic statistical concepts (hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, regression analysis).

  • Version Control & Collaboration: Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub workflow for managing analytics code.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience using dbt (data build tool) for analytics engineering.

  • Proficiency in Python or R for exploratory data analysis, automation, or statistical modeling.

  • Experience with product analytics platforms (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog).

  • Background in agile/scrum environments.

2 Databricks data Engineers: We are seeking 2 Senior Databricks Data Engineers to design, build, and scale a modern Lakehouse platform using Spec-Driven Development (SDD), Apache Airflow, and dbt. In this role, you will translate architectural requirements into reliable production solutions, ensuring data contracts, transformations, and orchestration processes are clearly defined, thoroughly tested, and fully automated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable Databricks data pipelines based on the Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers) using Delta Lake.

  • Lead the adoption of Spec-Driven Development (SDD) by creating machine-readable specifications and data contracts before implementation.

  • Build, monitor, and optimize workflow orchestration pipelines using Apache Airflow.

  • Develop, test, and maintain modular data transformation models with dbt, integrated with the Databricks SQL and Spark ecosystem.

  • Optimize PySpark workloads, manage cluster configurations, and control compute and storage costs.

  • Implement data governance, granular access controls, and data lineage tracking through Unity Catalog.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, including extensive production experience with Databricks.

  • Strong expertise in Apache Airflow for workflow scheduling, dependency management, and error handling.

  • Advanced knowledge of dbt modeling, testing practices, and macro development.

  • Practical experience with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and metadata-driven data platform design.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python (PySpark) and SQL.

  • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD processes, and infrastructure-as-code practices.

Multi-Cloud Experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • AWS: Configure and manage integrations with Amazon S3, IAM roles, and VPCs to support secure and scalable data platforms.

  • Azure: Implement secure data storage using Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2), integrate with Microsoft Entra ID, and deliver data to analytics platforms such as Power BI.

  • GCP: Build and operate data workflows using Google Cloud Storage (GCS) while enabling integration with BigQuery and Vertex AI for downstream analytics and AI use cases.

Our People

The ideal consultants will share our values and be aligned with our ways of working and as your career progresses, you can expect to work across all areas of the project lifecycle, from strategy to implementation. This will provide you with a broad base of experience from which to build an outstanding career.

title: Junior DevOps Engineer
description:
Szukamy JuniorDevOps Engineera, który chce rozwijać skrzydła w chmurze! ☁️


Czujesz, że DevOps to kierunek dla Ciebie?

Masz za sobą pierwsze projekty lub naukę w domu i szukasz miejsca, gdzie zamienisz teorię na praktykę?


To może być miejsce dla Ciebie :)



Kogo szukamy?


  1. Podstawowa znajomość podstaw jednej z chmur: AWS / Microsoft Azure / Google Cloud Platform,


  1. Pierwsze kroki z Terraformem lub innym narzędziem Infrastructure as Code,


  1. Umiejętność pracy z Dockerem i podstawy Kubernetes,


  1. Znajomość podstawowych zagadnień CI/CD,


  1. Skryptowanie w Bash lub Pythonie na poziomie podstawowym,


  1. Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie min. B2.



Jakie będą Twoje zadania?


W zależności od poziomu umiejętności i doświadczenia:


  1. Tworzenie i rozwijanie infrastruktury chmurowej z użyciem Terraform,


  1. Udział we wdrożeniach aplikacji i projektowaniu automatyzacji wdrożeń (CI/CD),


  1. Zarządzanie środowiskami Kubernetes i monitorowanie ich wydajności,


  1. Automatyzacja procesów developerskich i operacyjnych,


  1. Wsparcie zespołu developerskiego w zakresie infrastruktury i narzędzi,


  1. Tworzenie dokumentacji technicznej,



Co oferujemy?


  1. Forma współpracy: Umowa o Pracę, B2B lub Umowa zlecenie - w zależności od preferencji,


  1. Tryb pracy: 100% zdalny,


  1. Elastyczny czas pracy,


  1. Realne wsparcie w procesie rozwoju,


  1. Możliwość awansu i udziału w ambitnych projektach międzynarodowych.

title: Senior C++ Developer
description:
• Work mode - fully remote.

  • Assignment type: B2B contract.

  • Start - ASAP/1 month.

  • Contract length > 10-12 months + extensions.

  • Language - English.

  • Recruitment process - 1 interview with Recruiter - at least 1 interview with the client.

  • Workload: Full time.

Introduction & Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior C++ Developer to join our Quality Verification team, focused on enhancing automated multiplayer playtesting through innovative AI bot systems. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in software engineering, particularly in C++, with a dedication to ensuring high-quality gaming experiences.

Main Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain AI bot systems for automated multiplayer playtesting.

  • Develop bot behavior systems including movement, combat, interaction, and coordination.

  • Collaborate with designers and QA engineers to translate gameplay scenarios into testable bot behaviors.

  • Build telemetry pipelines for analysis, regression testing, and behavior validation.

  • Investigate bot failures such as pathfinding, network desynchronization, and gameplay interaction issues.

  • Modernize architecture and improve maintainability.

  • Participate in exploratory machine-learning-driven bot behavior research.

  • Review code and contribute to engineering best practices.

Key Requirements

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience.

  • Strong C++ proficiency.

  • Experience with AI behavior systems such as finite state machines or behavior trees.

  • Proven ability to improve maintainability in complex codebases.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in multiplayer game development.

  • Knowledge of performance optimization techniques.

  • Understanding of debugging and profiling tools.

  • Experience with automated testing infrastructure is a significant plus.

  • Familiarity with Frostbite, Unreal, or Unity is an asset.

  • Exposure to reinforcement learning concepts is a bonus.

Other Details

This position is fully remote and offers the opportunity to contribute to a dynamic and innovative gaming development environment. While remote work is supported, candidates based in Bucharest are preferred, as the team is located there. Occasional office presence would be welcomed for collaboration purposes, though it is not mandatory.

title: Junior Fullstack Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
PAYBACK is unique worldwide in data-based marketing. With the ability to develop digital business models and implement technical trends, we are pioneers of the data economy. The technical solutions for our 31 million customers relating to the PAYBACK program are designed and operated in-house. To this end, we work with the latest technologies and in a cross-functional and agile way.

Would you like to take on responsibility, contribute your ideas around our products and further develop PAYBACK with us? Then you’ve come to the right place.

OF COURSE, we don’t just live diversity. We celebrate it! Will you join us? We look forward to getting to know you.

Your responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance features across our web applications and services

  • Contribute to all phases of the software development lifecycle, including implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring

  • Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize existing applications and services

  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following engineering best practices

  • Create and maintain automated tests to ensure software quality and reliability

  • Participate in code reviews and pair programming sessions to improve code quality and share knowledge

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to deliver high-quality solutions

  • Support CI/CD pipelines and integrations with APIs, databases, and third-party services

  • Take ownership of the services and features you build following a "You Build It, You Run It" mindset

  • Continuously learn and contribute ideas for improving our products, processes, and technology stack

Your Profile:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • First professional experience in software development through internships, working student positions, university projects, personal projects, or a junior engineering role

  • Experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem

  • Basic understanding of frontend technologies such as JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web frameworks

  • Familiarity with Core, REST APIs, and modern web application architectures

  • Knowledge of relational databases, preferably Microsoft SQL Server

  • Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, debugging, and clean code principles

  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows

  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or Microsoft Azure is a plus

  • Basic knowledge of containerization and DevOps practices (e.g., Docker, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code)

  • Eagerness to learn across the full stack, including backend, frontend, databases, testing, monitoring, and operations

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset

  • Fluent English skills; German is a plus

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

  • Experience with Docker and containerized applications

  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD tools

  • Knowledge of Entity Framework Core

  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code solutions such as Terraform

  • Exposure to messaging, monitoring, and observability tools

  • Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js

  • Interest in cloud-native architectures and modern software engineering practices

How about?

  • Employment contract?Of course. With us you do not have to worry about stable employment.

  • Benefits?We have them! Among other: corporate incentive program, sport card, private medical care.

  • Lunch card?With the cooperation extended and permanent contract, you will receive additional funds to use for meal purchases.

  • Working in a hybrid model?Of course! ! You work with us 2 days a week from home.

  • Fancy a workation?At PAYBACK, you can work remotely from European countries for up to 15 days a year.

  • ‎Flexible working hours?Sounds great! We start working between 7 to 10.

  • Trainings?Of course. We provide training to develop hard and soft skills.

  • Convenient location?Sure! We invite you to our new office at Rondo Daszyńskiego, but we are currently also working remotely.

  • Dress code?We definitely say no. There are no rigid dress code rules in our company, sneakers are more than welcome.

  • Friendly atmosphere at work?Yes! In PAYBACK, people are the most important asset‎.

  • ‎Something is missing?Open communication is our priority, so dare to ask!‎

title: JD Edwards ERP Specialist (Finance) – Product Costing and Transfer Pricing
description:
JD Edwards ERP Specialist (Finance) – Product Costing and Transfer Pricing

Location:

Emagine office in Porto, Portugal, working onsite 4 days per week and 1 day remote

Start Date:

ASAP

Duration:

  • 2 years (Time & Material, full-time)

  • Possibility for permanent employment after the contract period free of charge

Important info:

Skill set and capabilities similar to industry standards.

About the Job

Your role will be a key contributor to our ERP Finance team, covering:

  • Process redesign

  • Continuous improvements

  • Project opportunities

  • Third-level support

You will be exposed to our change management processes and company culture, providing insights into a major medtech enterprise.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide expert analysis on JDE/Enterprise One

  • Ensure best practices for E1 in projects by participating in workshops, identifying issues and solutions

  • Review improvement suggestions for E1 design and processes from colleagues

  • Assist the finance team during month-end and year-end

  • Handle some third-level support cases and recommend solutions

  • Produce high-quality documentation

  • Utilize new E1 technologies such as orchestrator and UDOs

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience with the E1 ERP system, specifically with finance modules

  • Strong understanding of finance processes and accounting principles

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in accounting or a related field

  • CPA or CFA certification is an advantage

  • C1 English Level

Competencies

  • Strong leadership & negotiating skills

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Must Have:

Consultants must be experts in product costing and transfer pricing with the JD Edwards Finance module.

Local-based consultants or those willing to relocate from Brazil are preferred.

Other Details: This position is expected to operate in an international environment, requiring effective collaboration across regions.

title: Senior GenAI Engineer – Python
description:
About the Client

We are seeking experienced Senior GenAI Engineer – Python and cloud-native application development. In this role, you will design, build, and optimize scalable backend systems that power AI-driven and intelligent automation solutions in the cloud.

What you will do

  • Build LLM-powered features end to end. Design and implement agentic flows, retrieval, and tool calling using LangGraph — then ship them as FastAPI services with streaming, persistence and proper tests.

  • Own answer quality. Build evaluation datasets, regression suites and LLM-as-judge checks so we know whether a prompt or model change made things better before it reaches users.

  • Get the right context to the model. Turn user questions into effective queries against our search platform, orchestrate multi-step research loops, and shape the context the model reasons over. When an answer is wrong, work out whether retrieval, the query or the prompt is at fault — and fix the right one.

  • Debug production. Instrument flows with tracing (Langfuse), investigate bad answers from real traces, and manage latency, token and cost budgets — including routing across model sizes and families behind an AI gateway.

What we are looking for:

  • Strong proficiency in Python for backend development (FastAPI, Flask, Django, or similar frameworks).

  • Deep understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and API development.

  • Solid experience with Azure cloud services, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), storage, and serverless technologies.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM), and monitoring tools (App Insights, Prometheus, Grafana).

  • General interest and experience with AI-driven applications, and automation

  • Hands-on experience or strong understanding of AI-driven systems and intelligent automation workflows.

  • Know how to work with LLM use API and know how their are tested, know what RAG is, LangGraph and other tools like that experience.

  • Ability to apply prompt engineering and integrate machine learning or LLM APIs effectively.

  • Proven track record in system build, scalability and performance optimization.

  • Experience in code reviews, mentoring and setting engineering standards.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and technical decision-making.

  • Fluent in English, proactive communicator, and a collaborative team player.

  • Open-minded, creative, and motivated to push boundaries in AI and automation.

Perks and benefits

  • Comprehensive benefits: Udemy for Business, private medical care, Multisport card, veterinary package, language lessons and shopping vouchers.

  • Flexibility: adaptable working hours and remote or hybrid work options to suit your lifestyle and location.

  • Career growth: professional development opportunities and access to benefits resulting from partnerships with Microsoft, AWS, Snowflake, Salesforce and other global technology companies.

  • Global collaboration: cooperation with a diverse, international team.

  • Innovative environment: an opportunity to help shape modern AI and intelligent automation solutions.

  • Engaging community: team-building events, hackathons and CSR initiatives.

  • An annual company event in Mazury.

  • A welcome pack to start your journey with us.

title: Starszy Specjalista ds. analizy biznesowej i rozwoju systemu CSIRE (k/m/n)
description:
Polskie Sieci Elektroenergetyczne S.A. poszukują osoby na stanowisko:

Starszy Specjalista ds. analizy biznesowej i rozwoju systemu CSIRE (k/m/n)

Podstawowy zakres obowiązków:

  • Aktywny udział w projektach związanych z wdrożeniem i transformacją CSIRE.

  • Analiza i ocena inicjatyw rozwojowych oraz przygotowywanie dokumentacji przedwdrożeniowej.

  • Koordynacja działań związanych z wdrażaniem zmian oraz monitorowanie ich zgodności z wymaganiami biznesowymi, regulacyjnymi i organizacyjnymi.

  • Współpraca z wykonawcami systemów informatycznych w zakresie definiowania, uzgadniania i wdrażania zmian.

  • Merytoryczna weryfikacja dokumentacji projektowej, analitycznej i wdrożeniowej.

  • Definiowanie, zbieranie oraz dokumentowanie wymagań funkcjonalnych dla systemów IT.

  • Identyfikowanie oraz rekomendowanie zmian wynikających z potrzeb biznesowych, zmian legislacyjnych oraz oczekiwań interesariuszy.

  • Wsparcie realizacji testów, odbiorów i uruchomień nowych wersji systemu.

  • Przygotowywanie dokumentacji wdrożeniowej oraz procedur związanych z funkcjonowaniem i rozwojem CSIRE.

Nasze wymagania

  • Wykształcenie wyższe, preferowane kierunki: energetyka, informatyka lub inne techniczne.

  • Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia zawodowego na stanowisku o podobnym zakresie zadań.

  • Znajomość procesu definiowania i dokumentowania wymagań funkcjonalnych dla systemów IT.

  • Udział we wdrażaniu, rozwoju lub utrzymaniu złożonych systemów informatycznych.

  • Umiejętność współpracy i prowadzenia uzgodnień z wykonawcami systemów IT.

  • Znajomość procesów testowania, odbiorów i uruchamiania systemów informatycznych.

  • Umiejętność tworzenia analiz biznesowych oraz dokumentacji technicznej i projektowej.

  • Znajomość notacji BPMN i/lub UML.

  • Język angielski na poziomie minimum B2.

  • Rozwinięte zdolności analityczne, umiejętność budowania relacji, samodzielność oraz skuteczna organizacja pracy, także pod presją czasu.

Mile widziane

  • Znajomość zasad funkcjonowania rynku energii elektrycznej w Polsce.

  • Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi Jira, Confluence oraz Enterprise Architect (lub rozwiązań o podobnej funkcjonalności).

  • Znajomość zasad tworzenia i wykorzystania schematów XSD.

Oferujemy

  • zatrudnienie w oparciu o umowę o pracę

  • atrakcyjny system wynagrodzeń uwzględniający czytelny system premiowy

  • szkolenia podnoszące kwalifikacje i zapewniające rozwój zawodowy

  • pakiet benefitów pozapłacowych, m.in. prywatna opieka medyczna, ubezpieczenie na życie, karta multisport, dodatkowe świadczenia w ramach ZFŚS

  • dodatkowy dzień wolny z okazji Dnia Energetyka - 14 sierpnia

title: Architect (she/he/they)
description:
W Żabce Future napędzamy cyfrową transformację Grupy Żabka. Tworzymy nowoczesny, skalowalny ekosystem technologiczny, który łączy dane, narzędzia i procesy w spójną całość.
Działamy szybko, z pomysłem i w zgranych zespołach. Stawiamy na skalowalne technologie, realny wpływ i ciągłe doskonalenie 💙

Aktualnie poszukujemy Architekta Systemowego Paperless (Hands-on Java Developer).

Co będzie należało do Twoich zadań?

  • projektowanie i rozwój aplikacji opartych na Java i Spring Boot wspierających cyfrowy obieg dokumentów, w tym e-podpis, workflow oraz elektroniczną archiwizację;

  • udział w projektowaniu architektury rozwiązań Paperless oraz aktywne tworzenie i rozwój kodu (hands-on);

  • projektowanie i rozwój integracji z wykorzystaniem REST API, SOAP oraz innych mechanizmów integracyjnych, w tym z systemami Enterprise Content Management i platformami Data Lake;

  • rozwój rozwiązań opartych na architekturze mikroserwisowej oraz dbanie o ich wydajność, bezpieczeństwo i stabilność;

  • rozwój i utrzymanie procesów CI/CD w Azure DevOps oraz środowisk kontenerowych opartych na Docker i Kubernetes;

  • utrzymanie i optymalizacja środowisk uruchomieniowych, w tym Apache Tomcat, Linux oraz Windows Server;

  • analiza i rozwiązywanie problemów obejmujących backend, integracje, logi, metryki oraz warstwę frontendową (Angular lub React);

  • współpraca z zespołami technologicznymi i biznesowymi przy projektowaniu, wdrażaniu i rozwoju rozwiązań;

  • tworzenie i aktualizacja dokumentacji technicznej oraz rozwijanie standardów i dobrych praktyk programistycznych.

Kogo szukamy?

  • masz minimum 4 lata doświadczenia komercyjnego w tworzeniu aplikacji w Java;

  • bardzo dobrze znasz Java oraz Spring Boot i wykorzystujesz je na co dzień;

  • masz doświadczenie w projektowaniu i implementacji REST API;

  • swobodnie poruszasz się w architekturze mikroserwisowej;

  • dobrze znasz relacyjne bazy danych oraz język SQL;

  • korzystasz z systemu kontroli wersji Git;

  • znasz zagadnienia DevOps oraz procesy CI/CD, w tym z wykorzystaniem Azure DevOps;

  • masz doświadczenie ze środowiskami kontenerowymi Docker i Kubernetes;

  • dobrze znasz serwery aplikacyjne, takie jak Apache Tomcat;

  • swobodnie poruszasz się w środowiskach Linux oraz Windows Server;

  • znasz Angular lub React w stopniu pozwalającym analizować kod, diagnozować błędy oraz skutecznie współpracować z osobami rozwijającymi frontend;

  • rozumiesz architekturę systemów rozproszonych oraz zagadnienia związane z integracją systemów z wykorzystaniem REST i SOAP;

  • potrafisz tworzyć przejrzystą dokumentację techniczną;

  • potrafisz analizować problemy, proponować skuteczne rozwiązania oraz efektywnie współpracować z innymi.

Mile widziane

  • znasz rozwiązania ECM (np. OpenText ECM) oraz systemy Paperless, DMS, Workflow lub OCR;

  • masz doświadczenie z narzędziami Observability (np. Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Kibana);

  • masz doświadczenie z integracją aplikacji z platformami Data Lake;

  • znasz mechanizmy uwierzytelniania i autoryzacji (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML);

  • znasz standardy modelowania (BPMN, UML, ArchiMate);

  • masz doświadczenie z Microsoft Azure;

  • posiadasz certyfikaty Microsoft Azure lub architektoniczne;

  • masz doświadczenie z rozwiązaniami do kwalifikowanego podpisu elektronicznego lub usługami zaufania.

Co oferujemy?

  • współpracę w oparciu o kontrakt B2B;

  • niezbędny sprzęt i narzędzia wspierające efektywną pracę;

  • preferencyjne warunki na kartę MultiSport, opiekę medyczną LuxMed i ubezpieczenie grupowe Uniqa

A do tego:

  • realny wpływ na technologie, z których codziennie korzystają miliony ludzi;

  • miejsce, gdzie Twoje pomysły są słyszane i mają znaczenie;

  • współpraca z ekspertami i ekspertkami z różnych dziedzin;

  • możliwość testowania innowacyjnych rozwiązań.

Jak wygląda nasz proces rekrutacyjny?

  1. Wyślij nam swoje CV – uważnie je przeczytamy.

  2. Jeśli widzimy wspólny kierunek, odezwiemy się do Ciebie i zaprosimy Cię na krótką rozmowę telefoniczną (ok. 30 minut).

  3. Kolejny etap to rozmowa merytoryczna online.

  4. Jeśli wszystko pójdzie dobrze – witamy w Żabce Future!

Polityka równości

W Żabce zależy nam na tym aby każda osoba, która przechodzi przez proces rekrutacji miała poczucie, że mogła w pełni pokazać swoje umiejętności, kompetencje i potencjał.

Wierzymy, że nasza siła pochodzi z unikatowości każdej osoby oraz wzajemnego szacunku i otwartości na różnorodność. Do aplikowania zapraszamy każdą osobę, niezależnie od wieku, płci, stopnia sprawności, sytuacji rodzinnej, religii, orientacji seksualnej, narodowości itp. Chcesz wiedzieć więcej o naszym równościowym i inkluzowym podejściu, przeczytaj Politykę równości. ()

title: Lead Teachers at Lake Zurich KinderCare
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Lead Teacher you will:

  • Lead, coach and mentor less experienced teachers in your classroom; model behaviors and provide feedback
  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Possess active Child Development Associate (CDA) Credential or meet NAEYC candidacy requirements
  • Approved state trainer (preferred)
  • 2-3 years Early Childhood Education Experience (preferred)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Early Childhood Education (preferred)
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Use a computer, lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Be able to make physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $16.85 - $21.60 Hourly

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.


In the state of Illinois, we currently provide a 15% premium in addition to the range of pay listed to all hourly employees working in a center that participates in the Illinois Smart Start Workforce Grant.

KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

title: Kierownik Projektów
description:
Dla naszego Klienta szukamy Kierownika Projektu.

Twoja rola w projekcie:

  • odpowiadasz za koordynację i realizację projektów IT od strony technicznej.

  • Współpracujesz z zespołami developerskimi, architektami, analitykami, administratorami oraz testerami w celu terminowego dostarczania rozwiązań.

  • Planujesz, koordynujesz i monitorujesz realizację prac technicznych, dbając o jakość, terminowość oraz zgodność z wymaganiami projektowymi.

  • Identyfikujesz ryzyka techniczne, zależności pomiędzy systemami oraz inicjujesz działania minimalizujące ich wpływ na projekt.

  • Wspierasz przygotowanie estymacji, harmonogramów, planów wdrożeń oraz migracji.

  • Organizujesz i prowadzisz spotkania projektowe oraz warsztaty techniczne.

  • Współpracujesz z kierownikiem biznesowym projektu, wspierając przekładanie wymagań biznesowych na rozwiązania techniczne.

  • Raportujesz status realizacji prac, kluczowe ryzyka i zależności do interesariuszy i zarządu.

  • Koordynujesz działania wielu zespołów i dostawców zaangażowanych w realizację projektu.

  • Wspierasz rozwiązywanie bieżących problemów projektowych oraz usuwanie przeszkód wpływających na realizację projektu.

Wymagania:

  • Posiadasz minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w realizacji projektów IT, w tym doświadczenie w koordynacji prac zespołów technicznych.

  • Znasz proces wytwarzania i utrzymania oprogramowania oraz rozumiesz zagadnienia związane z integracją systemów, architekturą rozwiązań i wdrożeniami.

  • Potrafisz skutecznie planować i koordynować prace prowadzone równolegle przez wiele zespołów.

  • Umiesz identyfikować ryzyka techniczne, zależności projektowe oraz skutecznie nimi zarządzać.

  • Potrafisz prowadzić komunikację zarówno z zespołami technicznymi, jak i przedstawicielami biznesu.

  • Posiadasz wysokie umiejętności organizacyjne, analityczne oraz komunikacyjne.

  • Znasz metodyki Agile/Scrum oraz praktyczne aspekty zarządzania projektami IT.

  • Znasz narzędzia Jira, Confluence oraz rozwiązania wspierające planowanie i raportowanie projektów.

  • Posługujesz się językiem angielskim na poziomie umożliwiającym swobodną współpracę w środowisku projektowym.

    • Mile widziane:
      • Certyfikat PMP, PRINCE2, PSM, PSPO lub AgilePM.
      • Doświadczenie w projektach związanych z platformami danych, integracjami systemów lub rozwiązaniami chmurowymi.
      • Doświadczenie we współpracy z zewnętrznymi dostawcami IT.

Oferujemy:

  • umowa B2B

  • miejsce realizacji usługi: Chmielna 89, Warszawa (min. 2 x w tygodniu w biurze​)

title: Lead Teachers at Country Club Hills KinderCare
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Lead Teacher you will:

  • Lead, coach and mentor less experienced teachers in your classroom; model behaviors and provide feedback
  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Possess active Child Development Associate (CDA) Credential or meet NAEYC candidacy requirements
  • Approved state trainer (preferred)
  • 2-3 years Early Childhood Education Experience (preferred)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Early Childhood Education (preferred)
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Use a computer, lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Be able to make physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $16.85 - $21.60 Hourly

- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
