- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.

title: Contract Admin Analyst I
description:
Why Us?

At Par Health, we believe great healthcare is built on getting the essentials right. We’re looking for passionate, talented individuals who share our commitment to improving lives. With a global workforce, we lead with pride and purpose—prioritizing quality and safety while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and teamwork. Elevating the Essentials isn’t just our tagline, it’s the higher standard we live by every day.

Job Description Summary

Provides revenue contract, pricing and commercial reporting support for the SpecGx business. Many of the responsibilities below require peer review and approval amongst the Contracts team members.

Job Description

SUMMARY OF POSITION:

Provides revenue contract, pricing and commercial reporting support for the SpecGx business. Many of the responsibilities below require peer review and approval amongst the Contracts team members.

Agreement Preparation and Review

  • Utilize the pricing analysis models to prepare standard and non-standard contract documents in coordination with Pricing, Product Management, and/or Sales organizations
  • Work closely with Legal and Finance to ensure all deals are compliant with business policies and function as a liaison with other departments (Customer Service, Data Integrity, Credit, Rebates) to ensure proposed terms are supported by these functional areas

Contract Administration

  • Set up and maintain contract files utilizing document management systems
  • Load contract pricing, initial membership, and rebates programs in the Revenue Management System (Model N)
  • Respond to various pricing and contract inquiries and resolve price discrepancies on chargeback submissions
  • Track project workflow and maintain proper audit support for special projects and price changes.
  • Support Audit Control by attending bi-weekly Open Items Calls for Generics and Addiction Treatment
  • Manage expiring contracts in Model N and drive annual contract performance reviews
  • Maintain Product and Pricing in McKesson’s portal, “ARK”
  • Run daily “Bid Awards” and send notifications to appropriate wholesalers

Addiction Treatment Team Support

  • Set up new Addiction Treatment Customer Contracts
  • Work with Product Monitoring to prepare Credit Request and send to customer service to process
  • Assure that internal membership groups are set up correctly in Model N and resolve any pricing/rebate issues related to membership
  • Prepare annual across the board price increases for each calendar year

Suspicious Order Monitoring (“SOM”) related tasks

Support the SOM program by updating the Trade Partner list; preparing applicable customer notifications; and performing document discovery

Partner System

Responsible for contract set up in Partner for International and API contracts; enter pricing; resolving pricing or membership issues; and preparing pricing offers

Other Duties as assigned

SCOPE OF POSITION / RELATIONSHIP WITH OTHERS:

This role reports to Manager, Contracting & Reporting, and works closely with Pricing, Finance, Legal, Sales, Product Management, Customer Service, Wholesalers, Data Integrity, SOM Team, and Customers as well as all levels of Mallinckrodt management and project teams

Education:

Associates degree preferred in Business, Accounting or Finance field or equivalent experience; Bachelor’s degree a plus

Experience:

1 to 3 years of experience with customer contracting, reporting, contract operations, or customer service; and

experience with Accounts Receivable/Payable, Cognos, Excel, Word, AS400 Queries, rfXcel, invoicing systems

Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of Mallinckrodt’s order management, customers and product lines
  • Report writing skills (i.e., Cognos, Power BI)
  • Ability to identify issues and find appropriate resolution
  • Demonstrated understanding of contract language as it relates to contract setup and maintenance to ensure accurate pricing and calculation of customer rebates and accurate representation of intended financial implications

Other Skills/Competencies:

  • Strong communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and system oriented
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and with a team
  • Strong sense of urgency with the ability to prioritize
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, and adapt positively to change

EEO Statement:

We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws prohibiting discrimination and harassment, and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or genetic information, or any other classification protected by federal, state or local law. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Automatyk/Programista PLC w branży intralogistycznej – Beckhoff, Siemens, Rockwell (f/m/x)
description:
Dział Engineering Services realizuje zaawansowane projekty z obszaru automatyki przemysłowej, a w związku z dynamicznym rozwojem nowych inicjatyw poszukujemy doświadczonych Inżynierów Automatyków do projektów w branży intralogistycznej.

To propozycja dla osób, które chcą pracować przy nowoczesnych systemach, mieć realny wpływ na realizację projektów oraz rozwijać się w środowisku międzynarodowym. Praca odbywa się w trybie hybrydowym i wiąże się z podróżami służbowymi (ok. 60% czasu w skali roku) na terenie Europy, USA oraz Kanady — to świetna okazja do zdobycia globalnego doświadczenia i pracy bezpośrednio u klientów.

Szukamy specjalistów z ugruntowanym doświadczeniem w programowaniu sterowników PLC oraz uruchamianiu systemów i linii produkcyjnych, którzy realizowali projekty samodzielnie lub w ramach większych zespołów projektowych. Projekty z zakresu intralogistyki to atrakcyjny i perspektywiczny kierunek rozwoju, szczególnie dla inżynierów z doświadczeniem w branży automotive, którzy chcą poszerzyć swoje kompetencje i pracować z nowoczesnymi rozwiązaniami automatyzującymi przepływ materiałów.

Twoje zadania

  • Programowanie sterowników przemysłowych (Beckhoff, Siemens)

  • Uruchamianie systemów automatyki przemysłowej i robotyki u klientów w Polsce i za granicą

  • Udział w testach FAT/SAT oraz wsparcie produkcji

  • Przygotowanie oprogramowania, dokumentacji technicznej i projektowej ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem wymagań bezpieczeństwa i standardów przemysłowych

  • Parametryzacja, uruchomienie i optymalizacja pracy komponentów automatyki przemysłowej – pras, systemów wizyjnych, napędów itp.

  • Usuwanie bieżących awarii linii produkcyjnych (w razie potrzeby)

  • Doświadczenie w pracy ze sterownikami PLC (Siemens, Beckhoff lub Rockwell)

  • Gotowość do wyjazdów służbowych około 60% czasu w roku, . do Węgier, Niemiec, Czech, Wielkiej Brytanii, Włoch, USA i Kanady

  • Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne: Automatyka, Robotyka, Mechatronika lub pokrewne

  • Wymagane przebywanie na terenie Polski

title: Analytics Quality Engineer - Maps on Web and iOS
description:
Summary:

We are seeking a highly motivated QA Engineer responsible for the delivery and execution of tests to ensure seamless operation on the web. The ideal candidate will possess in-depth knowledge of core web technologies, an understanding of web browsers, programming expertise, and proficiency in using web developer tools across different browsers. Initially, the candidate will focus on mastering Maps’ web testing infrastructure—browser internals, development tools, and large-scale web app validation—before progressing to iOS analytics testing. This growth-oriented role emphasizes strong web quality engineering ownership with a pathway to integrated cross-platform (web + iOS) analytics testing. Our team actively conceptualizes, iterates, and executes new features, functioning as one of the few generalist groups in Maps requiring no deep domain expertise.

Start date: January 2027

Duration: Long-term project (12 months contract + potential extension)

Location: Malmö (5 days onsite) + a number of evening meetings

Main Responsibilities:

  • Testing large-scale web applications and formulating clear and comprehensive test scenarios and plans

  • Writing automation tests for web interfaces and potentially iOS apps

  • Executing problem-solving strategies to investigate and debug issues, independently and collaboratively

  • Documenting issues and reporting on the status of features, both current and in-development

  • Adhering to Agile software development methodologies/Scrum for rapid releases

  • Communicating effectively and collaborating across various functions

  • Expanding testing coverage to include iOS analytics and future web analytics

Key Requirements:

  • Hands-on experience with testing large-scale web applications

  • Analytical thinking abilities for constructing test scenarios and plans

  • Expertise in writing automation tests for web and iOS platforms

  • Strong debugging and analytical skills for problem investigation

  • Experience working in Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally

  • Willingness to expand testing focus into iOS analytics and future web analytics

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with iOS XCTests

  • Understanding of network security fundamentals

  • Performance testing experience

  • Familiarity with the Python scripting language

Other Details:

This position is suitable for someone looking to engage in a dynamic, fast-paced environment that involves enhancing the current testing infrastructure and validating web builds and deployments. The role is hands-on, requiring the candidate to take initiative and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

A Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience is preferred.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Azure)
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Your role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer (Azure), you will design and maintain CI/CD environments, build automated deployment pipelines, and support cloud-based infrastructure using Azure services. Your responsibilities will also include creating scripts, testing and documenting solutions, consulting project teams on DevOps automation, and coordinating workstreams in complex delivery initiatives.

You will also contribute to building an AI-ready delivery environment by adopting modern tools and ways of working that improve efficiency, insight and collaboration across engineering teams.

Working with diverse and technically advanced solutions will allow you to build strong relationships with clients and continuously grow your expertise. You will be part of highly self-organizing, independent teams that operate in agile and lean engineering environments, fostering continuous improvement and innovation.

Your project

Cloud & Custom Applications (C&CA) provides comprehensive end-to-end IT services from business specification, through software development and implementation, to application maintenance using leading IT technologies and management methods.

We enthusiastically institute solutions in the fields of DevOps, SRE, broadly understood automation and AI, with a practical focus on improving delivery efficiency, quality and reliability.

Your tasks

  • Design, build and support continuous integration and continuous delivery environments for projects carried out in our department.

  • Create deployment pipelines and scripts, and administer cloud infrastructure using Azure services.

  • Test and document your solutions with a focus on reliability, quality and maintainability.

  • Consult project teams on DevOps automation, cloud operating models and platform engineering practices.

  • Coordinate workstreams and support teams implementing DevOps solutions in complex projects.

  • Enable AI-assisted engineering practices, such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools, and support code reviews for quality, security and maintainability.

  • Support cloud and automation patterns that can be used for AI-enabled delivery, model deployment or modern data-intensive workloads where relevant.

Your profile

  • At least 5 years of experience working with Azure.

  • Master’s, engineer’s or bachelor’s degree.

  • Experience in CI/CD and/or cloud technologies.

  • Knowledge of any scripting language.

  • Leadership, consulting or coordination experience in complex delivery initiatives.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills, minimum B2 English.

  • Experience with Azure services supporting AI/ML workloads, automation, monitoring or secure deployment patterns will be an advantage.

  • Experience with GenAI tools, such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent solutions, or willingness to actively use them to support daily engineering work.

What You'll love about working here

  • Practical benefits: private medical care with Medicover with additional packages (e.g., dental, senior care, oncology) available on preferential terms, life insurance and 40+ options on our NAIS benefit platform, including Netflix, Spotify or Sports card.

  • Access to over 70 training tracks with certification opportunities (e.g., GenAI, Architects, Google) on our NEXT platform. Dive into a world of knowledge with free access to Education First languages platform, TED Talks and Udemy Business materials and trainings.

  • Enjoy hybrid working model that fits your life - after completing onboarding, connect work from a modern office with ergonomic work from home, thanks to home office package (including laptop, monitor, and chair). Ask your recruiter about the details.

  • Community Hub that will allow you to choose from over 20 professional communities that gather people interested in, among others: Salesforce, Java, Could, IoT, Agile, AI.

Get to know us

Capgemini is committed to diversity and inclusion, ensuring fairness in all employment practices. We evaluate individuals based on qualifications and performance, not personal characteristics, striving to create a workplace where everyone can succeed and feel valued.

Do you want to get to know us better? Check our Instagram — @capgeminipl or visit our Facebook profile — Capgemini Polska. You can also find us on YouTube.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
Make it real |

title: Senior Hardware Mechanical Engineer
description:
PROJECT INFORMATION:

  • Industry: Automotive

  • Remuneration: up to 119 PLN/h netto + VAT (B2B)

  • Location: Kraków (4/week)

Introduction & Summary
This position seeks an experienced Senior Hardware Mechanical Engineer with a strong background in automotive electronic hardware design and manufacturing technologies. The ideal candidate will possess at least five years of relevant experience in the automotive industry, demonstrating technical expertise in key areas such as EMC/ESD requirements and thermal systems.

Main Responsibilities
The selected engineer will be responsible for the mechanical design of compute products, ensuring adherence to design specifications and manufacturing processes. Core duties include:

  • Analyze and interpret internal and customer requirements using tools such as Polarion and DOORS.

  • Lead the mechanical design process while collaborating with CAD designers and cross-disciplinary teams.

  • Manage dimensional accuracy to ensure proper assembly and performance, including tolerance stack-up calculations.

  • Participate in the creation of Bill of Materials (BOM).

  • Oversee design activities for Electronic Control Unit (ECU) projects during initial design phases.

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the Automotive Industry, preferably with automotive electronic hardware design.

  • At least 5 years in manufacturing technologies, including sheet metal, die casting, and plastic design.

  • Strong knowledge of design requirements for addressing EMC and ESD issues.

  • Practical understanding of thermal management in electronic head units.

  • Hands-on experience with Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).

  • Proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Polarion and DFMEA methodologies.

  • Familiarity with advanced thermal management technologies.

Other Details
This is an onsite position with a project duration extending into Q4 2026 and Q1 2027.

title: Open Banking Roles
description:
Kim jest H2B Group?

Jesteśmy firmą konsultingową, która pomaga klientom w automatyzacji procesów biznesowych przy pomocy AI, a specjalistom IT rozwijać karierę w modelu B2B. Oferujemy projekty z branż takich jak fintech, medtech, edutech czy automatyka przemysłowa. Dzięki ścisłej współpracy wspieramy rozwój naszych klientów poprzez dostarczanie szybkich i mierzalnych efektów, jednocześnie zapewniając specjalistom IT możliwości rozwoju kariery i zdobywania cennego doświadczenia.

Dlaczego warto z nami współpracować?

Elastyczność - Wybierasz projekty dopasowane do swoich umiejętności i zainteresowań, z możliwością zmiany w ramach naszej firmy lub grupy Euvic, której jesteśmy częścią.

Przejrzystość - Masz jasne zasady współpracy i pełną transparentność wynagrodzenia oraz warunków.

Szybkość działania - Dzięki naszej efektywności szybko znajdziesz lub zmienisz projekt, który idealnie odpowiada Twoim kompetencjom.

Możliwość rozwoju - Pracujesz przy innowacyjnych projektach, rozwijając kluczowe kompetencje i zdobywając cenne doświadczenie.

Rozwijasz karierę w sektorze finansowo-bankowym? Mamy dla Ciebie idealne miejsce. Ze względu na dynamiczny rozwój i współpracę z czołowymi bankami oraz instytucjami finansowymi, poszukujemy doświadczonych specjalistów oraz ekspertów dziedzinowych. Zgłoś się do naszego Talent Poolu – dopasujemy projekt bezpośrednio do Twoich umiejętności i oczekiwań finansowych!

Kogo obecnie poszukujemy? (Rola / Stanowisko):

  • Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst (procesy bankowe, BPMN, UML, API)

  • Data Analyst (SQL, Python/R, BI tools, hurtownie danych)

  • Senior Product Designer (UX/UI dla aplikacji bankowych i FinTech, Figma, Design Systems)

  • Flexcube System Analyst (Core Banking, integracje, parametryzacja systemu)

  • Ekspertów IT / Architektów z doświadczeniem w domenach bankowych (Płatności, Kredyty, Compliance, Risk, CRM)

Wymagania ogólne:

  • Doświadczenie w pracy przy projektach z sektora bankowego, finansowego lub FinTech.

  • Znajomość procesów i specyfiki branżowej (. Core Banking, integracje systemowe, regulacje bankowe, bezpieczeństwo danych).

  • Znajomość standardowych narzędzi w zależności od roli (np. JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Figma, Enterprise Architect).

  • Samodzielność, podejście nastawione na rozwiązywanie problemów i umiejętność pracy w zespole.

  • Dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (min. B2) – praca w środowisku międzynarodowym.

Co oferujemy?

Pracę zdalną - elastyczność, która pozwala pracować z każdego zakątka świata!

Ciekawe projekty - dobierane zgodnie z Twoimi umiejętnościami i zainteresowaniami, dające możliwość pracy nad innowacyjnymi rozwiązaniami.

Umowa B2B bez zapisu o wyłączności - współpracuj z nami na swoich zasadach.

Rozwój zawodowy - praca z najnowszymi technologiami i w zróżnicowanych projektach gwarantuje stały rozwój.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (m/k)
description:
LAW STREAM SP. Z O.O. jest spółką technologiczną, koncentrującą się na automatyzacji i wypracowaniu rozwiązań, które docelowo mają wspomóc ewolucję Spółek z Grupy kapitałowej Votum S.A. z firmy odszkodowawczej o tradycyjnym modelu działania sieci sprzedaży do modelu technologicznego.

Spółka wchodzi w skład Grupy Kapitałowej VOTUM S.A., która posiada ugruntowaną pozycję na rynku, dzięki czemu zapewnia bezpieczeństwo i najwyższą jakość obsługi we wszystkich segmentach prowadzonej przez siebie działalności.

Szukamy doświadczonego DevOps Engineera, który wesprze utrzymanie i rozwój naszej infrastruktury serwerowej oraz usług.

Szukamy osoby mieszkającej we Wrocławiu lub okolicach. Praca jest hybrydowa, ale regularna obecność w biurze jest wymagana: pracujemy z infrastrukturą on-premise, a część zadań i spotkań odbywa się na miejscu.

Zakres obowiązków:

  • projektowaniem, rozwojem i utrzymaniem infrastruktury hybrydowej: serwery Linux (Debian), wirtualizacja VMware,

  • projektowaniem i rozwojem pipeline'ów CI/CD w GitLab CI, standardami release i strategiami wdrożeń,

  • administracją GitLab i GitLab Runnerami,

  • konteneryzacją usług (Docker) i rozwojem środowiska pod workloady kontenerowe

  • budową i rozwojem monitoringu i observability (metryki, logi, alerting),

  • hardeningiem systemów i usług, zarządzaniem sekretami, wdrażaniem zasady least privilege, współpracą przy segmentacji sieci i obsłudze podatności,

  • projektowaniem i regularnym testowaniem backupów oraz procedur Disaster Recovery, w tym kopii odpornych na ransomware,

  • diagnozowaniem złożonych problemów na styku systemów, sieci i aplikacji, obsługą incydentów,

  • współpracą z zespołami developerskimi w zakresie architektury i dobrych praktyk,

  • tworzeniem dokumentacji i standardów oraz dzieleniem się wiedzą w zespole.

Wymagania:

  • min. 5 lat doświadczenia w administracji systemami Linux w środowisku produkcyjnym, w tym min. 2–3 lata w roli DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineer,

  • bardzo dobrej znajomości Linuksa (Debian/Ubuntu), w tym troubleshootingu wydajności, systemu i sieci,

  • doświadczenia z Dockerem w środowisku produkcyjnym,

  • doświadczenia w projektowaniu i utrzymaniu pipeline'ów CI/CD, najlepiej w GitLab CI,

  • doświadczenia z monitoringiem i alertingiem (Zabbix, Prometheus/Grafana lub podobne),

  • znajomości Bash w stopniu pozwalającym na automatyzację,

  • dobrej znajomości sieci: TCP/IP, routing, VLAN, DNS, firewalle, load balancing,

  • praktyki w hardeningu systemów, zarządzaniu dostępami i analizie logów,

  • samodzielności, poczucia odpowiedzialności za swoje obszary i umiejętności jasnej komunikacji, także z osobami nietechnicznymi,

title: Threat Identification & Prioritization
description:
Summary

We are looking for a Cyber Security Consultant to support the organization's security posture through vulnerability management and assessment. The consultant will identify, analyze and prioritize security threats in order to mitigate risks affecting the organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct vulnerability assessments and manage vulnerability remediation processes.

  • Use vulnerability scanning tools to identify security weaknesses.

  • Evaluate the impact and severity of vulnerabilities based on the common threat landscape.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to explain vulnerability risks and business impact.

  • Research and analyze vulnerabilities using public sources and security bulletins.

  • Troubleshoot basic network and connectivity issues.

Must have:

  • Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles and risk management.

  • Proficiency in vulnerability scanning tools (Qualys, Tenable Nessus or similar).

  • Familiarity with CVSS and vulnerability prioritization methodologies.

  • Good grasp of Windows and Linux operating systems.

  • Basic command line skills in Linux and PowerShell.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in security operations or infrastructure support.

  • Familiarity with security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001 or similar).

  • Relevant security certifications (CompTIA Security+ or similar).

Other Details:

  • Work Model: Hybrid - 3 times per week form the office

  • Location: Warsaw, Gdańsk, Gydnia or Łódź

  • Rate: up to 130 pln/h, B2B contract

title: Solution Architect
description:
EXATEL to polski operator telekomunikacyjny i dostawca usług cyberbezpieczeństwa. Zbudowaliśmy drugą co do wielkości sieć światłowodową w Polsce i rozbudowujemy sieć międzynarodową.

EXATEL to nie tylko ponad 23 800 km sieci. To połączenie telekomunikacji z innowacją. Od kilku lat prowadzimy działania R&D w obszarze ICT tworząc własne rozwiązania, takie jak urządzenia sieciowe (SDN) oraz oprogramowanie dla cyberbezpieczeństwa (TAMA- własny antyDDoS). Już dziś świadczymy usługi łączności satelitarnej w oparciu o własny teleport.

Zakres obowiązków:

  • definiowanie architektury rozwiązania, architektury sieci oraz oprogramowania dla systemu SDN (Software Defined Network)

  • nadzór nad techniczną realizacją oraz aktywne tworzenie rozwiązania SDN opartego na własnej platformie sprzętowej

  • analiza wymagań biznesowych oraz ich dekompozycja na zadania dla zespołu wytwórczego

  • wsparcie zespołu wytwórczego w implementacji, integracji i testowaniu oprogramowania

  • zapewnienie wysokiej jakości wytwarzanego oprogramowania i jego zgodności z dobrymi praktykami i standardami (TDD, KISS, SOLID)

  • udział w planowaniu i szacowaniu wyceny prac zwinnego zespołu wytwórczego

  • współpraca z klientami wewnętrznymi w planowaniu rozwoju systemu.

Wymagania:

  • minimum 2-letnie doświadczenie na stanowisku architekta systemowego, oprogramowania lub rozwiązania

  • znajomość technologii SDN

  • doświadczenie w projektowaniu i programowaniu rozwiązań w dowolnym języku wysokopoziomowym

  • dobra znajomość systemu Linux

  • znajomość rozwiązań sieciowych do analizy i generowania ruchu sieciowego

  • poświadczenia bezpieczeństwa lub gotowość do poddania się procedurze.

Mile widziane:

  • doświadczenie w projektach NewIP (SDN+NFV)

  • doświadczenie w projektowaniu i tworzeniu usług RESTowych dla kontrolera ONOS (lub innego)

  • doświadczenie z zakresu konteneryzacji oraz wirtualizacji

  • znajomość OVS, Yang, Karaf

  • doświadczenie w zakresie sieci komputerowych, LAN, WAN,

  • wiedza i doświadczenie w zakresie protokołów: OSPF, BGP, IS-IS oraz OpenFlow

  • doświadczenie w pracy z wykorzystaniem Infrastructure as a Code (preferowany Ansible)

  • doświadczenie z narzędziami CI/CD

  • doświadczenie w pracy w zwinnym zespole (Scrum / Kanban)

Oferujemy:

  • pracę w modelu hybrydowym lub 100% zdalnie

  • umowę o pracę

  • podwyższone koszty uzyskania przychodu

  • premie półroczne

  • elastyczne godziny pracy

  • czas na rozwój własny

  • dostęp do platform szkoleniowych (pluralsight, packtpub, safari)

  • pracę w gronie pasjonatów i profesjonalistów przy użyciu najnowszych technologii

  • możliwość wpływu na kształt projektu, w tym na wybór narzędzi i technologii

  • obserwowanie jak tworzone oprogramowanie ma wpływ na działanie firmy - planujemy, tworzymy i wdrażamy na środowiska testowe i produkcyjne – na własnej infrastrukturze

  • pakiet świadczeń socjalnych (opieka medyczna w tym pakiet stomatologiczny i swoboda leczenia, karnet sportowy)

JAK WYGLĄDA PROCES REKRUTACYJNY?

  • Przeanalizujemy Twoją aplikację

  • Spodziewaj się telefonu od osoby z zespołu HR - Karoliny

  • Kolejny etap to spotkanie techniczne z Karoliną oraz osobą techniczną z Departamentu Rozwiązań R&D

  • Informacja zwrotna niezależnie od decyzji

Jeśli Twoje kompetencje wpisują się w nasze oczekiwania wyślij swoje CV i dołącz do #teamEXATEL 🛰!

title: Senior Golang Software Engineer (Data & Infrastructure)
company: Invia CEE x Travelplanet.pl x Wakacje.pl
description:
Invia x x is one of the largest travel groups in Europe. Every year we help more than 6 million people plan their trips. Behind that sit teams in IT, Product, Data, Marketing, HR, Finance, Sales and Customer Experience, who build the tools and services those travelers use. Whichever team you join, your work shows up in how people plan and experience their holidays.

Your next stop:

Join the team behind Supply Nexus, our group-level booking engine and supply platform. This role leans more toward data, infrastructure, and architecture than pure coding — roughly half your time is hands-on coding and code review, the other half is research and analysis on data structures and how best to process them in code.

What lies ahead on your journey:

  • Split time ~50/50 between coding/code review and research on data structures and processing approaches

  • Maintain and enhance Supply Nexus, including the booking engine

  • Integrate data and systems from across the business into one unified platform

  • Lead the redesign of a legacy service onto a modern platform — from architecture through delivery

  • Import and maintain tour operator data feeds, with a strong focus on availability

  • Process very large files (hundreds of GB) and structure the data into databases at terabyte scale

  • Design indexes for the fastest possible data access

  • Handle basic DevOps: CI/CD, deployment, cloud resource optimization

  • Improve platform performance, scalability, reliability, and observability

  • Build and improve API integrations across all entities

What to pack in your suitcase:

  • 6+ years as a software engineer, including 3/4+ years with Go

  • Proven experience processing large volumes of data at scale

  • Hands-on experience with relational and non-relational databases handling large data volumes

  • Experience processing very large files and structuring data into terabyte-scale databases

  • Experience designing indexes for fast data access

  • Strong, practical SQL

  • Experience with distributed systems and multiple architecture types

  • Solid data structures knowledge

  • REST API and gRPC experience

  • English B2+

  • Strong collaboration and problem-solving skills

  • CI/CD fundamentals and full software delivery lifecycle experience

  • Comfortable navigating legacy codebases

Your extra baggage of experience:

  • Kubernetes

  • Redis (or similar)

  • Kibana, Grafana

What you will find on board:

  • A remote working model, with a commitment to work from the office at least once a quarter

  • Opportunities for professional development aligned with current business needs and your individual career goals,

  • A benefits cafeteria platform – we do not decide what siuts for you, you can choose from life insurance, a sports card, and lunch and shopping vouchers,

  • Cooperation in international environment,

  • Access to Audioteka and Pilot WP, helping you balance personal development with moments of relaxation,

  • An openness to innovation and AI-powered tools that support our daily work and help us achieve even better results,

  • Discounts on our products for you, your family, and friends,

  • Comfortable offices in convenient locations (Gdańsk – Alchemia, Warsaw – Business Garden, Wrocław – Legnicka Business Garden), along with a friendly and informal atmosphere that encourages collaboration,

  • Option to join International educational trips, so you can see the destinations and hotels from our portfolio for yourself,

  • A culture built on trust, open communication, feedback, and appreciation (because the best journeys begin with a great team),

  • Team where #Explore #Engage #Enjoy build our travel mindset.

Get to know us better and see what our everyday journey looks like: Instagram, LinkedIn, Tiktok, Facebook.

title: ETIC, Project Manager - Graduate Program (German Speakers)
description:
Line of Service

Advisory

Industry/Sector

Technology

Specialism

Advisory - Other

Management Level

Intern/Trainee

Job Description & Summary

At PwC, our people in project portfolio management focus on optimising project portfolios to drive strategic business outcomes. These individuals oversee project selection, prioritisation, and resource allocation to facilitate successful project delivery.

In project management at PwC, you will oversee and coordinate various projects to facilitate successful delivery within budget and timeline. You will leverage strong organisational and communication skills to effectively manage teams and stakeholders.

About Us

For our Consulting business unit, we are looking for motivated university graduates from ETIC to join our German team on exciting consulting projects in the area of Portfolio, Program and Project Management (PPM). As part of our Graduate Program, you can expect a structured entry into the world of consulting with extensive training opportunities, a strong international network, and the chance to take on responsibility from day one.


Your Responsibilities – What to Expect

  • Consulting projects: You support digitalization and transformation projects for clients across industries such as Commercial, Financial Services, and the Public Sector – applying both agile and traditional project management approaches as well as modern digital PPM tools.
  • Project management: You contribute to the Project Management Office (PMO) and help ensure transparency on progress, risks, dependencies, and budgets across projects, programs, and portfolios.
  • Methods & frameworks: You work with established methodologies such as Scrum, SAFe, PRINCE2, or classic process models, and apply them together with the team.
  • Personal development: You gain exposure to complex, large-scale projects across a variety of industries and grow professionally through targeted trainings and internationally recognized certifications.
  • Team & business development: You become part of an international team, actively contributing to the growth of our PPM services and expanding your professional network within PwC.


Your Profile – What You Bring

  • You have successfully completed (or are about to complete) your studies in Business Administration/Economics, (Business) Information Technology, (Industrial) Engineering, or a comparable field of study.
  • Ideally, you have already gained some practical experience through internships, working student positions, or thesis work in the areas of project management, PMO, or consulting.
  • You have an interest in project management methodologies (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, PRINCE2, PMI, IPMA) as well as digital PPM tools. Initial certifications are a plus, but not a requirement – we will support you with relevant training as part of our Graduate Program.
  • You are analytically and conceptually strong, work in a structured manner, and enjoy collaborating within a team.
  • Your strong communication skills and confident demeanor help you engage with colleagues and clients on equal footing.
  • Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken, round off your profile. (German at least C1 – this is a mandatory requirement for this role.)


What We Offer

  • Structured career entry through our Graduate Program with clear development perspectives
  • Mentoring from experienced colleagues in our German PPM team
  • Extensive trainings and certifications (e.g. PRINCE2, Scrum, SAFe)
  • International working environment with close collaboration between ETIC and Germany
  • Flexible working arrangements – predominantly remote work
  • Attractive compensation

At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Teacher we will:

  • Invest in you and your career at KinderCare as you create a world-class experience in our classrooms
  • Reward your commitment to our children and families as your journey continues with us

When you join our team as a Teacher you will:

  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Physically able to lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $18.90 - $18.90 Hourly

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.

title: Starszy Programista/Starsza Programistka Oracle
description:
Job Description

Chcesz rozwijać swoją karierę globalnie?

Zaznacz swoją obecność w jednej z największych firm w branży płatności. Poszukujemy Starszego Programisty/Starszej Programistki Oracle , który/a dołączy do naszego dynamicznie rozwijającego się zespołu Zespołu Aplikacji Finansowo-Księgowych w eService i pomoże kształtować przyszłość globalnego handlu.

eService jest liderem rynku akceptacji kart płatniczych i rozliczania transakcji elektronicznych w Polsce, a także największym dostawcą technologii w zakresie usług rozliczeniowych w Europie Środkowo-Wschodniej. Firma działa na rynku od prawie 25 lat i oferuje przedsiębiorcom omnichannelowe rozwiązania płatnicze zarówno dla stacjonarnych i mobilnych punktów usługowo-handlowych, jak i działalności online. W ofercie ma terminale POS i bramki płatnicze dla rozwiązań e-commerce i m-commerce. Firma wspiera promocję płatności bezgotówkowych w małych i średnich przedsiębiorstwach, a także w jednostkach samorządu terytorialnego i instytucjach publicznych.
eService należy do Global Payments Inc. (NYSE: GPN) i PKO Banku Polskiego. Global Payments z siedzibą w Atlancie w stanie Georgia, zatrudnia około 27 000 pracowników na całym świecie, jest spółką z listy Fortune 500® i członkiem S&P 500. Prowadzi działalność o światowym zasięgu obejmującym Amerykę Północną, Europę, Azję i Pacyfik oraz Amerykę Łacińską.

Twoje obowiązki

· projektowanie i rozwój struktur danych oraz procesów przetwarzania danych z wykorzystaniem SQL i PL/SQL

· rozwój i utrzymanie systemów oraz aplikacji opartych o technologie Oracle (Oracle Database, Oracle Forms, Oracle Reports, Oracle BI EE)

· tworzenie interfejsów użytkownika, dokumentacji technicznej oraz udział we wdrażaniu rozwiązań informatycznych

· wsparcie procesu wydawniczego, testów funkcjonalnych oraz zapewnienie wysokiej jakości dostarczanych rozwiązań

· analizę, opiniowanie i szacowanie rozwiązań bazodanowych oraz wsparcie zespołu w rozwiązywaniu problemów technicznych

· współpracę z innymi zespołami oraz realizację zadań wynikających z bieżących potrzeb biznesowych i organizacyjnych

Twoje kompetencje

· minimum 3 lata doświadczenia na podobnym stanowisku związanym z rozwojem aplikacji i baz danych Oracle

· bardzo dobra znajomość Oracle Database (12c i nowsze), Oracle Forms, Oracle Reports oraz języków SQL i PL/SQL

· doświadczenie w projektowaniu i optymalizacji struktur baz danych, analizie oraz refaktoryzacji kodu PL/SQL

· praktyczna znajomość UML, wzorców projektowych oraz środowisk Linux/Unix i hurtowni danych

· umiejętność analitycznego myślenia oraz samodzielnego rozwiązywania problemów technicznych

· znajomość języka angielskiego i polskiego min. na poziomie B2.

O zespole

Nasze inkluzywne i globalne zespoły wspólnie zwyciężają każdego dnia. Jesteśmy dumni, że mamy najlepsze umysły w branży, od których możesz się uczyć, rozwijając swoją karierę. Ludzie, energia, relacje – to wszystko jest bezkonkurencyjne. Dołącz do stale rozwijającej się firmy i zyskaj dynamiczne możliwości wykraczające poza granice.

Co wyróżnia Globalpayera?

Globalpayerzy myślą jak klient, działają jak właściciele i wygrywają jako jeden zespół. Są ciekawi i innowacyjni — zawsze szukają lepszych sposobów na osiąganie rezultatów. Wspieramy się nawzajem w podejmowaniu decyzji, a nasza pasja napędza doskonałość we wszystkim, co robimy.

Czy brzmi to znajomo? W takim razie jesteś Globalpayerem. Aplikuj już teraz i rozwijaj swoją karierę globalnie.

Dodaj LinkedIn #MK

title: Lead Teachers at Spring Street KinderCare
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Lead Teacher you will:

  • Lead, coach and mentor less experienced teachers in your classroom; model behaviors and provide feedback
  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Possess active Child Development Associate (CDA) Credential or meet NAEYC candidacy requirements
  • Approved state trainer (preferred)
  • 2-3 years Early Childhood Education Experience (preferred)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Early Childhood Education (preferred)
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Use a computer, lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Be able to make physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $16.85 - $21.60 Hourly

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.


In the state of Illinois, we currently provide a 15% premium in addition to the range of pay listed to all hourly employees working in a center that participates in the Illinois Smart Start Workforce Grant.

KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

title: Kierownik Działu Service Desk (k/m)
description:
Poszukujemy Kierownika Działu Service Desk do zarządzania 4-5 osobowym zespołem 1. i 2. linii wsparcia.

Osoba na tym stanowisku będzie odpowiedzialna za uporządkowanie i rozwój procesów operacyjnych w oparciu o standardy ITIL 4/5, ze szczególnym naciskiem na automatyzację, rozwój bazy wiedzy oraz tworzenia i utrzymywania dokumentacji zapewniającej ciągłość działania organizacji.

Szukamy lidera, który skutecznie połączy kompetencje managerskie i techniczne, zadba o wysoką jakość świadczonych usług, sprawne funkcjonowanie zespołu oraz efektywny przepływ informacji wewnątrz organizacji.

Zakres obowiązków

Zarządzanie Zespołem i Kolejką Zgłoszeń: Koordynacja pracy zespołu agentów 1. i 2. linii wsparcia, aktywne zarządzanie kolejką ticketów w systemie ITSM, monitorowanie obciążenia pracy oraz merytoryczne wsparcie w rozwiązywaniu złożonych problemów.

Nadzór nad Jakością i SLA: Odpowiedzialność za utrzymanie standardów obsługi, kontrolę wskaźników SLA/KPI, monitorowanie satysfakcji użytkowników (CSAT) oraz reagowanie na odchyłki w jakości pracy zespołu.

Kompleksowe Wsparcie Infrastruktury i Monitoring: Nadzór nad technicznym wsparciem sprzętu i systemów. Proaktywne monitorowanie infrastruktury oraz dbanie o szybką reakcję na alerty, by zapobiegać przestojom.

Zarządzanie Procesami i Przepływem Pracy (ITSM / ITIL): Projektowanie i optymalizacja procesów (Incident/Problem Management), utrzymywanie aktualnej Bazy Wiedzy, katalogu usług oraz dbanie o optymalną konfigurację i automatyzację w systemie zgłoszeniowym. Aktywne promowanie kultury "Self-Service".

Asset Management, Budżet i Zakupy IT: Kompleksowy nadzór nad cyklem życia urządzeń i zgodnością ewidencji w systemach (. MDM). Realizacja zakupów sprzętu oraz stała, rozsądna kontrola kosztów licencji oprogramowania.

Zarządzanie Cyklem Życia Użytkownika (JML): Nadzór nad realizacją technicznej części procesów Onboarding/Offboarding (zarządzanie tożsamością, cykliczna weryfikacja uprawnień i konsekwentne dbanie o zgodność z politykami dostępu).

Utrzymanie Systemów i Nadzór nad Backupami: Administracja wewnętrznymi systemami IT. Nadzór nad poprawnością wykonywania kopii zapasowych (weryfikacja logów, rotacja taśm) oraz czuwanie nad procesem odtwarzania danych.

Współpraca z 3. linią i Zespołem Programistycznym: Nadzór nad wstępną diagnozą, reprodukcją błędów i filtrowaniem zgłoszeń eskalowanych do inżynierów infrastruktury oraz zarządzanie rolą zespołu jako pierwszej linii weryfikacji zgłoszeń dla wewnętrznego zespołu deweloperskiego.

Zarządzanie Kryzysowe i Komunikacja Masowa: Organizacja spotkań Post-Mortem po awariach oraz jasna, przejrzysta komunikacja z biznesem w trakcie incydentów (Major Incident).

Wsparcie Audytów i Cyberbezpieczeństwo: Nadzór nad dostarczaniem raportów i logów do audytów (compliance) oraz wsparcie inicjatyw podnoszących świadomość cyberbezpieczeństwa wśród pracowników.

Projekty Biznesowe i Vendor Management: Reprezentowanie działu w kluczowych wdrożeniach i migracjach IT (Service Transition). Współpraca z zewnętrznymi dostawcami usług i sprzętu oraz procesowanie RMA.

Wymagania

Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu: Minimum 2 lata doświadczenia na stanowisku kierowniczym, liderskim lub koordynacyjnym w obszarze Service Desk / wsparcia IT (zarządzanie zespołem 1. i 2. linii).

Procesy i standardy: Praktyczna znajomość metodyki ITIL (wersja 4/5) oraz doświadczenie w projektowaniu, optymalizowaniu i dokumentowaniu procesów wsparcia (w tym budowa bazy wiedzy i automatyzacja).

Narzędzia ITSM: Biegła znajomość i doświadczenie w pracy z systemami biletowymi klasy ITSM – ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem Jira Service Management (JSM).

Środowisko chmurowe i tożsamość: Dobra znajomość administracji środowiskiem Microsoft 365 oraz zarządzania kontami i uprawnieniami w Entra ID.

Zarządzanie zasobami (Asset Management): Praktyczna znajomość systemów klasy MDM oraz narzędzi do inwentaryzacji sprzętu i oprogramowania.

Zaplecze techniczne i sieciowe: Podstawowa znajomość architektury IT, sieci oraz systemów monitoringu i bezpieczeństwa.

Kompetencje organizacyjne: Zdolności analityczne, umiejętność ustalania priorytetów, dbałość o kompletność dokumentacji oraz wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności komunikacyjne, pozwalające na efektywną współpracę zarówno z zespołem technicznym, jak i z biznesem.

At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Lead Teacher you will:

  • Lead, coach and mentor less experienced teachers in your classroom; model behaviors and provide feedback
  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Possess active Child Development Associate (CDA) Credential or meet NAEYC candidacy requirements
  • Approved state trainer (preferred)
  • 2-3 years Early Childhood Education Experience (preferred)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Early Childhood Education (preferred)
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Use a computer, lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Be able to make physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $16.85 - $21.60 Hourly

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.


In the state of Illinois, we currently provide a 15% premium in addition to the range of pay listed to all hourly employees working in a center that participates in the Illinois Smart Start Workforce Grant.

KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

title: Software Architect – Android IVI (Automotive)
description:
Introduction & Summary:

We are seeking a skilled Software Architect specializing in Android IVI within the automotive sector, requiring 8-10 years of extensive experience. Candidates must possess a minimum of 6 years in Automotive Infotainment, Android IVI, BSP, or Embedded Systems. This role focuses on defining and delivering a comprehensive Android IVI software architecture.

Main Responsibilities:

- Define, design, and own the end-to-end Android IVI software architecture.

  • Architect solutions for Android A12 / A14 / A16-based IVI platforms.
  • Drive architectural decisions for Audio, Media, HMI, Connectivity, Telephony, Vehicle I/O, and BSP subsystems.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to develop key IVI features.
  • Create high-level and low-level architecture documents and interface specifications.
  • Optimize boot time, device bring-up, and platform stability.

Key Requirements:

  • 8-10 years total experience.
  • Minimum 6 years in Automotive Infotainment, Android IVI, BSP, or Embedded Systems.
  • Expertise in AIDL / HIDL, binder IPC, vendor services.
  • Experience with Android A12, A14, A16, CTS/VTS.
  • Familiarity with Audio framework, connectivity stacks, and Linux kernel internals.

Nice to Have:

  • Strong analytical and architectural thinking.
  • Ability to mentor and lead teams.
  • Experience with OEM/Tier-1 infotainment delivery.

Other Details:

This position offers an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, innovative environment within the automotive industry, focused on cutting-edge technology and solutions for vehicle infotainment systems.

title: Specjalista ds. cyberbezpieczeństwa (K/M/X)
description:
W Mednow technologia nie jest jedynie wsparciem - to fundament przyszłości e-zdrowia. Jako podmiot wspierający procesy rekrutacyjne, poszukujemy dla Mednow osoby na stanowisko Specjalisty ds. Cyberbezpieczeństwa (K/M/X) z doświadczeniem w obszarze GRC, zarządzania ryzykiem lub pracy w strukturach SOC, która realnie wpłynie na odporność cybernetyczną organizacji.

Mednow to innowacyjny gracz na rynku medycznym, wierzący, że nowoczesne narzędzia są kluczem do lepszej opieki nad pacjentem. Systemy spółki obsługują miesięcznie setki tysięcy pacjentów oraz ponad 300 placówek medycznych. Rola ta wiąże się ze stałą ochroną danych tysięcy użytkowników - od wdrażania grupowych Security Frameworków, przez analizę podatności (OpenVAS, NESSUS) i wsparcie w audytach (ISO 27001, NIS2), aż po wdrażanie zasad Security & Privacy by Design oraz obsługę incydentów.

Jeśli znajomość standardów OWASP, wymogów regulacyjnych (MDR, ROSO, AI Act) oraz wysokie umiejętności analityczne to Twoje mocne strony i szukasz miejsca, gdzie wiedza ekspercka realnie przełoży się na bezpieczeństwo w organizacji o dużym znaczeniu społecznym - zapraszamy do aplikowania!

Profil stanowiska

  • Wykształcenie wyższe - kierunkowe (informatyka, kryptologia, cyberbezpieczeństwo)

  • Co najmniej 2 lata doświadczenia w obszarze zarządzania cyberbezpieczeństwem, zarządzania ryzykiem w bezpieczeństwie systemów IT lub pracy w Security Operation Center

  • Znajomość frameworków bezpieczeństwa (OWASP TOP 10, OWASP ASVS)

  • Podstawowa znajomość narzędzi do zarządzania podatnościami (Greenbone OpenVAS, Tenable NESSUS)

  • Umiejętności analityczne (analiza logów, analiza podatności zgłoszonych w ramach testów, analiza zabezpieczeń proponowanych przez Product Managerów)

  • Mile widziane

    • Umiejętności przywódcze - celem umiejętnego egzekwowania wdrożenia poprawek bezpieczeństwa po zleconych pentestach

    • Samodzielność i decyzyjność - w komunikacji z podmiotami zewnętrznymi - jak CERT NASK, CERT CeZ

    • Znajomość wymagań prawnych w obszarze wytwarzania oprogramowania dla sektora ochrony zdrowia (MDR, ROSO, AI Act)

    • Akredytowany certyfikat audytora wiodącego ISO 27001 lub ISO 22301

Twoje zadania

  • Zgodność i standardy: Wdrażanie, rozwój i monitorowanie zgodności z grupowym Security Framework oraz wymogami prawnymi (. RODO)

  • Audyty i dokumentacja: Wsparcie w audytach wewnętrznych i zewnętrznych (np. ISO 27001, NIS2) oraz opracowywanie i aktualizacja polityk, procedur i standardów bezpieczeństwa

  • Projekty IT i analiza ryzyka: Udział w projektach IT (Security/Privacy by Design), prowadzenie analiz ryzyka oraz monitorowanie działań je ograniczających

  • Testy i podatności: Nadzór nad realizacją rekomendacji po testach penetracyjnych, testach podatności oraz audytach

  • Współpraca i incydenty: Współpraca z zespołami deweloperskimi, infrastrukturą, dostawcami oraz podmiotami zewnętrznymi; wsparcie w obsłudze incydentów i analizie ich przyczyn

  • Edukacja i raportowanie: Prowadzenie szkoleń i kampanii phishingowych dla pracowników oraz przygotowywanie raportów poziomu bezpieczeństwa dla Zarządu i Grupy

Dla Ciebie

  • Elastyczny, hybrydowy tryb pracy (60% pracy zdalnej i 40% pracy z naszego krakowskiego biura)

  • Pakiet benefitów, obejmujący . prywatną opiekę medyczną Allianz oraz dostęp do platformy kafeteryjnej

  • Stabilna praca w perspektywicznej branży łączącej technologie z ochroną zdrowia w międzynarodowej grupie TSS

title: Business Analyst (Product Discovery Lead)
description:
💻 Business Analyst (Product Discovery Lead)

💰 B2B, salary range flexible

🌍 Part-time position

We are looking for an open-minded, commercially savvy Business Analyst to take the lead on the product inception phase (Product Discovery & Inception) across our client projects. We need a true partner for our clients who asks the right questions, challenges assumptions, and helps define products that deliver real market value.

In this role, you will blend business curiosity, strong interpersonal skills, and solid analytical craftsmanship. You will serve as the primary point of contact for clients during the initial phase of shaping a system's vision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and facilitate interactive workshops with clients.

  • Clarify goals, establish KPIs, and define the Minimum Viable Product (MVP).

  • Convert business needs into Epics, User Stories, and a structured backlog.

  • Create BPMN/UML diagrams, User Journey Maps, and low-fidelity wireframes.

  • Partner with Architects and developers to validate the feasibility of proposed solutions.

  • Manage expectations and maintain clear communication throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Product Owner, with a proven track record of leading product discovery workshops.

  • Experience working in an IT consultancy or software agency environment.

  • Strong business mindset focused on ROI, market value, and end-user needs, rather than just software features.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to confidently guide and align C-level stakeholders.

  • Solid analytical toolkit: Proficiency in Agile frameworks, BPMN, User Stories, and tools like Jira, Confluence, and Miro/Mural.

  • Fluent English (C1+) for seamless client facilitation and negotiations.

Nice to Have

  • Practical experience in organizing, facilitating, or participating in Design Sprints.

  • Familiarity with Event Storming, Value Proposition Canvas, or Design Thinking.

  • Industry certifications (e.g., IIBA, PSPO, AgilePM).

  • Basic understanding of software architecture, APIs, and databases.

title: Business Analyst (Capital Markets)
description:
WHO ARE WE?

WE ARE A WORLD LEADER IN ENGINEERING AND IT SERVICES.

At ALTEN, we see our specialists as architects – today’s designers of tomorrow’s world.

As a leader in Engineering and IT Services, we support a company in their technological and sustainable transformation.

OVER 57,400 EMPLOYEES IN 30+ COUNTRIES, TO SUPPORT MORE THAN 6,500 CLIENTS WORLDWIDE.

We operate in all sectors: Aeronautics, Space, Defence, Security & Naval, Automotive, Rail & Mobility, Energy & Environment, Life Sciences & Health, Industrial Equipment & Electronics, Telecoms, Banking, Finance & Insurance, Retail, Services & Medias, Public Services & Government.

We carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies worldwide.

Our motto: Building Tomorrow’s World Today!

Role description

  • Analyse current business processes, workflows, rules and operating models.

  • Map current-state processes, applications, integrations and data flows.

  • Document business requirements, functional gaps and country-specific variations.

  • Compare current solutions with the target architecture and identify required changes.

  • Facilitate workshops with business SMEs, operations teams and application teams.

  • Drive gap analysis between current and target processes.

  • Transform findings into structured requirements, user stories and solution recommendations.

  • Support definition of target processes and operating models.

  • Work closely with Solution Architects and application teams to validate feasibility of proposed solutions.

  • Support impact assessments across Order Management, Trade Processing, Settlement and Safekeeping domains.

  • Document decisions, assumptions, dependencies and risks.

  • Prepare material for architecture reviews, governance forums and programme stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Strong business analysis and process mapping experience.

  • Ability to analyse complex operational workflows and business processes.

  • Experience gathering and documenting requirements from multiple stakeholder groups.

  • Experience facilitating workshops and interviews.

  • Understanding of stock trading lifecycles.

  • Knowledge of post-trade processes, safekeeping and account structures is highly desirable.

  • Experience working with regulatory or market-driven change initiatives is beneficial.

  • Able to understand application landscapes, integrations and data flows.

  • Comfortable working with Solution Architects and technical teams.

  • Understanding of APIs, interfaces and system interactions.

  • Able to bridge business and technology discussions.

  • Fluent business English is a must (both written and spoken)

We offer:

  • We offer a full-time employment contract

  • Location - Warsaw/Gdańsk/Łódź, work model - hybrid

  • Stable and long-term cooperation

  • Well-defined career path at the European leader in engineering & IT consulting

  • Opportunity to relocate and work in different ALTEN Polska branches

  • After project completion, opportunity to engage in subsequent projects within the company

  • Introduction and cooperation with a dedicated Competences Manager

Benefits:

  • Medicover medical care

  • Medicover dental care

  • Medicover Benefits platform

  • Medicover Sport card

  • Referral Program

  • Layette for a newborn employee’s child

  • Group life insurance

  • Pension scheme

We also offer cooperation based on a B2B or Contract of mandate (UZ).

We also guarantee:

  • Access to professional certifications with our technology partners (e.g., Google, ISTQB)

  • Access to relevant industry events

  • Access to the Knowledge Sharing Program

  • Access to the Referral Program

Do not hesitate and join our team!

title: DevOps Engineer (with German)
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Your role

As a DevOps Engineer, you will design and maintain CI/CD environments, automate deployment processes, and support cloud and on-prem infrastructure for ongoing projects. You will develop pipelines, create scripts, and ensure high quality by testing and documenting your solutions.

Your German language skills will help you collaborate effectively with stakeholders and project teams. In your daily work, you will also use modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted solutions where they help streamline automation, troubleshooting and documentation tasks.

Working with diverse and technically advanced solutions will allow you to build strong relationships with clients and continuously grow your expertise. You will be part of highly self-organizing, independent teams that operate in agile and lean engineering environments, fostering continuous improvement and innovation.

Your project

Cloud & Custom Applications (C&CA) provides comprehensive end-to-end IT services from business specification, through software development and implementation, to application maintenance using leading IT technologies and management methods.

We enthusiastically institute solutions in the fields of DevOps, SRE, broadly understood automation and AI, with a practical focus on improving delivery efficiency, quality and reliability.

Your tasks

  • Design, build and support continuous integration and continuous delivery environments for projects carried out in our department.

  • Create deployment pipelines and scripts, and administer virtual machines on cloud platforms and on-prem environments.

  • Test and document your solutions with a focus on quality, reliability and maintainability.

  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools, such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent solutions, to improve productivity, documentation quality and delivery efficiency where appropriate.

  • Support automation and platform improvements that can enable AI-assisted delivery practices in project teams.

Your profile

  • Master’s, engineer’s or bachelor’s degree.

  • At least 2 years of experience in CI/CD and/or cloud technologies.

  • Knowledge of Linux system administration.

  • Knowledge of any scripting language.

  • German language skills at minimum B2 level.

  • Openness to using AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly in daily DevOps work.

  • Basic familiarity with AI/ML workloads, cloud automation or modern platform engineering concepts will be an advantage.

What You'll love about working here

  • Practical benefits: private medical care with Medicover with additional packages (e.g., dental, senior care, oncology) available on preferential terms, life insurance and 40+ options on our NAIS benefit platform, including Netflix, Spotify or Sports card.

  • Access to over 70 training tracks with certification opportunities (e.g., GenAI, Architects, Google) on our NEXT platform. Dive into a world of knowledge with free access to Education First languages platform, TED Talks and Udemy Business materials and trainings.

  • Enjoy hybrid working model that fits your life - after completing onboarding, connect work from a modern office with ergonomic work from home, thanks to home office package (including laptop, monitor, and chair). Ask your recruiter about the details.

  • Community Hub that will allow you to choose from over 20 professional communities that gather people interested in, among others: Salesforce, Java, Could, IoT, Agile, AI.

Get to know us

Capgemini is committed to diversity and inclusion, ensuring fairness in all employment practices. We evaluate individuals based on qualifications and performance, not personal characteristics, striving to create a workplace where everyone can succeed and feel valued.

Do you want to get to know us better? Check our Instagram — @capgeminipl or visit our Facebook profile — Capgemini Polska. You can also find us on YouTube.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
Make it real |

title: Commercial Relationship Specialist
location: Fort Lauderdale, FL - Ft Lauderdale Office
description:
Thank you for your interest in a career at Regions. At Regions, we believe associates deserve more than just a job. We believe in offering performance-driven individuals a place where they can build a career --- a place to expect more opportunities. If you are focused on results, dedicated to quality, strength and integrity, and possess the drive to succeed, then we are your employer of choice.

Regions is dedicated to taking appropriate steps to safeguard and protect private and personally identifiable information you submit. The information that you submit will be collected and reviewed by associates, consultants, and vendors of Regions in order to evaluate your qualifications and experience for job opportunities and will not be used for marketing purposes, sold, or shared outside of Regions unless required by law. Such information will be stored in accordance with regulatory requirements and in conjunction with Regions’ Retention Schedule for a minimum of three years. You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system.

Job Description:

At Regions, the Commercial Relationship Specialist provides general administrative support to Relationship Managers within Commercial Banking to include Commercial Banking and/or specialized business segments of Agricultural Banking (AG), Government and Institutional Banking (GIB), Small Business Administration (SBA), and Franchise Lending.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Assists Relationship Manager(s) by performing daily support activities related to client relationships and keeps respective Relationship Manager informed when appropriate
  • Acts as a point of contact for Commercial Banking clients for all servicing requests related to client relationships
  • Attends weekly scheduled meetings with Relationship Manager(s) to discuss workflow items such as renewals, new pipeline items, servicing requests, past due reports, etc.
  • Provides reports for Relationship Manager(s) such as 360 Report, Weekly Sales Report, OneView Pipeline Report, Maturities, Past Due and Exception Reporting
  • Facilitates and manages credit application workflow as it applies to the appropriate credit channel including collecting financial information from clients, submitting facility applications and managing loan workflows to closing
  • Manages post-closing requirements including tickler requirements and exception citing's
  • Manages Relationship Manager(s) loan maturity pipeline, ensuring that renewals are approved and closed in a timely manner
  • Acts as a liaison between Credit Products and the Commercial Team with both underwriting and loan fulfillment processes and procedures and manages due diligence requirements from the field
  • Assists Relationship Manager(s) with sales support functions to include marketing requests, client and prospect presentations and building prospect information files
  • Opens new deposit products for clients
  • Works closely with the Treasury Management team to successfully onboard new Treasury Management clients as well as provide the clients with guidance and aid in locating appropriate resources for servicing
  • Maintains consistent data integrity for relationship team’s client accounts within all source systems
  • Maintains OneView administrative data to include updating client contact information, merging client records, managing pipeline reports for renewals and creating prospect/centers of influence (COIs) records
  • Manages data organization within Relationship Grouping Application (RGA) to ensure client records are properly grouped for accurate 360 reporting
  • Provides support if assigned for clients in specialized business segments such as GIB, SBA, AG, and Capital Markets within Commercial Banking
  • Supports Relationship Manager(s) with miscellaneous administrative tasks as assigned
  • May serve as a mentor for new associates

This position requires the tracking of time and is eligible for overtime for hours worked in excess of 40 per week under the Fair Labor Standards Act.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of banking or client support experience
  • Or High School Diploma or GED and three (3) years of general banking experience

Preferences

  • College degree

Skills and Competencies

  • Ability to partner with various internal partners across the organization
  • Ability to research, analyze data and derive facts
  • Advanced verbal, written communication, and organizational skills
  • Advanced work ethic and self-motivation
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

This position may be filled at a higher level depending on the candidate’s qualifications and relevant experience.

Position Type

Full time

As these factors vary by individuals, pay will also vary among individual associates within the same job.
