title: Senior Software Python Engineer
description:
• Work mode - fully remote.

  • Assignment type: B2B

  • Start - 01.09.2026.

  • Contract length > 10-12 months + extensions.

  • Language - English.

  • Industry - pharmaceutical.

  • Recruitment process - 2 interviews with the client.

  • Workload: Full time.

This role is for a Senior Software Engineer – Knowledge Graph, responsible for maintaining data quality, integration, and development of the knowledge graph platform, a vital asset that consolidates diverse drug discovery and gene biology data.

Responsibilities:

  • Own data quality: Define and enforce data validation, provenance tracking, and quality metrics across all data sources in the graph.

  • Integrate data sources: Collaborate with internal and external data providers to ingest, normalize, and harmonize heterogeneous biomedical datasets.

  • Maintain the knowledge graph: Manage the Neo4j schema, data modeling, and pipeline reliability.

  • Prepare data for AI/analytics: Ensure graph data supports AI and analytics use cases, including the Blindspot Analysis.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with research scientists, data scientists, and engineers to align scientific needs with reliable data solutions.

Must Haves:

  • Strong Python skills for data engineering and pipeline development.

  • Hands-on experience with Neo4j (Cypher, schema design, query optimization).

  • Proven experience integrating multiple heterogeneous biomedical data sources.

  • Deep understanding of data quality practices in production environments.

  • Experience resolving schema, identifier, and consistency issues directly with data providers.

  • Familiarity with biomedical standards and identifiers (UniProt, Ensembl, ChEMBL, etc.).

  • Strong communication skills with cross-functional scientific and technical teams.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in pharma, biotech, or academic drug discovery.

  • Advanced degree (MSc/PhD) in a relevant field.

  • Familiarity with graph ML, embeddings, or search/retrieval concepts.

title: Module Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Job Description

Role and Impact

Join Intel Wafer Packaging Manufacturing WPM C4 Ireland as a Module Engineer, and play a key role in advancing one of Intel most important manufacturing operations.


Wafer Packaging Manufacturing is a critical part of semiconductor production, where processed silicon wafers are transformed through advanced processes such as bumping and interconnect formation. These steps enable chips to be electrically connected into packages and final products. It is a highly technical, process driven environment.


C4 sits at the center of this capability, directly supporting product delivery, factory output, and customer commitments. As we scale, our focus is on building strong, high performing processes that consistently deliver for our customers across safety, quality, and output.


This is a hands on role in a highly automated fab, working closely with technicians, engineers, and global partners. It follows a hybrid working model, with a minimum of 4 days per week on site, reflecting the importance of direct engagement with tools, processes, and teams.


You will collaborate across a global Virtual Factory network, across Ireland, Oregon, and New Mexico, to share best practices and drive alignment, with a direct impact on process capability, technology ramps, and overall customer experience.


Why Join WPM C4 Ireland?

  • Real impact, your work directly enables product delivery and customer success.
  • Quality focused culture, with strong emphasis on disciplined execution and continuous improvement.
  • One factory mindset, working across a globally connected manufacturing network.
  • Exposure to advanced wafer bumping and packaging technologies.
  • Strong ownership, and opportunity to drive visible improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own module performance across safety, quality, output, and equipment metrics.
  • Sustain and optimize processes to ensure stable, repeatable, high quality output.
  • Use data and statistical methods to reduce variation and strengthen process control.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve robustness and performance.
  • Partner with 24 by 7 technician teams to rapidly contain and resolve issues.
  • Lead structured problem solving across cross functional teams.
  • Collaborate with the Virtual Factory to align standards and deploy best practices.
  • Support technology ramps, tool installs, and high volume manufacturing transitions.
  • Work with suppliers to improve tool capability and reliability.
  • Reinforce a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What You Will Bring?

  • Strong analytical and problem solving capability.
  • Experience in manufacturing or technical environments.
  • Ability to collaborate and influence across teams.
  • Semiconductor experience is an advantage.
  • Results driven mindset, with a focus on consistency and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like?

  • Stable and high performing processes, delivering consistent results.
  • Improved process capability and reduced variation.
  • Strong execution of ramps into volume manufacturing.
  • Effective collaboration across global partners.
  • Contribution to a culture focused on doing things right, every time.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Candidate must have a minimum of a Level 8 qualification, as per the National Framework of Qualifications NFQ, in an approved Science or Engineering discipline.. E.G: Bachelor degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM discipline.
  • 1+ years experience with a Bachelor degree, or completion of a Master degree in semiconductor or advanced manufacturing environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving capability, with experience using data to support decisions.
  • Familiarity with statistical process control, data analysis tools such as JMP or SQL, and structured problem solving methods.
  • Understanding of semiconductor processes, equipment, or similar high volume manufacturing systems.
  • Foundation in process control, process improvement, and process characterization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot issues with pace and ownership.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across teams.
  • Experience with data analysis, data mining, or advanced analytics techniques.
  • Hands on experience supporting or improving manufacturing processes or technologies.
  • Track record of driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Motivation to deliver consistent, high quality results, and build reliable, scalable processes.

Other Considerations

  • Willingness to travel on assignment for varying durations, should a business need arise.

What We Will Offer You

  • Extensive training and hands on practical experience, working with some of the smartest people in the world.
  • Opportunities to put forward your ideas and improvements, and make a difference globally within Intel.
  • Competitive benefits and pay, including quarterly and annual bonuses, and stock.
  • Healthcare and pension.
  • 25 days annual leave.
  • Onsite bank, gym, canteens, dental, opticians, EV charging, Grafton Rooms, games areas, and sports and social clubs.
  • Opportunities to volunteer in the community.
  • Hybrid working arrangement.

Job Type:

Experienced Hire

Shift:

Shift 1 (Ireland)

Primary Location:

Ireland, Leixlip

Additional Locations:

Posting Statement:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.

Position of Trust

N/A

EU Salary

We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry.

Annual Salary Range for this job which could be performed in Ireland is: €49,300.00 - €77,000.00

The compensation range displayed in this posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for this position. Within this range, individual pay is determined by job related skills, experience, and relevant education, training. As part of our total compensation approach, the final offer may include additional pay components and benefits. Your recruiting team will share the confirmed base salary along with any applicable total compensation elements upon employment offer delivery.

Work Model for this Role

This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change.

title: AWS Platform Engineer (Retail)
description:
BlueSoft to innowacyjny Software House należący do Grupy Orange. Mamy wewnętrzną filozofię – tworzenie prostych i skutecznych rozwiązań dla skomplikowanych problemów. Powstaliśmy w 2002 roku i obecnie pracuje z nami już ponad 1000 osób znających przeszło 200 technologii!

BlueSoft może wymagać weryfikacji tożsamości za pomocą kodu QR w aplikacji mObywatel na poszczególnych etapach rekrutacji oraz nawiązywania współpracy.

Opis projektu:

  • Długoterminowy projekt.

Twoja rola w zespole:

  • Projektowanie i implementacja platform GenAI / AI Agent Platform,

  • Implementacja, wdrożenie i utrzymanie rozwiązania,

  • Przygotowanie infrastruktury jako kodu w Terraform,

  • Projektowanie mechanizmów IAM, izolacji workloadów, secrets management i komunikacji sieciowej,

  • Implementacja mechanizmów observability, auditowania i monitoringu,

  • Współpraca z zespołami Security, Cloud Platform i klientem przy projektowaniu architektury,

  • Przygotowanie rozwiązania do wdrożenia na wielu kontach AWS i dla wielu zespołów.

Wymagania:

  • Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w obszarze Cloud / DevOps / Platform Engineering, w tym minimum 3 lata doswiadczenia z AWS i/lub EKS,

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość AWS, EKS / Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD (Github)

  • Doświadczenie z narzędziami GenAI / AI coding agents:

    • praktyczna znajomość Claude Code lub podobnych agentów codingowych,

    • znajomość ekosystemu agentowego, w szczególności MCP, gateway/proxy, observability oraz mechanizmów bezpieczeństwa

  • Angielski: swobodna komunikacja w języku angielskim, również w bezpośredniej współpracy z klientem.

Co zyskujesz dołączając do BlueSoft:

👨‍💻 Współpracę w zespole interdyscyplinarnych ekspertów – entuzjastów technologii, ceniących bezpośredniość i partnerskie relacje.
📈 Długoterminowe zaangażowanie projektowe w firmie, która nieprzerwanie od ponad 20 lat rozwija się na rynku IT.
🚀 Udział w różnorodnych projektach IT realizowanych dla rozpoznawalnych klientów – liderów w swoich branżach.
🥇 Dostęp do najnowszych technologii i środowisko oparte na najwyższych standardach inżynieryjnych.
⌚️ Elastyczne warunki realizacji usług – hybrydowo lub w pełni zdalnie, dopasowane indywidualnie do charakteru współpracy.
☁ Ekosystem wymiany wiedzy i rozwoju: szkolenia wewnętrzne, gildie tematyczne, szkolenia i certyfikacje Cloud w ramach partnerstw technologicznych z czterema dostawcami chmury.
📣 Dostęp do nauki języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego online oraz grupowe zajęcia językowe.
🏋️‍♂️ Możliwość przystąpienia do Multisport i prywatnej opieki medycznej na preferencyjnych warunkach wynegocjowanych przez BlueSoft.
⛵️ Morskie przygody – rejsy po Morzu Karaibskim, Śródziemnym i Północnym z dofinansowaniem ze strony BlueSoft.

title: Senior Functional Consultant
description:
Project details :
B2B
Remote with cccasional on-site visits to Bucharest
Long-term - Min 12 months


Summary

The role of the Senior Functional Consultant is to lead critical efforts in translating complex country-specific operations into efficient and sustainable functional solutions as part of a large-scale international POS rollout program. This position ensures that the solutions are seamlessly integrated within the existing POS system architecture.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead functional discovery activities for country rollouts, including the analysis of local checkout processes, fiscal requirements, payment methods, integrations, and operational constraints.

  • Provide functional leadership during discovery, solution design, implementation, testing, and rollout phases.

  • Analyze complex country-specific requirements and assess their impact on the standard POS solution and surrounding system landscape.

  • Promote and safeguard the adoption of the global standard solution.

  • Challenge local deviations and customization requests where existing platform capabilities or standardized processes can be used.

  • Identify, assess, document, and validate functional gaps between country requirements and the standard solution.

  • Distinguish genuine legal, fiscal, operational, and business-critical gaps from local preferences or non-essential deviations.

  • Cluster and categorize gaps to support prioritization, solution governance, and architectural decision-making.

  • Translate business requirements into detailed functional designs, solution concepts, process flows, system behavior, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

  • Define how country-specific requirements can be implemented within the capabilities and constraints of the existing POS environment.

  • Evaluate functional solution options and provide recommendations based on feasibility, maintainability, scalability, standardization, and business value.

  • Act as the senior functional interface between country stakeholders, discovery squads, product teams, solution architects, engineering squads, integration teams, and rollout teams.

  • Explain complex retail and POS processes to technical teams and explain system capabilities and constraints to business stakeholders.

  • Support engineering squads during technical solution design and implementation by providing functional guidance and clarifying expected system behavior.

  • Review technical solution proposals from a functional perspective and ensure alignment with business requirements and the standard solution.

  • Support the design of POS-related integrations, particularly in the areas of payments, EFT, fiscalization, peripherals, and connected retail systems.

  • Provide functional input for rollout planning, dependency management, and prioritization decisions.

  • Support root cause analysis for complex country-specific defects, production issues, and rollout problems.

  • Identify sustainable solutions that address root causes while minimizing country-specific customization and long-term complexity.

  • Define or review functional test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and end-to-end process validations.

  • Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect analysis, and go-live readiness activities.

  • Maintain high-quality documentation of requirements, functional designs, decisions, assumptions, dependencies, and end-to-end functional flows.

  • Mentor Business Analysts and less experienced functional team members where required.

Requirments:

  • At least 8 years of relevant professional experience as a Functional Consultant, Senior Business Analyst, or in a comparable role.

  • Extensive experience working with complex software systems, preferably in an international retail or store technology environment.

  • Deep functional knowledge of retail, checkout, and POS systems.

  • Strong understanding of POS processes, system behavior, functional components, integrations, and operational dependencies.

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end retail processes, particularly checkout, sales transactions, returns, discounts, promotions, receipts, cash management, and store operations.

  • Extensive experience translating complex business requirements into detailed functional solution designs.

  • Proven ability to assess requirements against existing platform capabilities and identify appropriate standard or customized solutions.

  • Strong experience identifying, analyzing, and managing functional gaps in template-based implementation or rollout programs.

  • Experience working with fiscal, legal, and regulatory requirements affecting POS systems.

  • Strong understanding of functional integration patterns and dependencies within a POS ecosystem.

  • Experience conducting and leading discovery workshops, solution design sessions, and stakeholder interviews.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root cause analysis for complex functional and operational issues.

  • Ability to evaluate solution options and make well-founded recommendations based on business value, technical feasibility, scalability, and maintainability.

  • Strong documentation skills, including functional specifications, process flows, business rules, system behavior, and acceptance criteria.

  • Experience working closely with product managers, solution architects, engineering teams, integration teams, and QA teams.

  • Strong experience in Agile software delivery and international rollout environments.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with both senior business stakeholders and technical teams.

  • Very good English communication skills, both written and verbal.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in large-scale international POS transformation or rollout programs.

  • Deep understanding of country-specific fiscalization requirements and associated technical constraints.

  • Experience with fiscal devices, fiscal services, transaction reporting, electronic receipts, or tax authority integrations.

  • Strong understanding of payment systems, payment methods, payment terminals, and EFT integrations.

  • Experience with POS peripherals and related integrations, such as printers, scanners, scales, cash drawers, and payment terminals.

  • Understanding of integrations between POS systems and surrounding platforms, such as ERP, pricing, promotion, inventory, master data, loyalty, or order management systems.

  • Experience with template governance, localization, and global-versus-local solution decisions.

  • Experience supporting system integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, hypercare, and production stabilization.

  • Experience mentoring Business Analysts or junior Functional Consultants.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Kim jesteśmy i co robimy?

Jesteśmy grupą ponad 130 doświadczonych specjalistów z 5-10-letnim stażem w tworzeniu oprogramowania 🚀🧑‍💻

Robimy rzeczy z sensem, twardo stąpamy po ziemi, rozwijamy się i wspieramy, a dzięki wysokiej jakości naszej pracy z łatwością pozyskujemy nowych klientów.

Pracujemy zdalnie. Przede wszystkim z szybko rozwijającymi się, ambitnymi firmami z zagranicy - USA, Izrael i inne kraje.

Nie jesteśmy tylko Software House'em - pełnimy także rolę partnera i doradcy w procesie budowy produktu. Dzięki naszemu biznesowemu know-how wiemy, jak tworzyć rozwiązania, które odnoszą sukces, i dzielimy się tą wiedzą z naszymi klientami.

Pracujemy w krótkich, dynamicznych iteracjach, aby na bieżąco weryfikować założenia biznesowe. Na każdym etapie projektu komunikujemy się proaktywnie, dbając o pełną przejrzystość współpracy.

Jedną z naszych największych wartości jest różnorodność - u nas nie ma miejsca na rutynę! Dołączając do zespołu, zyskasz możliwość pracy nad wieloma projektami z różnych branż i domen.

Na stanowisko DevOps Engineer szukamy osoby, która z pasją zapewnia stabilne, zautomatyzowane i skalowalne środowiska w chmurze - przede wszystkim AWS, ale nasze projekty żyją też na Azure, GCP i Cloudflare.

Szukamy kogoś mega ogarniętego i samodzielnego - osoby, która bierze temat end-to-end i dowozi, a nie odbija problem dalej.

Pracujemy AI-native i traktujemy to poważnie. Nie chodzi o wklejanie kodu do czatu - chodzi o realne używanie narzędzi: agenci (Claude Code i podobni) spięci z Twoim terminalem i repo, automatyzacja operacji i pipeline'ów, pisanie własnych skryptów, skilli i runbooków, integracje przez CLI / API / MCP.

U nas AI ma robić robotę, nie podpowiadać snippety.

Jeśli tak już pracujesz - świetnie. Jeśli jeszcze nie, ale masz szczerą chęć nauk - szukamy jej u kogoś z dużym, wszechstronnym doświadczeniem, najlepiej przepracowanym na wielu różnych stanowiskach i w różnych rolach. Taka osoba łapie nowe narzędzia błyskawicznie i to jej ufamy, że nadrobi resztę.

Zapraszamy zarówno na full-time, jak i part-time - od części etatu da się u nas zacząć.

Tło techniczne

  • wieloletnie doświadczenie w pracy z infrastrukturą chmurową AWS - projektowanie, wdrażanie i operacje usług takich jak EC2, S3, VPC, Lambda, RDS itp.

  • praktyczna znajomość Infrastructure as Code (IaC) - Terraform, CloudFormation lub podobne

  • doświadczenie w budowaniu i utrzymywaniu CI/CD - u nas przede wszystkim GitHub Actions (environments, secrets, deployment governance)

  • umiejętność skryptowania i automatyzacji - Bash, Python lub podobny język

  • dobra znajomość konteneryzacji (Docker) oraz doświadczenie z monitoringiem i logowaniem w środowiskach chmurowych

  • nawyk FinOps: czytasz cost explorer ze zrozumieniem, umiesz znaleźć i zrealizować oszczędności w infrastrukturze klienta (u nas to standard pracy, nie dodatek)

  • realne, praktyczne używanie narzędzi AI w codziennym devops: agenci spięci z terminalem/repo, automatyzacja i własne skrypty, pisanie i utrzymanie skilli oraz runbooków - a NIE kopiowanie fragmentów do czatu

Dodatkowo dobrze, gdy:

  • znasz Azure, GCP lub Cloudflare (Pages, Workers, WAF, DNS) - nasze projekty są multi-cloud

  • masz doświadczenie z orkiestracją kontenerów (Kubernetes / AWS EKS)

  • posiadasz certyfikację AWS (np. AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional) lub inne certyfikaty chmurowe

  • masz doświadczenie w środowiskach wieloregionowych / wysokiej dostępności (HA) oraz odzyskiwaniu po awarii (DR)

  • masz doświadczenie z zarządzaniem sekretami (np. AWS KMS, SOPS) oraz zabezpieczaniem infrastruktury chmurowej

  • znasz procesy i narzędzia observability: logowanie, alerty, metryki (np. AWS CloudWatch, Prometheus, ELK, Datadog)

  • ogarniasz security hygiene: zarządzanie dostępami (GitHub org, least privilege), reagowanie na incydenty u vendorów, podstawy email auth (SPF/DKIM/DMARC)

Docenimy również:

  • nieszablonowe myślenie i kreatywność

  • samodzielność i dobrą organizację pracy własnej

  • wysokie zdolności komunikacyjne 🫂

  • umiejętność logicznego myślenia i szybkiego uczenia się

  • umiejętność rozwiązywania problemów 🤝

  • wszechstronne doświadczenie zebrane na różnych stanowiskach i w różnych rolach - dzięki temu szybciej łapiesz nowe konteksty i narzędzia

Co oferujemy? 🤲

  • Elastyczną formę współpracy - dowolny rodzaj umowy dostosowany do Twoich potrzeb

  • Możliwość pracy zdalnej (full-time lub part-time - można zacząć od części etatu)

  • Realny wpływ na standardy DevOps w całej organizacji (FinOps, security, AI tooling)

  • Regularne spotkania coworkingowe w większych miastach dla chętnych

  • Ekologiczne podejście - zapewniamy sprzęt, ale możesz pracować na swoim 🌱

  • Spotkania integracyjne, by nawiązać nowe znajomości

  • Wewnętrzne sesje dzielenia się wiedzą - każdy ma coś wartościowego do przekazania

  • Docenianie Twojej pracy i zaangażowania 🤜🤛

  • Wsparcie seniorów

  • Szkolenia i mastermind z kompetencji miękkich

  • Pakiet medyczny i sportowy

title: Senior Market Research Analyst - International Development & AI
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Market Research Analyst – International Development & AI based in United States.

We are seeking an experienced research professional to identify and evaluate strategic market opportunities at the intersection of international development, artificial intelligence, and data services. In this role, you will conduct in-depth research into institutional demand, funding environments, procurement trends, and emerging technology applications across global development markets. You will assess opportunities involving multilateral development banks, government agencies, international organizations, and development-sector stakeholders. Through quantitative and qualitative analysis, you will translate complex market intelligence into actionable business recommendations. Working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams, you will help shape market positioning, service development, and expansion strategies. This is an opportunity to contribute to the responsible growth of AI-powered solutions while supporting strategic decisions in a dynamic, international, and technology-driven environment.

Accountabilities

  • Lead comprehensive market research initiatives to assess institutional priorities, AI adoption trends, and demand for AI training data, multilingual datasets, human evaluation, and related services within the international development sector.

  • Analyze funding mechanisms, procurement practices, technology investments, and institutional purchasing requirements across multilateral development banks, government agencies, international organizations, and development consulting firms.

  • Evaluate market opportunities across geographic regions and development sectors, including education, employment, social protection, agriculture, and public services.

  • Identify potential institutional customers, assess market size, competitive landscapes, barriers to entry, and commercial feasibility, and prioritize opportunities based on strategic relevance.

  • Conduct competitive intelligence and monitor emerging policies, funding programs, institutional initiatives, and technology trends that may influence market demand.

  • Assess how existing AI, multilingual data, and evaluation capabilities can address emerging institutional needs, including socioeconomic data analysis, document processing, and domain-specific AI applications.

  • Collaborate with technical, operational, and business development teams to evaluate service feasibility, identify potential adaptations, and support pilot programs, partnerships, and new service development.

  • Develop market assessments, feasibility studies, institutional analyses, executive presentations, and evidence-based strategic recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Establish research methodologies, priorities, and reporting processes to maintain reliable and ongoing market intelligence.

  • Independently manage research projects from initial scoping and data collection through analysis, reporting, and presentation, ensuring accuracy, quality, and timely delivery.

  • Translate complex economic, institutional, and market information into clear business insights that support strategic planning, market entry, and business expansion decisions.

  • Communicate research assumptions, limitations, risks, and recommendations effectively while managing multiple priorities and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Economics, Applied Economics, International Development, Public Policy, or a closely related quantitative social science discipline, with academic training in statistics and research methodologies.

    • At least 6 years of relevant professional experience, ideally between 6 and 10 years, in applied economic research, institutional research, policy analysis, market research, or strategic market intelligence.

    • Demonstrated experience conducting quantitative and qualitative research and evaluating complex economic, socioeconomic, institutional, and market information.

    • Proven ability to transform research findings into structured reports, actionable recommendations, and strategic business insights.

    • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to independently manage research initiatives and assess information from multiple sources.

    • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to present complex findings and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

    • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining high-quality deliverables.

    • Proficiency in research methodologies, data analysis, market assessment techniques, and professional reporting and presentation tools.

    • Ability to consistently work Central Time (CT) business hours, regardless of geographic location, to support business operations and team collaboration.

    • A Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy, International Development, Development Economics, or a related analytical discipline is preferred.

    • Previous experience working with multilateral development banks, international development organizations, government agencies, or similar institutional stakeholders is highly desirable.

    • Experience conducting research and market assessments across multiple countries, particularly in developing and emerging markets, is an advantage.

    • Familiarity with development-sector funding mechanisms, donor-funded programs, institutional procurement processes, and government investment priorities is preferred.

    • Knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, digital development, or technology-enabled solutions in international development is an asset.

    • Experience supporting market-entry strategies, commercial feasibility assessments, business expansion initiatives, or strategic partnerships is beneficial.

    • Strong stakeholder engagement skills and the ability to communicate effectively with executive-level decision-makers are highly valued.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive Salary: Annual base salary ranging from $70,000 to $95,000 USD for US-based employees, depending on qualifications, relevant experience, skills, and applicable geographic considerations.

      • Medical Insurance: Employer-sponsored medical coverage, subject to applicable eligibility requirements and waiting periods.

      • Dental Insurance: Dental coverage available to eligible employees.

      • Vision Insurance: Vision coverage available to eligible employees.

      • Retirement Savings: Access to a company-sponsored 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching contributions, subject to plan eligibility, contribution, and vesting provisions.

      • Short-Term Disability: Coverage available to eligible employees in accordance with applicable plan provisions.

      • Paid Time Off: Paid leave, sick leave, and applicable holiday benefits in accordance with company policies and relevant state and local laws.

      • Remote Work: Fully remote working arrangement for candidates based in the United States.

      • Work-Life Flexibility: Remote working environment with a consistent Central Time (CT) schedule to facilitate collaboration and operational alignment.

      • Professional Impact: Opportunity to contribute to strategic research and the development of AI and data services supporting international development markets.

title: Teachers at Woodinville KinderCare
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Teacher we will:

  • Invest in you and your career at KinderCare as you create a world-class experience in our classrooms
  • Reward your commitment to our children and families as your journey continues with us

When you join our team as a Teacher you will:

  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Physically able to lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $17.60 - $17.60 Hourly

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.


.

KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!

At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description:

Program Coordinator / Project Coordinator and Cost Analyst


Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Program Coordinator / Project Coordinator and Cost Analyst - Saudi National to join our team! In this role you will get to support the planning, coordination, financial tracking, and successful delivery of programs and projects while ensuring alignment with scope, schedule, quality, and budget objectives.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Coordinate multiple projects from initiation through completion.
  • Track project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and action items.
  • Schedule and coordinate project meetings, workshops, reviews, and related activities.
  • Prepare meeting agendas, presentation materials, minutes, action logs, and follow-up communications.
  • Monitor deadlines and follow up with project team members to ensure timely completion of assignments.
  • Maintain accurate project records, contracts, correspondence, reports, cost documentation, and supporting files.
  • Facilitate communication among project teams, clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and leadership.
  • Support project closeout activities, including final documentation, lessons learned, and financial reconciliation.
  • Identify potential project delays, risks, or challenges and escalate concerns to the appropriate manager.
  • Track project budgets, commitments, expenditures, invoices, purchase orders, forecasts, and financial obligations.
  • Prepare cost reports, budget summaries, variance analyses, financial projections, and management reports.
  • Compare actual costs against approved budgets and investigate discrepancies.
  • Support the preparation of cost estimates, pricing analyses, funding requests, and change-order evaluations.
  • Review invoices and expense documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with contractual requirements.
  • Maintain cost databases, financial spreadsheets, project trackers, and reporting systems.
  • Assist with monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
  • Monitor labor, material, subcontractor, travel, administrative, and other project-related costs.
  • Support earned value tracking and other project performance measurement processes, as applicable.
  • Provide cost-related information to project managers and leadership to support informed decision-making.
  • Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as appropriate.

What Required Skills You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Finance, Accounting, Construction Management, Engineering, Public Administration, or a related field.
  • Approximately 2 to 3 years of experience in project coordination, program administration, cost analysis, financial tracking, or a related role.
  • Experience coordinating schedules, budgets, documentation, project communications, and financial information.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Ability to prepare and maintain project budgets, cost reports, financial spreadsheets, and tracking systems.
  • Knowledge of cost control, budget monitoring, variance analysis, forecasting, and financial reporting principles.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple departments.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with project teams, clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and leadership.

What Desired Skills You'll Bring:

  • Experience supporting large-scale construction, infrastructure, engineering, transportation, buildings, or development projects.
  • Experience with project management information systems, enterprise resource planning systems, cost control software, or financial reporting platforms.
  • Experience preparing cost estimates, change-order evaluations, pricing analyses, forecasts, and funding requests.
  • Experience with earned value management, project performance measurement, or related project controls processes.
  • Familiarity with contracts, purchase orders, invoices, commitments, subcontractor costs, and commercial documentation.
  • Experience supporting project closeout, financial reconciliation, lessons learned, and final reporting.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas, data analysis, dashboards, and financial models.
  • Knowledge of project management principles, cost control procedures, and financial management practices.
  • Experience coordinating with clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal leadership.

title: IT Analyst
description:
BlueSoft to innowacyjny Software House należący do Grupy Orange. Od ponad 20 lat realizujemy projekty z obszaru software engineering, cloud, data oraz integracji systemów dla największych organizacji w Polsce i za granicą. Rozwijamy również własne produkty SaaS, które komercjalizujemy i skalujemy na rynkach lokalnych i międzynarodowych.

O projekcie

Jako IT Chapter - Platforma Zarządzania Procesami Biznesowymi szukamy osoby, która będzie odpowiedzialna za analizę i testowanie Platformy na silniku Camunda do sprzedaży produktów bankowych online.

Model współpracy: spotkania w jednym z biur w Warszawie, Katowicach lub Krakowie 6 dni w miesiącu.

Twoja rola w zespole

• Modelowanie procesów: Projektowanie przepływów w notacji BPMN 2.0 oraz tabel decyzyjnych DMN w programie Camunda Modeler.

• Analiza integracji: Tworzenie specyfikacji API (REST/SOAP) i mapowanie danych między Camundą, systemem front-endowym a systemami centralnymi banku.

• Testowanie (QA): Tworzenie scenariuszy testowych i weryfikacja logiki procesów oraz integracji (testy E2E, obsługa błędów, mechanizmy retry).

• Dokumentacja techniczna: Przygotowywanie diagramów sekwencji (UML) oraz zadań (User Stories) dla programistów.

• Diagnoza błędów: Analiza logów i monitorowanie procesów w Camunda Cockpit w celu wykrywania anomalii.

Czego oczekujemy

• Doświadczenie: Min. 3 lata w analizie systemowej lub testowaniu (mile widziane w bankowości, fintechu lub e-commerce).

• Znajomość Camundy: Praktyczna umiejętność pracy z ekosystemem Camunda BPM oraz standardami BPMN 2.0 i DMN.

• Kompetencje techniczne: Praktyczna znajomość formatów JSON/XML oraz narzędzi do testowania API (np. Postman).

• Bazy danych: Znajomość języka SQL do weryfikacji danych testowych.

• Wiedza domenowa: Zrozumienie procesów sprzedaży online (onboarding, KYC, scoring, zawieranie umów).

Narzędzia/Technologie:

• BPM / Workflow: Camunda BPM (Modeler, Cockpit), BPMN 2.0, DMN

• Integracje & API: REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, Kafka / RabbitMQ

• Narzędzia QA & Data: Postman, SoapUI, SQL

• Monitoring & Logi: Kibana, Splunk

• Metodyki & Narzędzia: Scrum/Agile, UML, Jira, Confluence, Git

• Skrypty (Nice to have): Java / JavaScript / Groovy (pod skrypty w Camundzie)

• Wersjonowanie: Git (GitLab / GitHub)

• Zarządzanie & Dokumentacja: Jira, Confluence, Enterprise Architect (lub inne narzędzie UML)

Co zyskujesz, współpracując z BlueSoft?

👨 💻 Współpracę w zespole interdyscyplinarnych ekspertów – entuzjastów technologii, ceniących bezpośredniość i partnerskie relacje.

📈 Długoterminowe zaangażowanie projektowe w firmie, która nieprzerwanie od ponad 20 lat rozwija się na rynku IT.

🚀 Udział w różnorodnych projektach IT realizowanych dla rozpoznawalnych klientów – liderów w swoich branżach.

🥇 Dostęp do najnowszych technologii i środowisko oparte na najwyższych standardach inżynieryjnych.

⌚️ Elastyczne warunki realizacji usług – hybrydowo lub w pełni zdalnie, dopasowane do charakteru współpracy.

☁ Ekosystem wymiany wiedzy i rozwoju: szkolenia wewnętrzne, gildie tematyczne oraz szkolenia i certyfikacje Cloud.

📣 Dostęp do nauki języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego online oraz grupowe zajęcia językowe.

🏋️ ♂️ Możliwość przystąpienia do Multisport i prywatnej opieki medycznej na preferencyjnych warunkach.

⛵️ Morskie przygody – rejsy po Morzu Karaibskim, Śródziemnym i Północnym z dofinansowaniem BlueSoft.

title: Senior IT Analyst
description:
Introduction & Summary

We are seeking an experienced IT Analyst to join a dynamic team within Group Technology. The ideal candidate will drive the requirements process, manage multiple initiatives with various stakeholders and provide insights for software development and decision-making. This role emphasizes the need for strong analytical skills and creative problem solving to support scalable, robust, and effective technological solutions.

What we offer:

  • Long Term project

  • Contract: B2B

  • Hybrid Mode: 3 days from office, 2 days from home ( Warszawa, Gdańsk or Gdynia)

Main Responsibilities

As an IT Analyst, you will:

  • Clarify, document and communicate functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Strengthen the robustness and quality of applications to ensure a reliable production environment.

  • Deliver projects in line with defined scope, standards, and timelines.

  • Stay updated with developments and best practices in your field.

  • Facilitate collaboration across business, IT, and external partners for successful deliveries.

  • Offer guidance to maximize customer value within your area.

  • Contribute to solutions that innovate and modernize the application portfolio.

Key Requirements

  • Strong requirements analysis skills.

  • Business knowledge and experience in banking.

  • Proficiency in SQL with experience managing large datasets.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective stakeholder management.

  • Hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence.

  • Ability to translate business needs into clear functional and non-functional requirements for T24.

  • Experience in analyzing end-to-end data flows.

  • Skills in facilitating workshops with diverse teams.

  • Proven track record in supporting solution design and defining acceptance criteria.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with the Hadoop ecosystem.

  • Experience with Snowflake technology.

Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Lead Teacher you will:

  • Lead, coach and mentor less experienced teachers in your classroom; model behaviors and provide feedback
  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Possess active Child Development Associate (CDA) Credential or meet NAEYC candidacy requirements
  • Approved state trainer (preferred)
  • 2-3 years Early Childhood Education Experience (preferred)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Early Childhood Education (preferred)
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Use a computer, lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Be able to make physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $16.85 - $21.60 Hourly

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.


In the state of Illinois, we currently provide a 15% premium in addition to the range of pay listed to all hourly employees working in a center that participates in the Illinois Smart Start Workforce Grant.

KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Teacher we will:

  • Invest in you and your career at KinderCare as you create a world-class experience in our classrooms
  • Reward your commitment to our children and families as your journey continues with us

When you join our team as a Teacher you will:

  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Physically able to lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $17.35 - $17.35 Hourly

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.


.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

title: Unemployment Claims Assistant
description:
Unemployment Claims Assistant - AZ
About Us Vensure Employer Solutions is the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector, providing a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. As a "One Employer Solution” headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Vensure helps thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations with custom strategies that benefit both employers and employees. Find out more by visiting
Position Summary The Unemployment Claims Assistant plays a vital role in supporting the Unemployment Services team by providing comprehensive administrative and clerical assistance throughout the unemployment claims process. This position ensures timely and accurate handling of documentation, correspondence, and data entry related to unemployment claims, helping to maintain compliance with state and federal regulations.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities Efficiently manage and route inbound mail, email, case files, and inquiries to the appropriate team members or departments, ensuring timely and accurate handling of all correspondence. Prepare, organize, and send outbound mail, including claim responses, supporting documentation, and other official communications, in accordance with established timelines and procedures. Enter and update client and claim information in the Unemployment Tracking software, ensuring data integrity and compliance with internal standards and external regulatory requirements. Create, manage, and update both physical and digital filing systems. Maintain various tracking logs and databases to support efficient retrieval of information and ensure audit readiness. Accurately input sensitive and time-critical information into internal systems to meet procedural deadlines and support the timely resolution of unemployment claims. Assist with employee recognition efforts such as birthday and anniversary acknowledgments. Maintain the team calendar and support the coordination and preparation of team meetings, events, and other collaborative activities. Provide support on ad hoc projects and initiatives as assigned by leadership, contributing to continuous improvement efforts and departmental goals. Regular, on-site attendance is an essential job function due to the need for secure access to systems, collaboration on sensitive technical matters, participation in operational meetings, and hands-on involvement.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities A strong drive to deliver exceptional client support to both external and internal customers. A flexible, positive attitude, and a dedicated team player and collaborator. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through. Ability to communicate clearly, concisely, and proactively, both verbally and in writing. Capability to learn multiple HRIS (Human Resources Information System) platforms and vendor partner platforms. Drive to learn, grow, and contribute to the overall success of the company Ability to thrive in a modern, collaborative international environment, effectively using video conferencing, chat, email, and phone to maintain strong team communication. Education & Experience High School Diploma or equivalent combination of experience, skills, education (including other relevant non-traditional degree programs, certifications, or job training programs) preferred. Experience in Microsoft Office software (Outlook, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint) and demonstrated ability to learn other applications as needed. Required Licenses and/or Certifications
None
Physical, Mental, & Communication Demands
Physical Demands:
Sedentary Work: Primarily involves sitting for extended periods, often at a desk or computer. Manual Dexterity: Frequent use of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment. Mobility: Occasionally walking or traversing throughout the office to meet with leaders and other employees. Visual Acuity: Ability to read and analyze data on a computer screen (or to read and analyze data with reasonable accommodation) and in printed materials. Lifting & Carrying: Minimal physical lifting required, but may involve handling documents, and lifting light office supplies.
Mental Demands:
Cognitive Processing: Frequent need to analyze claim details, interpret state-specific unemployment regulations, and apply policies accurately to various situations. Attention to Detail: Continuous requirement to maintain accuracy when reviewing claims, documentation, deadlines, and data entered into tracking systems. Problem Solving: Regularly identifying issues, evaluating options, and determining appropriate next steps to resolve claim discrepancies or client concerns. Concentration & Focus: Ability to maintain sustained focus while managing multiple claims, email correspondence, calls, and system navigation throughout the workday. Decision Making: Exercising sound judgment when advising clients, responding to state agencies, and prioritizing tasks to meet strict deadlines. Stress Tolerance: Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with time-sensitive demands, fluctuating workloads, and high accountability requirements. Adaptability: Capacity to adjust to frequent changes in state regulations, processes, technology platforms, and client needs.
Communication Demands:
Verbal Communication: Frequent verbal interaction via phone and virtual meetings with clients, state agencies, and internal teams, requiring clear, professional, and courteous communication. Written Communication: Regular preparation and review of written correspondence, including emails, claim responses, documentation submissions, and internal notes, requiring clarity, accuracy, and appropriate tone. Listening Skills: Active listening to understand client needs, clarify complex claim information, and respond effectively to questions or concerns. Interpersonal Communication: Ongoing collaboration with internal team members and cross-functional partners to coordinate actions, share information, and resolve issues. Professional Representation: Consistent ability to convey confidence, empathy, integrity, and professionalism when representing the company to external clients and government agencies. Cultural Sensitivity: Communicate with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds, demonstrating cultural awareness and sensitivity. Environmental Conditions This position is performed in a professional office environment and requires regular use of computers and standard office equipment. The work setting is climate-controlled with typical office lighting and low to moderate noise levels.
This position is eligible for the following benefits:
Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision coverage Retirement Plan: 401(k) with company match Paid Time Off: PTO, Holidays, Parental leave and Sick Leave provided as required by applicable state law Other Benefits: Life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, employee assistance program (EAP), flexible spending account (FSA), health savings account (HSA), Identity theft protection, critical illness, accident, cancer, hospital protection, legal and pet insurance.

title: Front-End Engineer - React (Payments)
description:
*We are looking for Poland based candidate.

At Capco Poland, we’re not just another consultancy - we’re the spark behind digital transformation in the financial world. As a global leader in technology and management consulting, we thrive on helping clients tackle the toughest challenges across banking, payments, capital markets, wealth, and asset management.

Build seamless digital experiences and help shape the future of payment technology.

The Role

At Capco, we're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer (React) to provide specialist development services for a project within the financial services and payments industry. You'll collaborate with the Team, contributing to the design, development, and enhancement of modern web applications supporting business-critical payment services. This engagement offers the opportunity to apply your React expertise, work with AWS cloud technologies, and deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused digital solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and deliver responsive, high-quality front-end solutions using React and modern JavaScript technologies.

  • Collaborate with the Agile Team, including developers, product owners, QA engineers, and other stakeholders, to coordinate technical activities and deliver agreed project outcomes.

  • Develop and maintain integrations between front-end applications and APIs or services hosted within AWS cloud environments.

  • Deliver clean, maintainable, and testable code, contributing to technical reviews and applying established engineering standards.

  • Analyse and resolve technical challenges, optimise application performance, and contribute to improvements in usability, accessibility, and application quality.

What We’re Looking For

  • Approximately 5–10 years of relevant software development experience, with substantial hands-on expertise in React and modern front-end development.

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and component-based application architecture.

  • Practical experience working with AWS cloud services and integrating front-end applications with cloud-based solutions.

  • Good understanding of REST APIs, state management, automated testing, version control (Git), and modern software development practices.

  • Ability to deliver technical solutions independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in Agile or Scrum project environments.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience delivering technology solutions within financial services, payments, or transaction-processing environments.

  • Familiarity with AWS services such as S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, or Lambda.

  • Experience with front-end testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, containerisation, and automated deployment processes.

  • Knowledge of web accessibility standards, front-end security practices, and performance optimisation.

B2B cooperation in a hybrid model, with the option to provide services from the Warsaw office to the extent agreed based on project needs.

Recruitment Process:

  1. HR Interview with the recruiter

  2. Technical Interview

  3. Client Interview

  4. Feedback and offer

title: Scrum Master (k/m)
description:
Twój zakres obowiązków

  • wsparcie dla zespołów Scrum’owych w efektywnej współpracy i realizacji projektów,

  • dbanie o jakość i efektywność pracy zespołu,

  • przygotowywanie, facylitowanie i doskonalenie wydarzeń Scrum i SAFe, w tym PI Planning,

  • wsparcie w organizacji pracy oraz podejmowanie decyzji dotyczących sposobu osiągania celów,

  • dbanie o rozwój umiejętności i kompetencji zespołu jako kluczowego elementu dalszego rozwoju,

  • pełnienie roli mentora i coacha,

  • identyfikowanie oraz usuwanie przeszkód, ryzyk, konfliktów i problemów komunikacyjnych utrudniających pracę zespołów,

  • rozwój praktyki Kanban,

  • analizowanie Flow Metrics oraz identyfikacja wąskich gardeł,

  • wsparcie w zarządzaniu backlogiem i zależnościami między zespołami,

  • wspieranie zespołów w wypracowaniu i stosowaniu zasad współpracy, Definition of Ready oraz Definition of Done,

  • wizualizowanie i usprawnianie przepływu pracy, w tym rozwijanie tablic, polityk przepływu oraz zasad zarządzania pracą w toku,

  • inicjacja oraz wsparcie działania Continuous Improvement,

  • rozwój standardów organizacyjnych oraz współtworzenie Community of Practice Scrum Masterów,

  • wsparcie wdrożenia metodologii opartej na SAFe.

Nasze wymagania

  • wykształcenie wyższe - preferowane kierunki: techniczne, zarządzanie, psychologia, coaching lub pokrewne,

  • minimum 2 lata doświadczenia w roli Scrum Mastera, Agile Coacha, Delivery Coacha lub podobnej,

  • praktyczna znajomość Scrum, Kanban, Lean, Agile i SAFe,

  • doświadczenie w facylitacji wydarzeń SAFe i Scrum oraz coachingu Product Ownerów i liderów,

  • znajomość zarządzania zależnościami, Value Stream Mapping, metryk oraz Flow Metrics,

  • umiejętność pracy z danymi i metrykami,

  • znajomość narzędzi takich jak GitLab, Microsoft 365 oraz Miro, Collaboard lub podobnych,

  • znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie minimum B2,

  • gotowość do pracy w środowisku sprzętowo-programowym oraz przy projektach o wysokich wymaganiach jakościowych
    i bezpieczeństwa,

  • samodzielność, dojrzałość, empatia i aktywne słuchanie,

  • komunikatywność, umiejętność budowania relacji, facylitowania dyskusji i rozwiązywania konfliktów,

  • orientacja na rozwój i ciągłe doskonalenie.

Mile widziane

  • certyfikaty PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe RTE lub SAFe Practice Consultant,

  • certyfikaty Kanban University, Lean Six Sigma lub PSM II / III,

  • doświadczenie w pracy z DevOps.

title: Director, Clinical Study Management
description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!


Responsible for providing leadership and oversight to support the global activities and timelines related to execution of full-service clinical trials, including oversight of project management and project finance teams. As part of the senior leadership team, participate in the development and implementation of organizational strategies, technologies and best practices that ensure superior customer service, staff development, quality information management reporting and effective, efficient divisional short- and long-term goals that align with the organization's vision, mission, and direction.
Role includes policy and process development and improvement, product quality, compliance monitoring, staff resource planning, staff, and contractor performance management. To provide support, expertise and represent project and finance teams with sponsors/clients throughout the project life cycle. Ensure all team members deliver high quality, timely service and that service delivery processes are maintained in accordance with
corporate and industry best practices that meet all regulatory requirements and guidelines. Support Business Development by assisting with bid development and defense as required.
Positions: 1, global remote.

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

    • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Responsibilities

  • This role will include a combination of the following:
Operational Planning & Oversight (40-50%)
  • As part of the senior management team, participates in the operational planning process identifying and advocating on behalf of the functional area and the stakeholders it supports.
  • Guides the departmental planning and implementation process to transform strategic plans and direction into measurable operational short- and long-term goals and targets.
  • Oversee and/or participate in the project development process working with Sponsors and functional Directors to negotiate and deliver quality product(s), assessing resource and financial and safety requirements, assigning resources, overseeing trial conduct, information, and data confidentiality, and supporting project teams by assisting the troubleshooting and resolution process while ensuring all align with corporate objectives.
  • Responsible to ensure sufficient project level staffing and maintain utilization targets.
  • Represent project operations on cross-department planning initiatives.
Unit Leadership, Team Management and Engagement (30-40%)
  • Serve as a role model, motivator, and mentor to members of the Clinical Project Operations team ensuring functional areas are adequately staffed with qualified personnel, providing ongoing support to managers and/or leaders in the areas of work allocation, resource planning, staff allocation, training and development, employee engagement, team development and performance management (staff evaluation, performance improvement and lost time management).
  • Acts as senior representative of project operations team at client meetings.
  • Represent project operations at business development meetings including but not limited to bid defenses, general capabilities, and scientific conferences.
  • Attend and present at investigator meetings as needed.
Product Service/Excellence (10-15%)
  • Works in collaboration with leadership team to achieve excellence in project services, evaluating and implementing recommendations to minimize organizational risk, meet all regulatory and/or industry standards, while creating and promoting programs that support the Organization's growth as a world class provider of clinical research and research services.
Budget Planning & Financial Risk Management (10-15%)
  • Working in conjunction with members of the senior leadership team to plan, manage, advocate and report on behalf of the department during the budget and annual operational review processes.
  • Maintain knowledge of financial and regulatory risks and requirements related to department service delivery and direct the development of methodologies to review, monitor, and manage risks and requirements.
  • Work in conjunction with business development to prepare budgets and proposal text in response to requests for proposal, requests for information and statements of work.
  • Oversee change order development for full-service projects ensuring realization of project costs are achieved in line with work performed.

Qualifications

  • Job Experience & Education Requirements: Undergraduate university degree (Bachelor or Honors Bachelor) + minimum of 10 years related experience and training/continuous ongoing development OR College diploma/degree and a minimum of 15 years related experience.
  • Deep experience in full-service project management leadership, coaching and leading a team with an excellence mindset.
  • Financial Resource Management: significant financial responsibility (extensive participation in budget setting, autonomous expenditure and/or revenue generation decisions limited by company policy or financial processing, reconciliation and reporting.
Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.
