title: Data Scientist (Credit Risk)
description:
Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy Data Scientisty z doświadczeniem, który będzie rozwijać modele analityczne i scoringowe w obszarze ryzyka kredytowego. To rola łącząca zaawansowaną analizę danych, modelowanie ML/AI oraz współpracę z obszarem biznesowym i technologicznym. Będziesz pracować nad rozwiązaniami wykorzystywanymi w praktyce — od eksploracji danych i budowy modeli, przez wdrożenie i monitoring, aż po ich optymalizację i dalsze doskonalenie.

Twój zakres obowiązków

  • Budowa, rozwój, utrzymanie i monitoring modeli analitycznych / scoringowych (głównie predykcyjnych) w obszarze ryzyka kredytowego i fraudowego oraz innych istotnych dla organizacji aspektach.

  • Rozwój narzędzi i komponentów wspierających modelowanie ML/AI.

  • Współpraca z biznesem i IT przy wdrażaniu oraz optymalizacji rozwiązań analitycznych, procesów i produktów.

  • Udział w innowacyjnych projektach rozwojowych wykorzystujących dane oraz automatyzację.

  • Projektowanie rozwiązań wspierających decyzje kredytowe, ocenę wiarygodności klientów i jakość portfela.

  • Analiza danych oraz identyfikacja czynników wpływających na ryzyko, skuteczność procesu i wyniki biznesowe.

  • Przygotowywanie analiz dotyczących portfela kredytowego, procesu oceny klienta i efektywności modeli.

  • Monitoring jakości modeli oraz rekomendowanie zmian poprawiających ich skuteczność i stabilność.

  • Dzielenie się wiedzą i wspieranie rozwoju kompetencji analitycznych w zespole.

Nasze wymagania

  • Doświadczenie na podobnym stanowisku.

  • Co najmniej 3 lata doświadczenia w pracy z danymi i modelowaniu z wykorzystaniem ML.

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość Python i SQL.

  • Umiejętności i wiedza w pracy z bazami danych/hurtownią danych.

  • Praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z bibliotekami takimi jak Pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels lub podobnymi.

  • Syntetyczne przedstawianie informacji i rekomendacji.

  • Biegła znajomość pakietu MS Office.

  • Znajomość języka angielskiego umożliwiająca pracę z dokumentacją i współpracę w środowisku technologicznym oraz pracę z partnerami biznesowymi.

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie w obszarze credit risk, fraud, fintech, e-commerce, lendtech lub bankowości.

  • Doświadczenie z bazami NoSQL, narzędziami do monitoringu, np. Grafana.

  • Wykształcenie wyższe o profilu ścisłym: matematyka, statystyka, ekonometria, informatyka, fizyka lub kierunki pokrewne.

  • Doświadczenie na stanowisku w obszarze zarządzania Ryzykiem Kredytowym w sektorze instytucji finansowych (najlepiej w zakresie Klienta Biznesowego).

To oferujemy

  • Realny wpływ na rozwój modeli wykorzystywanych w procesach decyzyjnych.

  • Współpracę z zespołami biznesowymi i technologicznymi przy kluczowych inicjatywach firmy.

  • Przestrzeń do rozwoju eksperckiego w obszarze data science i credit risk.

  • Stabilne zatrudnienie w organizacji rozwijającej nowoczesne rozwiązania dla biznesu.

Benefity

  • dofinansowanie zajęć sportowych

  • prywatna opieka medyczna

  • dofinansowanie nauki języków

  • dofinansowanie szkoleń i kursów

  • spotkania integracyjne

Wspieramy mikro, małe i średnie firmy w codziennym finansowaniu ich działalności. Jesteśmy fintechem, a nie bankiem, dzięki czemu szybko odpowiadamy na specyficzne potrzeby naszych klientów.

title: Informatica Developer
description:

This role focuses on the migration of the Informatica PowerCenter platform to the Informatica Cloud (IDMC) solution, ensuring effective data integration and application functionalities.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Knowledge of agile methodologies (Scrum).

  • Experience with complex data integration issues.

title: GPU Software Development Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

The Role and Impact

As a GPU Software Development Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing and developing software solutions that enable Intel's GPUs, ranging from firmware and device drivers to APIs and application layers. You will work on cutting-edge kernel-level features that drive functionality, power management, and performance optimization for integrated and discrete graphics products. Your contributions will directly shape immersive visual experiences for millions of users, ensuring Intel's leadership in graphics technologies.

Business Group

We are the Windows Kernel Mode Driver Team within Intel's Client Graphics IP group of DCG. Our primary objective is the development and deployment of robust and performant Windows kernel GPU drivers. These drivers are instrumental in unleashing the full potential of Intel's integrated and discrete GPU hardware for user-space clients, games, and applications.

Our focus lies in managing critical low-level functions, including device activation, reset and power state transitions, workload submission, power conservation, and scheduling, as well as collaboration with System-on-Chip (SOC) Intellectual Properties (IPs). With this charter, we conceive, create, and verify software solutions that serve as the link between user-space applications and the underlying GPU and SOC. If you thrive in an environment that involves working on system-level software, with regular exposure to diverse domains such as graphics rendering, firmware, SOC, and power management, then a role on our Kernel Mode Driver Team is where you should be.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, validate, and optimize GPU kernel-mode drivers for Windows operating systems.
  • Collaborate on implementing low-level features, including device activation, power management, and workload scheduling for integrated and discrete GPUs.
  • Design and debug firmware and software features related to GPU hardware and accompanying System-on-Chip (SOC) components.

title: Junior SOC Engineer
description:
Astek

Założona w 1988 roku we Francji Grupa Astek jest światowym partnerem w obszarze doradztwa inżynieryjnego oraz IT. Dzięki swojej wiedzy specjalistycznej w wielu sektorach przemysłowych i technologicznych, Astek wspiera międzynarodowych Klientów w rozwijaniu i wdrażaniu produktów oraz usług, jednocześnie uczestnicząc w ich transformacji cyfrowej.

Grupa Astek od momentu powstania opiera swój rozwój na kulturze przedsiębiorczości i innowacyjności oraz na budowaniu umiejętności swoich ponad 10 000 pracowników, którzy codziennie uczestniczą w zróżnicowanych projektach technologicznych i inżynieryjnych.

Dołącz do silnie rozwijającej się we Francji i na całym świecie Grupy, której obroty w 2025 r. wyniosły 730 milionów euro.

Zapraszamy na https://astek.net po więcej szczegółów.

Stanowisko

Obecnie dla naszego klienta z branży energetycznej, poszukujemy kandydata/kandydatki na stanowisko Junior SOC Engineer

Dodatkowe informacje

SOC Enterprise Project – projekt skupiony na eliminacji luk w monitoringu bezpieczeństwa dla różnych jednostek biznesowych i technologii. Jako Junior SOC Engineer wesprzesz obecny zespół SOC, przejmując część zadań i odciążając go w bieżącej pracy. Będziesz brać udział w onboardingu klientów oraz tworzeniu i wdrażaniu zapytań w systemach opartych o KQL i ADX.

To rola dla osoby, która lubi łączyć pracę techniczną z kontaktem z ludźmi – oprócz pisania zapytań będziesz komunikować się z interesariuszami i klientami po angielsku.

Oferowane wynagrodzenie

Wynagrodzenie: do 900 PLN netto/dzień, w zależności od posiadanego doświadczenia i kompetencji.

Sprawdzisz się w tej roli, jeżeli:

  • Jesteś studentem 4–5 roku (lub świeżo po studiach) kierunku IT/pokrewnego

  • Programujesz w Pythonie

  • Znasz SQL

  • Znasz KQL lub szybko się go nauczysz (jeśli masz mocny SQL – bez obaw)

  • Dobrze posługujesz się językiem angielskim i potrafisz komunikować się z klientem/interesariuszami

  • Znasz ekosystem Microsoft lub chętnie w nim pracujesz

  • Jesteś dyspozycyjny/a do pracy stacjonarnej w Katowicach - na początku współpracy

Mile widziane:

  • Znasz Azure (przydatne przy większych wdrożeniach)

  • Miałeś/aś styczność z ADX, Logic Apps lub narzędziami klasy SIEM

Zadania, które na Ciebie czekają:

  • Wsparcie zespołu SOC i przejmowanie części jego bieżących zadań

  • Onboarding klientów – kontakt i komunikacja z interesariuszami (w tym po angielsku)

  • Tworzenie zapytań w KQL i wdrażanie ich w systemach opartych o ADX

  • Walidacja i analiza danych pochodzących z ADX

  • Wsparcie przy wdrożeniach w środowisku Microsoft

Nasz proces rekrutacji

Rozmowa z naszym Rekruterem -> Rozmowa z naszym Business Managerem -> Spotkanie z Klientem

W uzasadnionych przypadkach po rozmowie z Rekruterem wprowadzamy dodatkowy etap weryfikacji technicznej

Potrzebujesz więcej informacji? Skontaktuj się ze mną: [justyna.placzkiewicz@astek.net]

Skontaktujemy się tylko z wybranymi kandydatami.

Co oferujemy

  • Długoterminowa współpraca

  • Szkolenia techniczne, certyfikaty i podnoszenie kwalifikacji

  • Mentoring Competence Center - bycie członkiem społeczności CC od pierwszego dnia pracy jest szansą na rozwijanie swoich umiejętności, uczestniczenie w różnych konferencjach oraz dzielenie się wiedzą i doświadczeniem z ludźmi, którzy na co dzień mierzą się z tymi samymi wyzwaniami

  • Jasna ścieżka kariery

  • Pakiet benefitów pracowniczych (Multisport, prywatna opieka medyczna, ubezpieczenie na życie)

  • Przyjazną atmosferę pracy, imprezy integracyjne i spotkania team-buildingowe

System rekomendacji

Znasz kogoś, kogo zainteresuje ta oferta? Skorzystaj z naszego systemu rekomendacji i zgarnij bonus do 7000 zl!

title: Production Operative
description:
Red Dot Corporation, the leading producer of premium mobile HVAC units and components for heavy-duty commercial and military vehicles, is recruiting for the following position:

FLSA: Non-Exempt

Production Operative - Final Assembly/Fabrication

Shift: Days, Monday - Thursday 10-hour shifts 6:30 AM to 5:15 PM

Compensation: $20.50 per hour


Summary Description:


Under the general supervision and direction of the Area Team Leader, the Production Operative performs hands-on tasks within assigned manufacturing work centers. While operatives may be cross-trained for multiple departments, position is assigned to the Final Assembly or Core Department, where the employee will be responsible for the assembly, brazing, and testing of heater cores, evaporators, and condensers. The role must be performed in alignment with company procedures, safety standards, and quality requirements. Assignments may vary based on production needs.


Job Duties and Responsibilities (Essential Functions):


· Completes tasks associated with Final Assembly or Fabrication job descriptions as assigned; Responsible for performing brazing operations to join metal parts according to specifications, using a torch method while ensuring strong, clean, and precise joints.

· Practice appropriate safety, security and environmental procedures. Handle relevant equipment with care, being concerned with safety and security. Immediately report safety concerns to Supervisor/Lead.

· Exercise care of all tools, machines and equipment through proper use and storage.

· Maintain a clean work area, including daily sweeping of floors, racking of tools, dies, guides and related equipment.

· With training, guidance, and time management, work on pace to meet production schedules.

· Ability to multi-task, work in a fast-paced environment, and to be cross-trained and work in other areas as assigned.

· Provide regular updates to direct supervisor regarding progress and non-routine occurrences that may disrupt work schedule.

· Other duties as assigned.

·

Department-Specific Duties – Core Department

  • Assemble heater cores, evaporators, and condensers using fixtures, jigs, and precision tools.
  • Perform brazing operations using a torch or oven/furnace to join copper or aluminum parts, ensuring clean, leak-free joints
  • Conduct water testing on completed units using pressurized systems to check for leaks, recording results accurately.
  • Interpret work orders, blueprints, and production specifications to verify correct dimensions, tolerances, and materials.
  • Inspect brazed and assembled components for quality, ensuring alignment, proper joint flow, and product integrity.
  • Safely handle and store gases and brazing materials; follow all PPE and ventilation requirements.
  • Monitor and maintain brazing equipment, reporting issues or wear to the supervisor for maintenance or calibration.
  • Perform minor repairs or rework on parts that do not meet quality standards, as directed.
  • Track material use, scrap, and output to ensure proper reporting and productivity.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Basic understanding of manufacturing processes and equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, work instructions, and SOPs.
  • Familiarity with quality control standards and visual/mechanical inspection techniques.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude and proficiency with hand and power tools.
  • Basic computer and data entry skills for tracking production activities.
  • Strong attention to detail, time management, and ability to work both independently and within a team.
  • Good communication skills for reporting issues and following directions.
  • Dependability and consistent attendance required.
  • Commitment to safety, product quality, and continuous improvement.

title: ServiceNow Developer with IRM (f/m/x)
description:
Zespół ServiceNow w Sii świadczy usługi dla klientów z różnych branż w Europie i Stanach Zjednoczonych. Specjalizujemy się w rozwoju platform klientów, optymalizacji i cyfryzacji procesów oraz rozbudowie wykorzystywanych w organizacjach platform. Nasza ekspertyza obejmuje moduły: ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, SecOps, SPM oraz IRM w ekosystemie ServiceNow.

W Sii wszelkie decyzje związane z zatrudnieniem podejmowane są wyłącznie na podstawie kwalifikacji i kompetencji. Zapewniamy równe i sprawiedliwe traktowanie wszystkich osób, niezależnie od cech prawnie chronionych. Aktywnie promujemy różnorodne i inkluzywne środowisko pracy, w pełnej zgodności z obowiązującymi przepisami antydyskryminacyjnymi.

Twoje zadania

  • Tworzenie i utrzymywanie istniejącej dokumentacji

  • Udział w testach i działaniach wdrożeniowych

  • Uczestnictwo w analizie wymagań i sesjach przeglądowych, przeglądach projektów oraz spotkaniach Scrum

  • Wykonywanie aktualizacji platformy, w tym przegląd pominiętych rekordów

  • Realizacja zadań administracyjnych, konfiguracyjnych oraz ogólnych w ServiceNow, w tym standardowa konfiguracja, bezpieczeństwo, workflow, zarządzanie danymi i integracje

  • Identyfikowanie możliwości automatyzacji w celu poprawy doświadczenia użytkownika końcowego z platformą

  • Tworzenie skryptów w różnych obszarach (Business Rules, UI Actions, Access Control Lists, UI Policies, UI Pages)

  • Tworzenie, dostosowywanie i modyfikowanie Flow/Workflow, portali i widgetów

  • Konfiguracja dashboardów z funkcjami raportowania

  • Integracja z narzędziami firm trzecich oraz innymi instancjami ServiceNow (w tym standardowe API oraz usługi sieciowe REST/SOAP)

  • Weryfikacja rozwiązania technicznego przed wdrożeniem

Wymagania

  • Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia na stanowisku ServiceNow Developer

  • Doświadczenie z podstawowymi modułami ServiceNow, w tym Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Service Level Management, CMDB, Knowledge Management oraz Service Request Management

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z modułem ServiceNow IRM (Integrated Risk Management), w tym konfiguracja Risk Management, Policy and Compliance Management, Audit Management oraz Vendor Risk Management

  • Znajomość metodologii oceny ryzyka, testowania kontroli, zarządzania problemami oraz wdrażania ram zgodności w ramach ServiceNow IRM

  • Umiejętność konfigurowania oświadczeń ryzyka, celów kontroli, wskaźników ryzyka (KRI) oraz dashboardów raportujących w IRM

  • Zorganizowane i skoncentrowane podejście do pracy

  • Dobre umiejętności analityczne i komunikacyjne

  • Wymagana biegła znajomość języka polskiego i angielskiego

  • Wymagane zamieszkanie w Polsce

Mile widziane

  • Posiadanie odpowiednich certyfikatów ServiceNow

title: PnP System Validation and Integration Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

The PnP SV (Power and Performance System Validation) group is responsible for the functional (logical) integrity of the processor, from the first silicon stage through to mass production.

In the period before the first silicon, the group is responsible for defining the processor testing methodology and its environment, defining test plans, and developing some of the software and hardware tools required to perform the tests.

In the period between the first silicon and readiness for mass production, the group focuses on running the defined tests and performs DEBUG of failures in order to ensure that all logical bugs have been found. After approval for mass production, problems and bugs that were missed (from customers) arrive, and work is done on them (as each processor has many derivatives).

The work in the department involves collaboration with additional groups – logic design, architecture, software groups for tool and simulator development, and more.

A complete project lasts between two to four years, with each phase taking approximately half of that period.

Job Description

title: Cyber Security Case Manager/Coordinator
description:
Astek

Założona w 1988 roku we Francji Grupa Astek jest światowym partnerem w obszarze doradztwa inżynieryjnego oraz IT. Dzięki swojej wiedzy specjalistycznej w wielu sektorach przemysłowych i technologicznych, Astek wspiera międzynarodowych Klientów w rozwijaniu i wdrażaniu produktów oraz usług, jednocześnie uczestnicząc w ich transformacji cyfrowej.

Grupa Astek od momentu powstania opiera swój rozwój na kulturze przedsiębiorczości i innowacyjności oraz na budowaniu umiejętności swoich ponad 10 000 pracowników, którzy codziennie uczestniczą w zróżnicowanych projektach technologicznych i inżynieryjnych.

Dołącz do silnie rozwijającej się we Francji i na całym świecie Grupy, której obroty w 2025 r. wyniosły 730 milionów euro.

Zapraszamy na https://astek.net po więcej szczegółów.

Stanowisko

Obecnie dla naszego klienta z branży bankowej poszukujemy kandydata/kandydatki na stanowisko Cyber Security Case Manager/Coordinator (K/M)

Oferowane wynagrodzenie

Wynagrodzenie: do 1040 PLN netto/dzień, w zależności od posiadanego doświadczenia i kompetencji.

Sprawdzisz się w tej roli, jeżeli:

  • Masz doświadczenie w koordynowaniu projektów lub inicjatyw związanych z Cyber Security, szczególnie w obszarze zarządzania podatnościami i remediacji findingów bezpieczeństwa.

  • Potrafisz efektywnie współpracować z zespołami technicznymi, rozumiesz podstawowe zagadnienia związane z infrastrukturą IT i cyberbezpieczeństwem oraz swobodnie poruszasz się w dokumentacji technicznej.

  • Lubisz pełnić rolę koordynatora, który monitoruje postępy działań, angażuje odpowiednich interesariuszy, eskaluje ryzyka i dba o terminowe zamykanie tematów.

  • Dobrze odnajdujesz się w środowisku, w którym trzeba łączyć perspektywę techniczną i biznesową oraz współpracować z osobami o różnych kompetencjach i poziomach wiedzy.

  • Potrafisz przejąć odpowiedzialność za powierzony obszar i konsekwentnie doprowadzać sprawy do zakończenia.

  • Jesteś osobą komunikatywną, proaktywną i nie boisz się inicjować działań oraz angażować innych w realizację wspólnych celów.

  • Swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim, zarówno w mowie, jak i piśmie.

  • Potrafisz działać w sytuacjach niejednoznacznych, sprawnie ustalać priorytety i znajdować rozwiązania problemów.

Mile widziane:

  • Znajomość frameworków i standardów cyberbezpieczeństwa, takich jak MITRE ATT&CK, NIST czy ISO 27001.

  • Doświadczenie we współpracy z zespołami odpowiedzialnymi za testy bezpieczeństwa, zarządzanie podatnościami lub ryzykiem IT.

  • Wiedza z zakresu regulacji i wymagań związanych z cyberbezpieczeństwem oraz bezpieczeństwem informacji.Doświadczenie w środowisku regulowanym, np. w sektorze finansowym, bankowym lub ubezpieczeniowym.

  • Podstawowa znajomość zagadnień związanych z Offensive Security, testami penetracyjnymi lub analizą podatności.Certyfikaty z obszaru Cyber Security, takie jak CISM, CISSP, CEH, OSCP lub CREST.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z międzynarodowymi interesariuszami oraz w środowisku projektowym.

Zadania, które na Ciebie czekają:

  • Koordynowanie procesu remediacji podatności i rekomendacji wynikających z testów bezpieczeństwa oraz działań Cyber Security.

  • Monitorowanie postępu działań naprawczych i dbanie o terminowe zamykanie zidentyfikowanych findingów.

  • Współpraca z zespołami IT, Cyber Security oraz właścicielami aplikacji i usług w celu skutecznego adresowania ryzyk bezpieczeństwa.

  • Prowadzenie przypisanych spraw od momentu identyfikacji problemu do jego pełnej remediacji, przy wsparciu ekspertów technicznych z zespołu.

  • Ocena i priorytetyzacja zidentyfikowanych ryzyk oraz wspieranie procesu podejmowania decyzji dotyczących działań naprawczych.

  • Organizowanie spotkań statusowych, koordynowanie komunikacji pomiędzy interesariuszami oraz zapewnianie transparentności prowadzonych działań.

  • Eskalowanie ryzyk, blokad oraz opóźnień mogących wpływać na terminową realizację działań remediacyjnych.

  • Przygotowywanie raportów, dokumentacji oraz prezentacji dla odbiorców technicznych i biznesowych.

  • Ścisła współpraca z zespołami realizującymi Offensive Security Testing oraz Operational Security.

  • Inicjowanie i proponowanie usprawnień w procesach związanych z zarządzaniem podatnościami, ryzykiem oraz bezpieczeństwem IT.

Rozmowa z naszym Rekruterem -> Rozmowa z naszym Business Managerem -> Spotkanie z Klientem

W uzasadnionych przypadkach po rozmowie z Rekruterem wprowadzamy dodatkowy etap weryfikacji technicznej

Potrzebujesz więcej informacji? Skontaktuj się ze mną: [krystyna.sojko@astek.net]

Skontaktujemy się tylko z wybranymi kandydatami.

Co oferujemy

  • Długoterminowa współpraca

  • Szkolenia techniczne, certyfikaty i podnoszenie kwalifikacji

  • Mentoring Competence Center - bycie członkiem społeczności CC od pierwszego dnia pracy jest szansą na rozwijanie swoich umiejętności, uczestniczenie w różnych konferencjach oraz dzielenie się wiedzą i doświadczeniem z ludźmi, którzy na co dzień mierzą się z tymi samymi wyzwaniami

  • Jasna ścieżka kariery

title: Senior Java Developer | Krakow
description:
Senior Java Backend Developer

Location: Kraków, Poland
Work Model: Hybrid — 3 days/week

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Java Backend Developer to join a leading technology team in Kraków.

The ideal candidate will have 8+ years of hands-on experience in backend application development, with strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot.

This role offers the opportunity to work on enterprise-scale applications, designing and delivering robust, scalable, and high-performance backend solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.

  • Build and enhance RESTful APIs and microservices-based solutions.

  • Collaborate with architects, business analysts, QA engineers, and other development teams to deliver high-quality software.

  • Participate in system design discussions and contribute to technical architecture decisions.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following best practices and coding standards.

  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues.

  • Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Participate in code reviews and mentor junior team members where required.

  • Contribute to CI/CD implementation and DevOps initiatives.

  • Work effectively within Agile/Scrum teams.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience.

  • Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot.

  • Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices.

  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns.

  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.

  • Familiarity with messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar.

  • Experience with Git, Maven/Gradle, and modern development tools.

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and software delivery best practices.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Excellent communication skills in English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

  • Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures.

  • Financial services or enterprise-scale project experience.

Work Model

Hybrid working model with regular on-site presence required in Kraków, Poland.

Ideal Candidate

If you are a highly skilled Java Backend Developer with strong Spring Boot expertise and a passion for building scalable enterprise applications, we would love to hear from you.

title: Electrical / Electronics Engineer
description:
• Contract B2B, 12 months + extensions

  • Rate: 75-100 PLN/h netto + VAT

  • Full-time, typical core hours

  • Working model: Hybrid, 3 days from Cracow office, the rest remotely

  • Language: English & Polish

We are looking for an Electrical / Electronics Engineer to join an automotive R&D team in Kraków and contribute to the design and redesign of electronic devices intended for high-volume automotive applications. The role combines hands-on electronic circuit design, power supply development, simulation, prototyping and laboratory validation.

You will work on products designed with a strong focus on reliability, cost optimisation and high-volume manufacturing.

Your responsibilities

  • Designing and redesigning electronic devices for automotive applications.

  • Designing power supply circuits, including DC/DC converters.

  • Designing and testing analogue and digital electronic circuits.

  • Developing microcontroller-based electronic solutions.

  • Preparing electronic schematics and supporting PCB development.

  • Performing circuit calculations and simulations.

  • Supporting component selection and design optimisation.

  • Building, bringing up and validating prototypes.

  • Performing laboratory measurements and hardware troubleshooting.

  • Preparing electrical characteristics and technical design documentation.

  • Supporting releases and design updates.

  • Participating actively in peer and design reviews.

  • Following established Electrical Design Processes and quality standards.

  • Cooperating with local and international engineering teams.

Must-have requirements

  • 2–5 years of professional experience in electronics / hardware development.

  • Engineering degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.

  • Hands-on experience designing DC/DC converters / power supply circuits.

  • Experience designing and testing digital and analogue circuits.

  • Experience with microcontroller-based hardware.

  • Understanding of medium-power analogue electronics and signal measurement.

  • Practical experience with electronic CAD / EDA tools.

  • Experience with circuit simulation tools.

  • Ability to create and understand electronic schematics and PCB-related documentation.

  • Hands-on experience with prototype validation and laboratory testing.

  • Good written and spoken English.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Nice to have

  • Master's degree in Electronics or a related field.

  • Previous experience designing electronics for the automotive industry.

  • Experience designing or optimising hardware for EMI/EMC compliance.

  • Experience with automotive EMC testing.

  • Knowledge of digital video interfaces and serializer/deserializer technologies.

  • Experience with technologies such as SerDes, FPD-Link, GMSL or LVDS.

title: Senior System Validation and Integration Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

• Lead system validation and integration for Intel IPU (Infrastructure Processing Unit) silicon and presilicon projects, supporting one of the most innovative and leading product lines in the industry. • Drive deep understanding of system architecture and requirements; lead definition of comprehensive test plans in collaboration with system architects, design, and firmware teams. • Design, develop, and maintain advanced automation frameworks, system test plans, and validation procedures for both presilicon and silicon environments. • Take a handson leadership role in system bringup, feature enablement, integration, and crosscomponent debugging. • Own complex failure analysis and root cause investigation across hardware, firmware, and software layers. • Leverage AI and datadriven methodologies to accelerate debug, anomaly detection, log analysis, and test optimization; actively contribute to AIbased validation and development solutions. • Drive CI/CD methodologies in validation environments, improving coverage, scalability, and execution efficiency. • Mentor junior engineers, guide technical direction, and influence validation methodologies and best practices. • Work extensively with validation and lab tools such as Lauterbach, LeCroy, IXIA, and advanced debug infrastructures.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
• 7+ years of experience in system validation for pre-silicon and silicon environments.
• Strong experience in IP networking systems with deep understanding of protocols and performance (TCP/IP, routing, traffic flows).
• Proven hands on expertise in debugging complex system issues across HW/SW/FW boundaries.
• Strong programming skills in Python and/or C/C++, with experience building scalable automation frameworks.
• Experience with networking and debug tools such as Wireshark, Scapy, Tcprewrite, NetCat, IPtables, etc.
• Experience with AI/ML tools or techniques for debugging, log analysis, or test optimization - strong advantage.
• Strong system level thinking, with multidisciplinary understanding (embedded systems, HW/SW interaction, architecture).
• Proven experience leading test planning, estimation, and execution in complex projects.
• Handson experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation in validation environments.
• Strong leadership, mentoring, and cross team collaboration skills.

title: Senior FullStack Java Engineer
description:
ALTEN – A Global Leader in Engineering and IT Services

Founded in France in 1988, the ALTEN Group is a leading technological partner serving the world’s largest clients. In 2023, it achieved revenues exceeding 4.07 billion euros and employs over 57,000 people, 88% of whom are engineers and IT experts.

ALTEN Polska has been operating for 13 years, supporting its clients' innovation, research and development, and IT systems. It has offices in Kraków, Warsaw, Wrocław, Gdańsk, and Poznań.

It serves key industries such as aerospace, space, industrial solutions, automotive, railway, energy, finance, telecommunications, and retail.

Areas of expertise: business analysis, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data analysis and cloud solutions, application development, software testing, project management, embedded software, quality management, industrialization, digital transformation, and industrial engineering.

For more information, visit:

Location: Kraków (hybrid, 8 office visits/month)

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable microservices for the Collateral platform using Java 17/21 and Spring Boot.

  • Contribute across the full development lifecycle, from conception to deployment.

  • Apply DevOps and Agile principles to streamline development and improve team velocity.

  • Ensure test-driven development (TDD) with JUnit, integration tests, regression tests, and Cucumber for end-to-end acceptance testing.

  • Collaborate closely with QA teams to enhance code quality and development efficiency.

  • Mentor junior team members and drive innovative solutions for complex business challenges.

  • Support the platform through incident resolution, monitoring, and problem management.

  • Develop automated tools to improve operational efficiency and support functions.

  • Translate functional requirements into technical solutions.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on Java development experience.

  • Proficiency in Java 17/21 and Spring Boot for microservices development.

  • Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and DevSecOps pipeline setup/maintenance.

  • 3+ years of experience working in Agile and/or DevOps teams.

  • Experience with TDD (JUnit, integration tests, regression tests, Cucumber) in a CI environment.

  • Proven ability to translate functional requirements into technical solutions.

  • Excellent communication skills and a self-motivated approach to learning new technologies.

  • Track record of delivering significant projects from conception to completion.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot).

  • Familiarity with Spring Cloud (Hystrix, Eureka, Zuul, Sleuth, Feign, Ribbon).

  • Experience with distributed applications using in-memory data stores (e.g., Oracle Coherence, Redis, Hazelcast).

  • Knowledge of REST APIs, messaging systems (MQ, Solace), and automated deployment tools (Ansible).

  • Experience with TypeScript, Angular, and HTML5 for full-stack development.

  • Cloud experience (GCP/AWS).

  • Knowledge of relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL).

We offer:

We offer a full-time employment contract

  • Location – Kraków; work model – hybrid

  • Stable and long-term cooperation

  • Well-defined career path at the European leader in engineering & IT consulting

  • Participation in company conferences, trainings, workshops, integration meetings, etc.

  • Certification and training opportunities

  • Opportunity to relocate and work in different ALTEN Polska branches

  • After completion of the project, opportunity to engage in a subsequent one within the company

  • Introduction and cooperation with dedicated Competences Manager

Benefits

  • Medicover medical care

  • Medicover dental care

  • Medicover Benefits platform

  • Medicover Sport card

  • Referral Program

  • Layette for a newborn employee’s child

  • Group life insurance

  • Pension scheme

We also offer cooperation based on a B2B or Contract of mandate (UZ). As part of this cooperation, you may have the opportunity to:

  • Access the Medicover Sport program on a self-funded basis

  • Access the Medicover Platform

  • Access Allianz insurance option on a self-funded basis

  • Access expert’s support from Competences Center and Practices & Expertise functions

  • Support additional business initiatives (PoCs, client engagements, and technical assessments) under a separately agreed scope

  • Access to professional certifications with our technology partners (e.g. Google, ISTQB)

  • Participate in relevant industry events

  • Participate in the Knowledge Sharing Program

  • Participate in Referral program

  • Continue cooperation through subsequent projects, after completion of the project

Join our team and let’s build tomorrow’s world today!

title: Technical Lead
description:
Industry: Pharmaceutical

Start: ASAP

Work model: Remote

Contract: B2B

Summary: The Technical Lead will play a crucial role in integrating a global SaaS platform into the research IT landscape, ensuring reliable and secure laboratory data flows. This role combines solution architecture with hands-on engineering to facilitate seamless data management across different regions.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Build a thorough technical understanding of the vendor SaaS solution and its integration points within the existing IT landscape.

  • Lead solution design for secure, compliant, and reliable integration between Climb, Cloud Services, SADP, and downstream systems.

  • Define and coordinate expected data flows, including support for laboratory activities and equipment.

  • Assess and coordinate migration of data from the legacy solution to the new platform.

  • Provide technical leadership to the development team and collaborate with the Product Owner and Scrum Master to implement the right solution.

  • Remain hands-on with Python and database development, including PostgreSQL and PL/SQL-related work.

  • Design and validate integrations using messaging queues and appropriate data architecture patterns.

  • Support proof-of-concept work, technical troubleshooting, code reviews, and continuous improvement.

  • Use GitHub and agile delivery practices to support transparent and effective software delivery.

Key Requirements:

  • Strong experience in solution architecture, requirements analysis, and solution design.

  • Proven experience integrating SaaS products with enterprise systems.

  • Strong AWS knowledge and experience in designing cloud-based solutions.

  • Hands-on Python development experience.

  • Strong database and data engineering experience, particularly with PostgreSQL and PL/SQL.

  • Experience with messaging queues, data flows, and system-to-system integration.

  • Understanding of secure and compliant solution design in a regulated environment.

  • Experience with GitHub and agile practices.

  • Analytical and systematic thinking ability to translate complex requirements into clear technical solutions.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in laboratory animal research applications.

  • Familiarity with compliance regulations in the healthcare sector.

  • Interpersonal skills for team collaboration and feedback.

title: C++ Engineer (UI Framework)
description:
We are looking for a skilled C++ Engineer to join a platform-focused team responsible for building and evolving a modern UI framework, component library, and design system infrastructure used across multiple products and internal teams.

Start: January 11th 2027

Length: 18 months

Location: Stockholm (on-site presence required 2-3 days per week)

You will work in a cross-functional environment alongside C++ engineers, front-end developers, UX designers, and product stakeholders, helping to create scalable, performant, and maintainable solutions that support a broad range of user experiences.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, improving platform capabilities, and building systems that enable other development teams to move faster and deliver consistent user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain core UI framework capabilities using C++.

  • Build scalable, stable, and high-performance platform solutions that support multiple products and teams.

  • Collaborate closely with both back-end and front-end developers to define APIs and technical architecture.

  • Partner with UX designers and product stakeholders to translate user needs into technical solutions.

  • Maintain and improve integrations between internal systems and third-party technologies.

  • Work closely with other engineering teams to drive consistency and alignment across products.

  • Contribute to technical direction, architecture discussions, and engineering best practices.

  • Support continuous improvements in development processes, quality standards, and ways of working.

  • Coach and mentor engineers on software design principles, code quality, testing, and maintainability.

  • Balance performance, scalability, developer experience, and end-user experience in technical decision-making.

  • Drive quality through strong API design, automated testing, code reviews, and engineering best practices.

Required Experience

  • Strong professional experience with modern C++ development.

  • Experience working with and modernizing large or legacy codebases.

  • Experience building platform capabilities, frameworks, SDKs, or shared services used by internal development teams.

  • Solid understanding of software architecture, API design, and scalable system development.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to navigate complex technical challenges.

  • Experience working in agile development environments.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Fluent English, both spoken and written.

Meritorious

  • Experience working with front-end technologies such as TypeScript, React, or modern web frameworks.

  • Experience building or maintaining design systems, component libraries, or UI platforms.

  • Understanding of UX principles and collaboration with design teams.

  • Experience with rendering technologies, graphics systems, or performance optimization.

  • Experience working in product organizations with multiple stakeholders and internal customers.

  • Familiarity with Figma and design-to-development workflows.

What We Are Looking For

We believe the right person is a strong engineer who enjoys working on foundational technology that enables other teams to succeed. You thrive in collaborative environments, care about code quality and maintainability, and can balance technical excellence with pragmatic delivery. Experience building platforms, frameworks, or developer-facing products will be highly valued.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a team where you will have significant influence on architecture, developer experience, and the future evolution of a widely used UI platform.

title: Internal Controls Manager
description:
Who You Are:

You are a detail-oriented and analytical professional with deep knowledge of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, internal controls, and business process design. You thrive at evaluating risk, documenting processes, and identifying gaps that could impact financial reporting. You are just as comfortable digging into process details as you are partnering with cross-functional teams to drive control improvements. You balance independence and collaboration, bringing strong project management and communication skills to keep stakeholders aligned and compliant.

The Task At Hand:

Once Upon a Farm is seeking an Internal Controls Manager to support the company’s SOX compliance program and ensure robust internal controls over financial reporting. This role will focus on business process controls (e.g., procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, inventory, payroll, financial close) while collaborating with IT and operational teams to ensure end-to-end compliance. You will take ownership of walkthroughs, risk assessments, control documentation, testing, and remediation tracking. By ensuring controls are designed and operating effectively, you’ll play a critical role in maintaining trust, compliance, and strong governance across the organization.

In This Role, You Will:

  • SOX Compliance & Internal Control Management
    • Support the execution of the company’s SOX program, focusing on IT and Business Process controls across finance and operations.
    • Perform process walkthroughs with business owners, identify key controls, and document them in risk-control matrices.
    • Design and update process narratives, flowcharts, and test plans to reflect current practices.
    • Execute control testing and document results in accordance with PCAOB and external auditor standards.
    • Track and validate remediation efforts for control deficiencies, ensuring timely resolution.
  • Process & Risk Assessment
    • Assist in annual SOX scoping and risk assessment activities.
    • Evaluate changes in business processes, acquisitions, or system implementations for impact on SOX controls.
    • Provide recommendations for strengthening processes, mitigating risks, and improving operational efficiency.
  • Collaboration & Business Partnership
    • Partner with Finance, Accounting, HR, Operations, and IT to ensure consistent control execution and awareness.
    • Support internal and external audit requests, providing clear and accurate documentation.
    • Act as a trusted advisor, simplifying compliance requirements and guiding best practices for control design and operation.
    • Use AuditBoard GRC tool to document and retain SOX workpapers.

In This Role, You’ll Bring With You:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field (CPA, CIA, or CISA certification preferred).
  • 4–6 years of experience in SOX compliance, internal audit, or external audit at a public company or Big 4/large firm.
  • Strong knowledge of SOX 404 requirements and internal control frameworks (COSO).
  • Hands-on experience with business process controls (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, payroll, inventory, financial close).
  • Excellent documentation, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally, influence stakeholders, and communicate effectively.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguity, deeply understand business needs, develop a cohesive strategy, and make decisions requiring a high level of judgment.
  • Solid knowledge of Microsoft Suite, Outlook, Slack, and other professional platforms.
  • Although this role is a remote work-from-home position, we “Farmers” do meet as a company and/or as a department a few times a year. Anticipate possible travel up to a few times each quarter.
  • Genuinely passionate about improving childhood nutrition for a healthier and happier planet.
  • Desire to contribute to a dynamic, high-growth, purpose-driven work environment.
  • Must reside in the United States to be considered for this position.
  • Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Compensation:

  • Salaried, Exempt, Full-Time
  • The anticipated salary range for this position is $130,000.00 - $150,000.00. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a few factors, including skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses, stipends, equity, and role-specific perks.

Additional:

  • Remote-first work environment
  • Annual Bonus
  • 401(k) program + 4% company match after three months
  • New Hire Remote Life Stipend + annual Nourish and Nurture Allowance
  • Monthly Cell and Internet Stipend
  • Quarterly Farm-to-Fridge home deliveries and Employee Discounts
  • New Parents: Up to 18 weeks of paid Parental Leave, Baby Steps Back To Work, 3 months’ supply of Once Upon a Farm products, and breast milk shipping service and support for those who travel after birth for the duration of your breastfeeding journey
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Paid Volunteer Time
  • Paid Time Off to fulfill civic responsibilities, including jury duty and voting in local, state, and national elections
  • Medical Insurance for the employee is covered at 100% on select plans, with additional plan options at a reduced cost to the employee
  • Vision and Dental Insurance are covered at 100% for the employee and dependents
  • Life insurance
  • Flexible spending account and Health Savings Accounts for applicable plans
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • All other benefits, leaves, and insurance as required by law, based on your specific residence
  • And so much more!

Who We Are

Our Purpose: Drive systemic improvement in childhood nutrition for a healthier, happier, and more equitable world.

Our Business: At Once Upon a Farm, a better story starts here. We're on a greater mission in providing organic, crave-worthy snacks and meals for children of all ages. Our recipes are crafted with only the best organic ingredients – whole fruits and veggies, cold-pressed (our pouches), or freshly frozen (our meals) to perfection– to support your growing kids at every stage. Each of our organic, non-GMO, non-dairy recipes contains no added sugar and are free from artificial flavors, colors, and preservatives – just simple, real, nutritious snacks your entire family will love.

We support and champion farmers who supply the highest-quality organic ingredients for our foods. We help parents keep their promise to provide the best nourishment for their children’s bodies and souls. We treat our consumers, customers, suppliers, investors, and all our valued employees with the same high level of dignity and respect that we expect from others. We will always fight for and support efforts to drive positive social change and food justice for the benefit of parents, kids, and families. Lastly, we foster an entrepreneurial and collaborative culture that values humility, honesty, passion, positive social impact, and fun.

Our Team: We’re all fully remote, which makes us a highly collaborative, dynamic, and supportive bunch. We share a singular mission to make the world a better place through the highest quality, most delicious, nourishing, and nutritious products made accessible to every home, from our farms to your fridge. And while we’re invested in our product, we’re equally invested in one another's success.

Once Upon a Farm is a purpose-driven brand made up of an inclusive group of individuals with diverse backgrounds, passions, and beliefs. We hire self-motivated, independent thinkers, and those who are genuinely passionate about improving childhood nutrition for a healthier and happier planet. Bring your whole self to your work at Once Upon a Farm, a proud equal-opportunity employer. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use.

In an effort to help us remove unconscious bias from our resume review process, we ask that you please remove all identifying information from your resume (like profile photos) before you upload it. Once Upon a Farm is committed to cultivating an inclusive environment where a diverse group of people can and want to do their best work, and that starts with our hiring practices.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Please see our Privacy Policy to learn more about the data we collect.

title: AI Silicon Performance Modeling and Analysis Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

About the Role and Team


The AI Silicon Architecture and Performance Engineering team is responsible for developing and maintaining performance models that enable architecture exploration, design evaluation, scalability analysis, and performance projection for next-generation AI silicon products. These models are a critical component of the product development process, providing early visibility into architectural tradeoffs, bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities long before silicon availability.


We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated engineer to drive AI silicon performance modeling, validation, architectural analysis, and stakeholder engagement activities. The candidate will work closely with architects, performance stimulus generation teams, silicon design teams, and product stakeholders to evaluate and optimize key AI silicon subsystems that determine overall platform scalability and performance.


The role focuses on performance modeling and analysis of AI SoC communication fabrics, memory subsystems, scale-up and scale-out interconnects, host-device memory paths, and end-to-end data movement infrastructure. The successful candidate will leverage SystemC/TLM-based modeling methodologies to generate actionable insights that directly influence architecture and product decisions.


This position requires a unique combination of software development expertise, architecture understanding, analytical problem solving, and cross-functional technical leadership. The engineer will be expected to independently drive complex technical initiatives while serving as a trusted performance expert across multiple organizations.



Key Responsibilities:

AI Silicon Performance Model Development

  • Implement new architectural features and capabilities based on evolving product requirements.
  • Improve model fidelity, scalability, maintainability, and simulation performance.

  • Perform detailed debugging and root-cause analysis of model issues and performance anomalies.
  • Contribute to the evolution of modeling infrastructure, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance SystemC/TLM-based performance models representing critical AI silicon subsystems.

    • Drive modeling of key architectural components including:
    • SoC fabrics and on-chip communication networks
    • Memory controllers and memory subsystem behavior
    • Scale-up controllers and fabrics enabling accelerator-to-accelerator communication within a node, tray, or pod
    • Scale-out controllers and fabrics enabling communication across nodes, racks, and larger AI clusters
    • Host CPU to accelerator memory paths
    • Local, host, and remote memory access paths
    • End-to-end data movement architectures


Functional Validation and Model Correlation:

  • Define and execute comprehensive validation strategies to ensure correctness and architectural accuracy of performance models.
  • Develop validation plans, regression suites, coverage methodologies, and quality metrics.
  • Correlate modeled behavior against architectural expectations, reference simulations, performance projections, and available hardware measurements.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies between expected and observed behavior.
  • Establish robust validation frameworks that improve stakeholder confidence in model-generated performance projections.
  • Continuously improve validation methodologies and model quality.

AI Silicon Performance Characterization and Architectural Analysis:

  • Design and execute performance studies covering a wide range of workloads, traffic patterns, and system configurations.
  • Analyze performance of communication fabrics, memory systems, and data movement paths under representative AI workloads.
  • Evaluate bandwidth utilization, latency characteristics, congestion behavior, traffic distribution, buffering efficiency, and resource utilization.
  • Characterize interactions across local memory, host memory, and remote memory domains.
  • Assess scalability of scale-up and scale-out architectures across increasingly larger deployment footprints.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and quantify their impact on overall system throughput and efficiency.
  • Conduct architectural tradeoff studies to evaluate alternative design approaches.
  • Provide performance-driven recommendations that influence architecture and product decisions.

Performance Data Generation, Analytics and Visualization:

  • Develop frameworks and methodologies for large-scale performance data generation and analysis.
  • Create automated workflows for data collection, processing, correlation, and reporting.
  • Develop performance dashboards and visualization tools that simplify interpretation of complex performance data.
  • Define and track meaningful performance KPIs and architectural metrics.
  • Utilize Python-based analysis frameworks to process large datasets and generate actionable insights.
  • Enable efficient consumption of performance information by architects, designers, and engineering leadership.

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Partner closely with architecture teams, performance stimulus generation teams, silicon design teams, and product stakeholders.
  • Drive technical discussions related to performance methodology, architectural assumptions, workload behavior, scalability analysis, and bottleneck identification.
  • Review architectural proposals and provide performance-driven feedback.
  • Present performance studies, technical findings, and architectural recommendations to engineering leadership.
  • Influence product and architecture decisions through data-backed analysis and sound engineering judgment.
  • Act as a key technical bridge between architecture, modeling, and performance analysis organizations.

Methodology Development and Team Growth:

  • Drive improvements in modeling methodologies, simulation efficiency, and analysis workflows.
  • Identify opportunities for automation across modeling, validation, performance analysis, and reporting activities.
  • Establish best practices for model quality, performance characterization, and architectural analysis.
  • Contribute to technical mentoring and knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Support the development of junior engineers and future team growth initiatives.
  • Help cultivate a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate should show the following behavioral traits:

  • Strong quantitative reasoning and data-driven decision-making skills.
    Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Presentation (technical) and stakeholder management skills.
  • Influence engineering decisions through rigorous analysis and technical credibility.
  • Operate independently and deliver results in ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Independently solve complex technical problems.

Qualifications:

Minimum qualifications, you must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics Engineering.

  • 6+ years of industry experience in:

    • Performance modeling, AI silicon architecture, SoC architecture, computer architecture, performance engineering, or related domains.
    • SoC architecture, including on-chip communication fabrics, NoC concepts, high-speed interconnects, and scale-up/scale-out communication architectures.
    • Memory subsystem architecture, including memory controllers, cache hierarchies, data movement, and latency/bandwidth characterization and performance bottleneck analysis.
    • Software development experience in C++.
    • Working proficiency in Python for automation, performance analysis, data processing, and visualization.
    • Hands-on experience with SystemC and Transaction-Level Modeling (TLM) methodologies.
    • Experience developing or validating performance models for AI accelerators, SoCs, CPUs, GPUs, networking products, or complex hardware systems.
    • Performing architectural tradeoff analysis and performance debug and characterization studies.


This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.


Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

  • Deep understanding of AI accelerator architectures and modern AI infrastructure.
  • Experience modeling memory, communication, interconnect, or scalability-related subsystems.
  • Experience with Network-on-Chip (NoC) architecture and interconnect performance analysis.
  • Understanding of scale-up and scale-out architectures used in modern AI computing platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML workloads, large language models, distributed training, and inference environments.
  • Experience with performance stimulus generation methodologies and workload characterization.
  • Experience building automated dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, Grafana, Plotly, or similar technologies.
  • Experience evaluating large-scale distributed AI systems and accelerator clusters.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership in cross-functional environments.

description:
O projekcie

Dołącz do NATEK Poland i zespołu Financial Markets w ramach współpracy z naszym klientem! Departament odpowiada w banku za rozwiązania IT wspierające zaawansowane obszary rynków finansowych. Realizują projekty związane z kalkulacjami finansowymi, zarządzaniem wskaźnikami oraz obsługą produktów bankowych – łącząc modernizację dotychczasowych narzędzi z tworzeniem zupełnie nowych rozwiązań. Szukamy osoby, która lubi pracę na styku biznesu i technologii, ceni stabilne procesy, a zarazem chce mieć realny wpływ na ewolucję systemów bankowych.

Obowiązki

  • Analiza i modelowanie procesów oraz systemów zgodnie z wymaganiami biznesowymi i technicznymi

  • Współpraca z biznesem oraz zespołami technicznymi w celu wypracowania odpowiednich rozwiązań

  • Tworzenie i utrzymywanie dokumentacji analitycznej oraz systemowej

  • Modelowanie procesów i systemów z wykorzystaniem odpowiednich notacji

  • Analiza i definiowanie integracji pomiędzy systemami

  • Współpraca przy projektowaniu oraz opisywaniu interfejsów i przepływów danych

Wymagania

  • 5+ lat doświadczenia na stanowisku Analityka Systemowego

  • Doświadczenie w pracy przy procesach kredytowych (preferowany klient korporacyjny)

  • Doświadczenie w modelowaniu procesów i systemów z wykorzystaniem notacji UML i BPMN

  • Praktyczna znajomość technologii REST, Kafka/RabbitMQ, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, SQL oraz FIX Protocol

  • Język angielski na poziomie B2

  • Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne

To oferujemy

  • Program Poleceń – ciesz się współpracą ze swoimi kolegami i otrzymaj bonus!

  • Klub NATEK 5/10 lat – oferujemy długoterminową współpracę i świętujemy każdą piątą rocznicę współpracy prezentami

title: Lead Teachers at Elmhurst KinderCare
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Lead Teacher you will:

  • Lead, coach and mentor less experienced teachers in your classroom; model behaviors and provide feedback
  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Possess active Child Development Associate (CDA) Credential or meet NAEYC candidacy requirements
  • Approved state trainer (preferred)
  • 2-3 years Early Childhood Education Experience (preferred)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Early Childhood Education (preferred)
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Use a computer, lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Be able to make physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $16.85 - $21.60 Hourly

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.


In the state of Illinois, we currently provide a 15% premium in addition to the range of pay listed to all hourly employees working in a center that participates in the Illinois Smart Start Workforce Grant.

KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

title: Pharmacy Student, Hourly Part Time Flexible Shifts Greenlight Requisition
description:
Join a locally owned and operated store to help deliver health, beauty and convenience services in your community, and keep the customer at the centre of everything you do.


Why this role is important?

SUMMARY:
Join a locally owned and operated store to help deliver health, beauty and convenience services in your community, and keep the customer at the centre of everything you do.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Pharmacy and Customer Service
Acknowledge all customers approaching the Pharmacy
Ensure all privacy requirements are met, including, customer confidentiality and consent management
Be clearly identifiable to the public

Why this role is important:
Here at Shoppers Drug Mart, we take pride and ownership in helping Canadians live life well. We’re looking for talented individuals who are passionate about providing an exceptional shopping experience for our Pharmacy customers and delighting them every step of the way!

We can offer progressive careers, comprehensive training, flexibility and a great benefits package! Come share our vision and passion in delivering a superior customer experience. Be a part of our growing Health & Wellness philosophy! We’re looking to provide practical experience for future pharmacists in a community pharmacy. Our retail / community environment will provide real world training to enhance academic experience. Students will learn about the expanding roles of the community pharmacist.

What we offer:
Expose students to the practice of pharmacy in a community setting- Enhance communication skills with patients, employees, and other health care workers- Enhance students' knowledge of OTC products, disease state management, drug therapy, and patient counseling skills- Teach skills necessary to manage a retail pharmacy- Prepare future pharmacists to be successful in a community setting. If you want to join a fast-paced winning team and believe you can have an immediate impact, then we want to hear from you.

J2WRTL
J2WRRX

Why work in a Shoppers Drug Mart store?

Each store has an Associate-Owner, so you will work for a local business owner while having the support of a national brand. Benefit from a purchase discount program, flexible and varied schedules, competitive pay and online learning through Academy.

Take ownership of your work and find more ways to care about your patients, co-workers, customers and community.

Associate Owners in the Shoppers Drug Mart network recognize Canada's diversity as an opportunity to better serve their communities, and strive to reflect the nation’s evolving diversity in the products they sell, the people they hire, and the culture they create in their stores. Accommodation is available upon request for applicants and colleagues with disabilities.​

In addition, we believe that compliance with laws is about doing the right thing. Upholding the law is part of our Code of Conduct – it reinforces what our customers and stakeholders expect of us.

#FS #PHARM #ON

title: Product Data Analyst (she/he/they)
description:
Technologia, która robi różnicę

Green Hive Technology to software house w Grupie Żabka, w którym tworzymy cyfrowe rozwiązania napędzające rozwój jednego z największych ekosystemów convenience w Polsce. Realizujemy projekty obejmujące rozwój aplikacji Żappka, inicjatywy z obszaru data science wspierające franczyzobiorców, rozwiązania wykorzystujące generatywną sztuczną inteligencję (genAI) oraz inne innowacyjne produkty cyfrowe. 💚

Aktualnie poszukujemy Product Data Analyst!

Co będzie należało do Twoich zadań?

  • przygotowywanie analiz ilościowych i formułowanie na ich podstawie wniosków oraz rekomendacji biznesowych;

  • podważanie status quo, stawianie i weryfikacja hipotez oraz szukanie nowych rozwiązań;

  • zbieranie, strukturyzowanie i interpretacja danych;

  • współpraca z interesariuszami biznesowymi i technologicznymi, zrozumienie ich potrzeb oraz komunikowanie wyników;

  • dokumentowanie prowadzonych analiz, zmian i eksperymentów;

  • podsumowywanie efektów podejmowanych działań i mierzenie ich wpływu na biznes.

Kogo szukamy?

  • posiadasz minimum 2 lata doświadczenia w roli analitycznej;

  • bardzo dobrze znasz zarówno SQL jak i Excela;

  • znasz podstawy Pythona i chcesz się w nim rozwijać;

  • potrafisz zrozumieć specyfikę branży i efektywnie przełożyć ją na wymagania analityczne;

  • masz doświadczenie w pracy z chmurowymi hurtowniami danych (np. Snowflake, BigQuery);

  • wyróżnia Cię analityczne myślenie, dociekliwość i zaangażowanie w realizowane zadania;

  • cechuje Cię proaktywna postawa i chęć zdobywania nowej wiedzy;

  • potrafisz samodzielnie planować i dobrze się organizujesz;

  • znasz język angielski na poziomie minimum B2.

Mile widziane

  • doświadczenie w branży retail/e-commerce;

  • doświadczenie z narzędziami do wizualizacji danych (np. Power BI).

Co oferujemy?

  • współpracę w oparciu o kontrakt B2B;

  • możliwość skorzystania z naszych biur w Poznaniu i Warszawie;

  • możliwość skorzystania z preferencyjnych warunków m.in. na kartę MultiSport, prywatną opiekę medyczną LuxMed oraz ubezpieczenie grupowe Uniqa. Dodatkowo możliwość uzyskania zniżek na Maczfit i w sklepach Samsung, a także możliwość zakupu lub wynajmu samochodu osobowego na korzystnych warunkach rabatowych.

A do tego:

  • realny wpływ na technologie, z których codziennie korzystają miliony ludzi;

  • miejsce, gdzie Twoje pomysły są słyszane i mają znaczenie;

  • współpraca z ekspertami i ekspertkami z różnych dziedzin;

  • możliwość testowania innowacyjnych rozwiązań.

Jak wygląda nasz proces rekrutacyjny?

  1. Wyślij nam swoje CV – uważnie je przeczytamy.

  2. Jeśli widzimy wspólny kierunek, odezwiemy się do Ciebie i zaprosimy Cię na krótką rozmowę telefoniczną (ok. 30 minut).

  3. Kolejny etap to rozmowa merytoryczna online.

  4. Jeśli wszystko pójdzie dobrze – witamy w Green Hive Technology.

title: Senior SAP MM/SD Consultant (with Polish)
description:
LeverX to międzynarodowa firma technologiczna i SAP Gold Partner, specjalizująca się w rozwiązaniach SAP. Od ponad 20 lat pomagamy firmom rozwijać i usprawniać ich procesy biznesowe — od wdrożeń i integracji po rozwój oraz optymalizację systemów SAP. Nasz zespół liczy ponad 2200 specjalistów, a na koncie mamy już ponad 1500 projektów SAP, w tym realizowanych dla firm z listy Fortune 500.

Obecnie szukamy Senior/Lead SAP MM/SD Consultant, który dołączy do naszego zespołu.

Co oferujemy:

  • 89% naszych projektów wykorzystuje najnowsze technologie i rozwiązania SAP, . S/4HANA Cloud, BTP, CPI, RAP, CDS i OData.

  • 98% projektów to aktywne projekty rozwojowe, a krótkoterminowe kontrakty supportowe należą do rzadkości.

  • Społeczności eksperckie oraz wewnętrzne kursy i możliwości wymiany wiedzy.

  • Wynagrodzenie dopasowane do rynku oraz regularne przeglądy wyników.

  • Prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover oraz dostęp do programu Medicover Sport.

  • Lekcje języka angielskiego i niemieckiego.

Wymagane umiejętności:

  • Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w konsultingu funkcjonalnym SAP MM/SD, w tym udział w co najmniej 2 pełnych cyklach wdrożeniowych.

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość konfiguracji i optymalizacji procesów SAP MM (Purchasing, Inventory Management) oraz SAP SD (Order to Cash).

  • Doświadczenie z S/4HANA oraz integracją z innymi modułami, takimi jak FICO, WM i PP.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy zgodnie z metodykami Agile/Activate.

  • Język angielski na poziomie B2+ oraz język polski na poziomie B2+.

Mile widziane:

  • Bogate doświadczenie w projektach obejmujących pełny cykl wdrożeniowy.

  • Znajomość strategii i narzędzi do migracji danych SAP, takich jak Migration Cockpit, Object Modeler itp.

  • Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu zespołem / pełnieniu roli lidera.

Obowiązki:

  • Prowadzenie i realizacja kompleksowych wdrożeń oraz migracji SAP MM/SD, w tym projektów S/4HANA.

  • Konfiguracja i wsparcie kluczowych modułów logistycznych SAP: Materials Management (MM) oraz Sales & Distribution (SD).

  • Współpraca z interesariuszami biznesowymi w zakresie zbierania i analizy wymagań oraz przekładania ich na rozwiązania funkcjonalne.

  • Nadzór nad kluczowymi procesami logistycznymi, takimi jak obsługa zamówień zakupu, zarządzanie zapasami, ATP, MRP, ustalanie cen oraz dostawy.

  • Prowadzenie i koordynowanie działań związanych z migracją danych, z zapewnieniem integralności i spójności danych podstawowych oraz transakcyjnych.

  • Wsparcie i prowadzenie zespołów projektowych zgodnie z metodykami Agile lub SAP Activate.

  • Mentoring i wsparcie merytoryczne dla młodszych konsultantów oraz członków interdyscyplinarnych zespołów projektowych.

title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
description:
Billennium is a global technology company with over 20 years of experience, committed to innovation and empowering businesses. As an employer, we offer a supportive, growth-focused environment where collaboration and creativity thrive. Join us to shape the future of technology together!

We are looking for an experienced Test Automation Engineer who will join a long-term project for our client in the fuel retail sector.

Attendance at the office is required once a month, with additional participation in planning meetings at the client's Warsaw office approximately once per quarter.

What you will do:

  • Plan and execute integration, system and usability testing.

  • Taking part of E2E and UAT testing.

  • Work with developers to understand the critical paths and ensure product stability.

  • Build better cooperation with other Dev Teams.

What we are looking for:

  • At least 5 years of experience as software tester.

  • Proficiency in Java.

  • Experience in performance testing.

  • Experience with Jira (preferably with X-ray).

  • Proficiency with Git.

  • Proficiency in using Postman for API testing.

  • Expert in CI/CD process and tools.

  • Excellent understanding of API response structure.

  • Experience in testing framework building and maintenance.

  • Expertise in understanding of the entire SDLC.

  • Good programming practices and design patterns (SOLID, KISS, OOP etc.).

  • Experience in code review.

  • Experience with tool integration and adopting to new solutions and technologies (POC, show case).

For Web Front:

  • Selenium/Selenide

  • Cypress

  • TestNG/jUnit

  • Cucumber

  • JMeter (nice to have)

For API:

  • REST Assured

  • TestNG/jUnit

  • Gatling

For Mobile:

  • Appium

  • XCUI Test

For Performance:

  • Gatling

  • JMeter (nice to have)

Perks and benefits (our offer):

  • Comprehensive benefits - enjoy Udemy for Business, private medical care, Multisport card, veterinary package, language lessons, and shopping vouchers.

  • Flexibility - adaptable working hours and remote/hybrid work options to suit your lifestyle & location.

  • Career growth - access opportunities for professional development and learning, including perks related to our official partnerships with global IT giants: Microsoft, AWS, Snowflake, Salesforce & more.

  • Global collaboration - work with a diverse, international team.

  • Innovative environment - be part of a forward-thinking and growth-oriented workplace.

  • Engaging community - work with passionate professionals and participate in team-building events, hackathons, and CSR initiatives to make an impact beyond work.

  • Team-building events including our company tradition (annual company event in Mazury).

  • A pleasant surprise to start your journey with us in the form of a welcome pack.
