title: Konsultant/Konsultantka ds. Wdrożeń i Serwisu
description:
O nas:

W KAMSOFT tworzymy systemy informatyczne oraz oprogramowanie, z których każdego dnia korzystają miliony użytkowników: od pacjentów, lekarzy i farmaceutów, aż po sieci szpitali i największe firmy farmaceutyczne. Jesteśmy także wiodącym dostawcą w dziedzinie e-zdrowia. Oferujemy rozwiązania chmurowe i stacjonarne, aplikacje mobilne, a także rozbudowane systemy dedykowane na szeroko pojęty rynek ochrony zdrowia. Ciągły rozwój jest jedną z głównych zasad na których opieramy naszą działalność. Dlatego poszukujemy osób otwartych, pomysłowych i ambitnych, które chcą podnosić swoje umiejętności i rozwijać się razem z nami. Od 40 lat tworzymy rozwiązania IT, a naszą siłą jest zespół ponad 700 specjalistów. Jesteśmy stabilnym pracodawcą, oferujemy także wiele możliwości rozwoju oraz aktywnie wspieramy pasje naszych pracowników. Zachęcamy również do odwiedzenia naszej strony .

Główne zadania:

  • Wdrażanie systemów informatycznych produkowanych przez KAMSOFT,

  • Bezpośrednie i zdalne wsparcie dla użytkowników systemów IT,

  • Wykonywanie konfiguracji oprogramowania,

  • Zarządzanie zgłoszeniami serwisowymi klientów,

  • Sporządzanie dokumentacji serwisowej i wdrożeniowej,

  • Udział w działaniach handlowych i okresowe szkolenia użytkowników systemu.

Wymagania:

  • Umiejętność tworzenia zapytań SQL i podstawowa znajomość relacyjnych baz danych,

  • Doświadczenie we współpracy z klientami i w pracy zespołowej,

  • Komunikatywność, umiejętność szybkiego nawiązywania kontaktów,

  • Predyspozycje do prowadzenia szkoleń,

  • Umiejętność analizowania problemów i znajdowania rozwiązań,

  • Prawo jazdy kat. B i gotowość do delegacji służbowych.

Mile widziane:

  • Doświadczenie w pracy wdrożeniowej lub serwisowej systemów informatycznych.

Oferujemy:

  • Pracując u nas, zyskujesz nie tylko stabilne zatrudnienie, przyjazną atmosferę, czy możliwość współpracy ze świetnymi specjalistami, ale także możesz skorzystać z całego katalogu różnych benefitów, aktywności i możliwości rozwojowych, które wspomagają obszary:

  • Zdrowie: prywatne ubezpieczenie medyczne, prywatne ubezpieczenie na życie

  • Rozwój: możliwość udziału w szkoleniach wewnętrznych, zewnętrznych i konferencjach,

  • Rozrywka: imprezy integracyjne, kręgle, imprezy rodzinne: Mikołajki, Dni Dziecka, konkursy firmowe

  • Sport: karty MultiSport, imprezy sportowe, dofinansowanie do sportu i rekreacji

  • Przyszłość: Pracowniczy Program Emerytalny

  • I inne: abonament telefoniczny i internetowy, Kafeteria Benefitów, Zakładowy Fundusz Socjalny, bezpłatny parking firmowy, wyjazdy zagraniczne.

title: Senior IC Test Engineer
description:
We are Mobileye's Production Test team - responsible for the definition, development, and deployment of production test operations for the world’s most advanced SoC’s for ADAS and self-driving vehicles.

This is your opportunity to join a team during its initial forming stage and leave your mark as Mobileye assumes full ownership for its silicon production operations to enable high volume manufacturing for cutting-edge automotive products.

What will your job look like?

  • Work closely with the design teams from early stages of the design process to review DFX architecture and define test requirements.
  • Define test methodologies and generate test content for high-speed interfaces of embedded IP blocks (LPDDR4/5, PCIe Gen4/5, D/C/MPHY).
  • Test program coding, pattern conversion and pre-Si validation (virtual test simulations)
  • Support Load Board and Probe Card design activities.
  • Lead post-Si test program debug activities to enable delivery of samples to internal and external customers.
  • Test program characterization and tuning to enhance test program quality to meet automotive standards.
  • Support Quality & Reliability team to enable effective and timely qual plan execution.
  • Lead test deployment activities with tier-one Foundry and OSAT vendors to enable large-scale Wafer-Sort and Final-Test operations.

All you need is:

  • BSc or MSc degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • 7+ years of experience as IC Product/Test engineer.
  • Hands on experience in bring-up & productization of complex IC products.
  • Deep understanding of structural DFT methods (scan, mbist, jtag, …).
  • Proficiency in C/C++ and scripting language (Perl, Python, …) in Unix environment.
  • Experience with data and yield analysis using known statistical methods and tools (e.g. JMP).
  • Strong sense of ownership, commitment, and responsibility.
  • Team player, with the ability to work in a rapidly evolving environment.
  • Good interpersonal communication skills.

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience with Teradyne UltraFlex/UltraFlexPlus.
  • Familiarity with Verilog and RTL behavioral simulations.
Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!

title: Assistant Manager
location: Fort Myers, FL, USA (Page Field Commons - J.Crew Factory)
description:
Our Story

We think shopping should be fun. Actually, really fun. As in scoring our exclusive collection of colorful, classic styles at prices that can’t be beat. A fan of lots of options in amazing fits? You’ve got it. Looking for some great accessories you won’t find anywhere else? Check. Need to get dressed for a day at the office, a weekend get-together or your next family vacation? As an Assistant Manager, you're a part of the leadership team. You help drive profitability through genuine customer connections, brand loyalty, and strong community engagement. You'll provide immediate feedback and coaching to the sales team to maximize performance. You will also collaborate with the rest of the leadership team to adapt strategies for business success and ensure smooth operational support as needed.

title: Engineering Manager, Production Engineering
description:
About Tutor

We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.

Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Our robots range from a semi-humanoid with frontier dexterity approaching the human form to workhorses that do back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

The Role

You lead our Production Engineering team: the engineers and technicians who take robot designs from prototype to mass production. You report to the Head of Manufacturing.

Your job is to design the system and the machine that build our robots: the processes, test systems, tooling and change control that let Manufacturing produce high-quality robots at a competitive cost, even as designs change fast.

This is a player-coach role. You set direction, assign the work and grow the team, and you stay hands-on. You are in design reviews, at the bench with a scope, and on the floor debugging a robot that needs to ship.

Why This Role Matters

Every robot we ship has to be built right, tested right and delivered on time, while the design behind it keeps improving. That only works with a strong team and a production system built for change. Much of that system doesn't exist yet. You build it, and the team that runs it.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the team: Set priorities and assign work across production engineers, test and bring-up engineers, technicians and contract engineers. Hold clear technical standards and review the team's work.
  • Grow the team: Hire, mentor and develop engineers. Shape a team structure that scales as production grows.
  • Prototype to production: Own how new designs move from prototype through pilot builds into volume production, with the processes, work instructions, tooling, fixtures and station design to support them.
  • Test and bring-up: Own the test strategy across the line, from subassembly bench tests to station tests, robot bring-up and final acceptance, so defects are caught early and never reach a customer.
  • Engineering change: Represent Manufacturing in design change reviews and own how changes are cut in on the line without losing quality or output.
  • Design for manufacturing: Partner with hardware engineering so designs arrive buildable, testable, serviceable and cost-effective.
  • Recurring failures: Use data from the line and the field to drive recurring problems to root cause and permanent fixes.
  • Stay hands-on: Debug electrical, mechanical and system-level issues yourself when a robot needs to ship.

What Success Looks Like

In your first few months: You've worked the floor with the team and earned their trust. Every engineer knows their priorities and what they own. The top recurring build failures have clear root causes and fixes underway, and you've laid out a plan for test, change control and the team.

In your first year: Robots move through bring-up and final test with little rework. Design changes reach the line cleanly. New designs arrive production-ready. The team is growing, owns its work and holds a high bar without you in the room.

Required

  • Bachelor's in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer or Mechatronics Engineering. A Master's is a plus.
  • Proven experience leading engineers: setting priorities, assigning work, reviewing output and developing people. A formal manager or technical lead title both count. We care about what you did with the team you had.
  • Deep hands-on hardware experience designing, integrating and debugging complex electromechanical systems. You still find root cause yourself.
  • Strong electrical fundamentals. You read schematics, use scopes and meters, and isolate problems across power, boards, harnesses, sensors, actuators and communication interfaces.
  • Experience taking hardware from prototype through new product introduction into volume production.
  • Experience building production test systems: fixtures, bring-up, end-of-line or automated test.
  • Hands-on design-for-manufacturing and design-for-test work with design engineering.
  • Experience managing engineering change on an active production line.
  • You use AI tools daily in your engineering work and can show us how.

Preferred

  • Built or scaled a production or manufacturing engineering team at a hardware startup.
  • Robotics or industrial automation experience.
  • Cost reduction work: should-cost, value engineering, or BOM and labor reduction.
  • Python for test automation, diagnostics or data analysis.
  • Experience with MES, traceability or change control systems.
  • Contract manufacturer or supplier bring-up.

Why Join

  • Build the team and the system. You shape how we build robots and who builds them.
  • Lead without leaving the hardware. You manage a team and still get your hands dirty.
  • Real hardware, real stakes. Your fixes run on robots working at customer sites.
  • AI is how we work. You have the tools and the backing to automate what most factories still do by hand.
  • Direct line to leadership. Work side by side with hardware, software and deployment teams.

How We Work: Our Values in This Role

We hire against our values, and we'll interview you against them too. Here's what they look like in this seat:

  • Love of the Game. You lead from the bench, not from a slide deck.
  • Gumption. When a robot won't ship, you and your team are already on the floor finding out why.
  • Beginner's Mindset. You question how we build and test today, and you change your mind fast when the data says to.
  • Belief in Each Other. You give your engineers real ownership, help them grow, and earn the hardware team's respect by being right and being fair.
  • Keep Moving Forward. You find the fix that keeps the line moving today, then make it permanent.
  • Customer Obsession. Every shortcut on the line shows up at a customer site. You and your team build it right.

Why Tutor?

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

Benefits

We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get:

  • Fully employer-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium.
  • A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future.
  • Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees.
  • Regular in-office meals and team social events throughout the year.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

title: C++ Game Developer
description:
Lubisz programować i chcesz dołączyć do doświadczonego zespołu, by wspólnie tworzyć gry, które podbijają świat? Świetnie! To właśnie Ciebie szukamy!

Czym będziesz się zajmować?

  • projektowaniem, implementowaniem i testowaniem różnego rodzaju gier i aplikacji wykorzystujących zagadnienia między innymi z zakresu statystyki matematycznej w środowisku Linux.

Pasujesz do nas, jeśli:

  • posiadasz co najmniej średnią znajomość C++ (wersja 11 i wyższe, STL) i praktyczne doświadczenie związane z tym językiem;

  • znasz zagadnienia związane ze statystyką matematyczną i posiadasz umiejętność implementacji algorytmów numerycznych;

  • masz co najmniej podstawową znajomość systemu Linux oraz jego narzędzi programistycznych;

  • dbasz o wysoką jakość kodu oraz posiadasz umiejętność tworzenia dokumentacji technicznej;

  • dysponujesz umiejętnościami analitycznymi i chęcią rozwiązywania problemów;

  • umiesz pracować w zespole;

  • masz dobra znajomość aplikacji arkuszy kalkulacyjnych i umiejętność efektywnego wykonywania za ich pomocą obliczeń z zakresu statystyki matematycznej;

  • znasz język angielski w stopniu pozwalającym na czytanie dokumentów technicznych.

Mile widziane:

  • znajomość zagadnień teorii gier;

  • doświadczenie w pracy ze średnimi lub dużymi projektami informatycznymi;

  • znajomość języka skryptowego Python/Bash;

  • znajomość systemu kontroli wersji Git;

  • znajomość Jira.

Dlaczego warto dołączyć do #TeamWazdan?

  • Podejmiesz współpracę z międzynarodową firmą, będącą jednym z liderów w swojej branży na rynku polskim i znaczącym graczem na rynku globalnym.

  • Oferujemy stabilne zatrudnienie w oparciu o preferowaną przez Ciebie formę współpracy oraz atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie, uzależnione od Twojej wiedzy i kwalifikacji.

  • Będziesz współpracować z doświadczonym zespołem przy użyciu nowoczesnych technologii, dzięki czemu podniesiesz swoje kwalifikacje.

  • Otrzymasz szeroki pakiet benefitów, .: kartę Medicover, prywatną opiekę medyczną LuxMed, kartę Pyszne Pay, paczki świąteczne.

  • Dbamy o dobrą atmosferę, oferując pracę w zintegrowanym i kreatywnym zespole z poszanowaniem równowagi między pracą i życiem prywatnym.

Jeśli Twoje CV wpisze się w nasze oczekiwania spodziewaj się:

1. Telefonu lub maila od zespołu HR.

2. Technicznego spotkania online z szefem działu i reprezentantem działu HR.

3. Jeśli pozytywnie przejdziesz rozmowę możesz się spodziewać: zadania do wykonania w domu lub pogłębionej rozmowy technicznej.

4. W ostatnim etapie możesz spodziewać się oferty, bądź podziękowania za udział w rekrutacji.

Uprzejmie informujemy, że skontaktujemy się tylko z wybranymi kandydatami.

title: SAP BTP Developer - AI & Agentic Applications
description:
Role Summary

  • Duration: 12-month contract with the possibility of extension

  • Work model: 100% remote

  • Industry: Pharmaceuticals / Life Sciences

  • Language: English — full professional proficiency

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced SAP BTP Developer to build AI-powered applications and extensions for a client in the pharmaceutical industry.

You will combine SAP development expertise with generative AI and agent-based technologies to support business processes. Working with SAP Joule, AI Core, Generative AI Hub and external AI platforms, you will contribute across the delivery lifecycle — from design and development to deployment and production support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop AI-enabled applications on SAP BTP using CAP (Node.js), CDS, SAP HANA Cloud and Cloud Foundry.

  • Build custom Joule Skills and AI agents using Joule Studio and Agent Builder.

  • Integrate AI services and models through SAP Generative AI Hub and external platforms such as OpenAI, Azure AI and Anthropic.

  • Implement RAG, prompt engineering and AI evaluation techniques.

  • Build and maintain SAPUI5 / Fiori applications and integrations between SAP and non-SAP systems.

  • Support workflow automation using SAP Build Process Automation.

  • Ensure solutions meet security, compliance and enterprise architecture standards.

  • Contribute to testing, CI/CD, deployment and production operations.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–7 years of SAP development experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on SAP BTP experience.

  • Strong knowledge of SAP BTP Cloud Foundry, CAP/CAPM (Node.js), CDS, SAP HANA Cloud and SAPUI5 / Fiori.

  • Hands-on experience with SAP AI Core, AI Launchpad, Generative AI Hub and Joule Studio.

  • Experience integrating external AI platforms and LLMs.

  • Experience delivering at least one AI, GenAI or Agentic AI solution into production.

  • Proficiency with REST APIs, OData services, Git, CI/CD and cloud-native development.

  • Understanding of OAuth 2.0, IAS, XSUAA and role-based access control (RBAC).

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with English at full professional proficiency.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP Build Process Automation, SAP Work Zone or SAP Event Mesh.

  • Familiarity with SAP Cloud SDK for AI and MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations.

  • SAP BTP certifications.

  • Experience working in Agile teams.

Who We’re Looking For

You can connect SAP development with practical AI capabilities and understand when to use an AI assistant, an autonomous agent or a traditional application. You enjoy solving business problems collaboratively and building solutions that work beyond the proof-of-concept stage.

Key Technologies

SAP BTP | Cloud Foundry | CAP | Node.js | CDS | SAP HANA Cloud | SAPUI5 | Fiori | AI Core | AI Launchpad | Generative AI Hub | Joule Studio | OpenAI | Azure AI | Anthropic | RAG | MCP | OAuth 2.0 | Git | CI/CD

Interested?

Send us your CV, we’d like to hear about your SAP BTP experience and the AI solutions you’ve helped bring into production.

title: Application Support Engineer - Graduate-level
description:
Hi, we’re Penfold - we’re on a mission to help everyone save enough to be comfortable in later life! 🚀

There’s over a trillion pounds sitting in UK pensions – but most of it is with legacy providers offering outdated products and poor service. We’re here to change that.

Penfold is building the pension of the future – a modern, tech-first platform that makes saving for later life easy, engaging and accessible for everyone.

We’re a growing team of 70+ builders across London and Tallinn, backed by some of the world’s leading FinTech investors. Having raised £25M+, we manage £1bn+ in pensions for over 100,000 savers and thousands of businesses — and we’re on track for profitability next year.

As one of our first 100 hires, you’ll play a key role in shaping our culture and have loads of opportunity to grow, progress and make your mark.

About the role -

We’re looking for an engineer starting out in their career, who wants to grow their technical skillset whilst also adding value to the business.

The role will be a split of ~50% first line support, ~50% build work. You will be investigating and helping to resolve customer issues, whilst working on automating our processes to reduce support volume. We have reduced support volume by 5% last year despite our user base growing over 25%.

The plan for this role is to work in a 50/50 cadence of support/build work for ~a year and then to move into a Product team as a Product Engineer, or to reduce the support workload to a small amount and spend more time on product work. Our last two Application Support Engineers are now in our Product teams as an Associate and a SWE I engineer!

You will be joining another Application Support Engineer who works with the same 50/50 cadence and be managed by our Team Lead who looks after our Scaling function that’s responsible for building internal tools that enable us to scale the business

Your responsibilities

  • Supporting our Customer Support, Operations and Growth teams to ensure critical tasks are completed within our SLAs
  • Reviewing and improving our production support process
  • Identifying key tasks to automate and automating as many Business-As-Usual tasks as possible so you can focus on high-value problems
  • Using our monitoring tools to identify performance issues and working with our Platform Engineer to resolve them
  • Collaborate with the product team to provide feedback on user experience and identify areas for improvement
  • Provide training and support to the wider team on technical issues
  • Create technical documentation for our internal knowledge base

Skills and Experience:

We do not require previous work experience; however, we do need a baseline level of software development knowledge in order for you to be as effective in your role as possible. This includes:

  • Knowledge of Javascript/Typescript
  • Knowledge of SQL databases (PostgresQL is a plus)
  • Good communication skills
  • A data-driven mindset - you are able to interrogate metrics and analytics to inform decisions

What We’re Looking For

  • A motivated engineer who wants to grow their technical skillset in the early stages of their career
  • An engineer who can communicate with non-technical stakeholders and helps them to understand issues
  • A data-driven person who can spot opportunities through analysis to improve processes and help to implement them
  • Someone who wants to grow into a Product Engineer role

Be prepared to work hard! Ultimately, we’re looking for smart, hardworking & motivated people who get stuff done & are committed to contributing to a great team. So, if you’re excited about what we’re doing, get in touch – definitely don’t be put off if you don’t tick every box!

Our application process:

  • Initial chat with our HR team
  • Hiring manager chat (Head of Engineering)
  • Technical interview (TS & SQL based, AI allowed)
  • Team interviews - two interviews, one with two members of our Engineering team and one with two of your key stakeholders in Customer Support/Operations(this is as much for you to get a better sense of us!)

Benefits:

We’re working hard to create a working environment where people feel empowered to do their very best work, make a big impact, and enjoy what they do. Specifically, our benefits package includes:

  • A competitive salary – we proactively review salaries to make sure you get what you deserve
  • Meaningful share options – own a part of Penfold and share in our success
  • Medical insurance through Confido
  • Unlimited holiday – we’re interested in your output, not how many holidays you go on!
  • Hybrid working – we like people to come into our office (so you need to live in Tallinn) at least a couple of days a week to collaborate, but we trust you to get your work done in whatever environment suits you
  • Free access to mental health therapy provided by Spill
  • Great community office space in the heart of Tallinn
  • Free drinks & snacks + company lunch every week
  • Laptop and WFH equipment as required
  • Learning and Professional Development – we conduct regular 360 feedback and focus on role progression that suits each individual
  • Quarterly company socials + regular team meetups throughout the year
  • Plus a host of other benefits – see here: https://getpenfold.com/careers

—
We are 100% committed to building a diverse and representative team. Whatever your race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability - we want to hear from you. If you have questions about the role or the company or the interview process, please let your recruiter know and we’re happy to answer these anonymously if that makes you feel more comfortable.

We’re all about giving every candidate the best chance to shine. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the job description, application, or selection process, just let us know — we’d be happy to help. When it comes to hiring, we focus only on your skills, experience, and how you live our values.

As part of our hiring process, we may record your interview and use AI tools to generate notes. This helps us capture details accurately and ensures a fair review by our hiring panel. By attending an interview with Penfold, you consent to the use of recording and AI-generated notes for this purpose. If you have any concerns or would prefer not to be recorded, please let us know in advance.

As we’re a regulated business, any offer (and ongoing employment) depends on passing the usual pre-employment and regulatory checks, which are started before your first day.

title: Product Owner
description:
Jesteś osobą zaangażowaną, otwartą na zmiany i gotową na nowe wyzwania? Szukasz rozwiązań zamiast problemów? Cenisz współpracę i masz kreatywne podejście?

Dołącz do naszego zespołu!

🔍 Oczekujemy od Ciebie:

  • wykształcenia wyższego

  • doświadczenia w tworzeniu i rozwijaniu produktów IT

  • proaktywnego podejścia do realizowanych zadań

  • samodzielności i odpowiedzialności

  • swobodnego i jasnego komunikowania swoich koncepcji

  • bardzo dobrej organizacji pracy

  • umiejętności pracy w zespole

  • umiejętnego zarządzania zmianą

  • umiejętności prezentowania rozwiązań

  • otwartości i kreatywności w kreowaniu kierunków rozwoju produktów

Mile widziane:

  • doświadczenie w pracy w metodykach zwinnych

  • umiejętności sprzedażowe

  • identyfikowaniem potrzeb Klienta w zakresie rozwoju produktów

  • przekładaniem potrzeb i wymagań Klienta na zadania dla zespołów produktowych

  • definiowaniem i określaniem priorytetów dla zadań realizowanych przez zespoły produktowe

  • planowaniem i monitorowaniem prac zespołów produktowych

  • wsparciem zespołów produktowych w realizacji zadań

  • definiowaniem, rozwijaniem i dotrzymywaniem kryteriów ukończenia dla produktów

  • współpracą z Kierownikami Projektów w zakresie realizacji projektów

  • tworzymy od ponad 30 lat zaawansowane oprogramowanie dla największego operatora pocztowego w Polsce

  • z naszych produktów korzysta codziennie ponad 30 tysięcy użytkowników

  • pracujemy przy dużych projektach

  • zespoły SCRUMowe rozwijają kilkanaście naszych produktów

  • proponujemy wynagrodzenie adekwatne do posiadanego doświadczenia i umiejętności

  • oferujemy dostęp do MyBenefit, Multisport, prywatnej opieki medycznej i stomatologicznej

  • zapewniamy ergonomiczne stanowiska pracy

  • stawiamy na rozwój Twoich kompetencji - organizujemy szkolenia z ekspertami dziedzinowymi, zapewniamy dostęp do platformy szkoleniowej

  • zapewniamy świetną atmosferę, tworzoną przez wszystkich, nie mamy dress codu 😉

  • nasze wartości - to nie puste słowa, kierujemy się nimi każdego dnia

title: ServiceNow QA Engineer
description:
Astek

Założona w 1988 roku we Francji Grupa Astek jest światowym partnerem w obszarze doradztwa inżynieryjnego oraz IT. Dzięki swojej wiedzy specjalistycznej w wielu sektorach przemysłowych i technologicznych, Astek wspiera międzynarodowych Klientów w rozwijaniu i wdrażaniu produktów oraz usług, jednocześnie uczestnicząc w ich transformacji cyfrowej.

Grupa Astek od momentu powstania opiera swój rozwój na kulturze przedsiębiorczości i innowacyjności oraz na budowaniu umiejętności swoich ponad 10 000 pracowników, którzy codziennie uczestniczą w zróżnicowanych projektach technologicznych i inżynieryjnych.

Dołącz do silnie rozwijającej się we Francji i na całym świecie Grupy, której obroty w 2025 r. wyniosły 730 milionów euro.

Zapraszamy na https://astek.net po więcej szczegółów.

Stanowisko

Obecnie dla naszego klienta z branży telekomunikacyjnej, poszukujemy kandydata/kandydatki na stanowisko ServiceNow QA Engineer

Dodatkowe informacje

Model pracy w 100% zdalny

Oferowane wynagrodzenie

Wynagrodzenie: do 650 PLN netto/dzień, w zależności od posiadanego doświadczenia i kompetencji

Sprawdzisz się w tej roli, jeżeli:

  • masz doświadczenie jako QA / Software Tester

  • znasz w praktyce testy funkcjonalne, end-to-end i integracyjne

  • prowadziłeś/aś lub realizowałeś/aś UAT

  • potrafisz analizować defekty i zgłoszenia od biznesu

  • pracowałeś/aś z User Stories i znasz proces obsługi defektów

  • znasz metodykę Agile/Scrum

  • dobrze współpracujesz z developerami, BA i biznesem

  • swobodnie komunikujesz się po angielsku (C1)

Mile widziane:

  • doświadczenie w projektach ServiceNow, szczególnie HRSD

  • praca bezpośrednio z biznesem

Zadania, które na Ciebie czekają:

  • udział w warsztatach dotyczących projektowania rozwiązań

  • testy funkcjonalne, end-to-end i integracyjne dostarczanych rozwiązań

  • przygotowanie i realizacja testów akceptacyjnych wspólnie z Business Analystami

  • organizacja i prowadzenie UAT z przedstawicielami biznesu

  • analiza feedbacku, zgłoszeń i defektów oraz identyfikowanie przyczyn problemów

  • rejestrowanie defektów i User Stories dotyczących poprawek i usprawnień

  • monitorowanie poprawek realizowanych w ServiceNow

  • testowanie bug fixów i kolejnych aktualizacji systemu

  • testy funkcjonalne enhancementów i poprawek realizowanych przez zespół Run

  • udział w ceremoniach Agile

  • bieżące raportowanie postępów prac

Nasz proces rekrutacji

Rozmowa z naszym Rekruterem -> Rozmowa z naszym Business Managerem -> Spotkanie z Klientem

W uzasadnionych przypadkach po rozmowie z Rekruterem wprowadzamy dodatkowy etap weryfikacji technicznej

Potrzebujesz więcej informacji? Skontaktuj się ze mną: [justyna.placzkiewicz@astek.net]

Skontaktujemy się tylko z wybranymi kandydatami.

Co oferujemy

  • Długoterminowa współpraca

  • Szkolenia techniczne, certyfikaty i podnoszenie kwalifikacji

  • Mentoring Competence Center - bycie członkiem społeczności CC od pierwszego dnia pracy jest szansą na rozwijanie swoich umiejętności, uczestniczenie w różnych konferencjach oraz dzielenie się wiedzą i doświadczeniem z ludźmi, którzy na co dzień mierzą się z tymi samymi wyzwaniami

  • Jasna ścieżka kariery

  • Pakiet benefitów pracowniczych (Multisport, prywatna opieka medyczna, ubezpieczenie na życie)

  • Przyjazną atmosferę pracy, imprezy integracyjne i spotkania team-buildingowe

System rekomendacji

Znasz kogoś, kogo zainteresuje ta oferta? Skorzystaj z naszego systemu rekomendacji i zgarnij bonus do 7000 zl!

Link: https://astek.pl/system-rekomendacji/

Klauzula informacyjna

Administratorem Pana/Pani danych osobowych jest ASTEK Polska sp. z o.o. z siedziba w Warszawie (00-133) przy Al. Jana Pawla II 22. Przysługuje Pani/Panu prawo do wglądu do danych, prawo żądania usunięcia danych itp. Szczegółowe informacje dotyczace przetwarzania:

W dowolnym momencie przysługuje Panu/Pani prawo do wycofania wyrażonych zgód. W razie wycofania zgód prosimy o kontakt e-mailowy na adresprivacy@astek.netlub pisemnie na adres administratora.

Procedura dokonywania zgłoszeń przez sygnalistów w ASTEK Polska sp. z o. o.: https://astek.pl/sygnalisci/

title: ETIC, Project Manager - Associate (German Speakers)
description:
Line of Service

Advisory

Industry/Sector

Technology

Specialism

Advisory - Other

Management Level

Associate

Job Description & Summary

At PwC, our people in project portfolio management focus on optimising project portfolios to drive strategic business outcomes. These individuals oversee project selection, prioritisation, and resource allocation to facilitate successful project delivery.

In project management at PwC, you will oversee and coordinate various projects to facilitate successful delivery within budget and timeline. You will leverage strong organisational and communication skills to effectively manage teams and stakeholders.

About Us

For our Consulting business unit, we are looking for motivated professionals from ETIC to join our German team on exciting consulting projects in the area of Portfolio, Program and Project Management (PPM). As part of our Team, you can expect a structured entry into the world of consulting with extensive training opportunities, a strong international network, and the chance to take on responsibility from day one.


Your Responsibilities – What to Expect

  • Consulting projects: You support digitalization and transformation projects for clients across industries such as Commercial, Financial Services, and the Public Sector – applying both agile and traditional project management approaches as well as modern digital PPM tools.
  • Project management: You contribute to the Project Management Office (PMO) and help ensure transparency on progress, risks, dependencies, and budgets across projects, programs, and portfolios.
  • Methods & frameworks: You work with established methodologies such as Scrum, SAFe, PRINCE2, or classic process models, and apply them together with the team.
  • Personal development: You gain exposure to complex, large-scale projects across a variety of industries and grow professionally through targeted trainings and internationally recognized certifications.
  • Team & business development: You become part of an international team, actively contributing to the growth of our PPM services and expanding your professional network within PwC.


Your Profile – What You Bring

  • You have successfully completed (or are about to complete) your studies in Business Administration/Economics, (Business) Information Technology, (Industrial) Engineering, or a comparable field of study.
  • Ideally, you have already gained some practical experience through internships, working student positions, or thesis work in the areas of project management, PMO, or consulting.
  • You have an interest in project management methodologies (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, PRINCE2, PMI, IPMA) as well as digital PPM tools. Initial certifications are a plus, but not a requirement – we will support you with relevant training.
  • You are analytically and conceptually strong, work in a structured manner, and enjoy collaborating within a team.
  • Your strong communication skills and confident demeanor help you engage with colleagues and clients on equal footing.
  • Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken, round off your profile. (German at least C1 – this is a mandatory requirement for this role.)


What We Offer

  • Structured career entry with clear development perspectives
  • Mentoring from experienced colleagues in our German PPM team
  • Extensive trainings and certifications (e.g. PRINCE2, Scrum, SAFe)
  • International working environment with close collaboration between ETIC and Germany
  • Flexible working arrangements – predominantly remote work
  • Attractive compensation

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (AI & Automation Platform) (All Genders)
company: Schaeffler Global Services Europe Sp. z o.o.
description:
Your Key Responsibilities

  • Building and maintaining scalable and reliable cloud infrastructure for AI process automation platforms

  • Ensuring operable and securing cloud-based solution architecture for custom-developed, open-source, and off-the-shelf applications

  • Acting as technical consultant for internal colleagues and collect their feedback to ensure a successful user experience

  • Establishing and maintaining logging, monitoring and alerting systems to proactively identify and resolve performance issues

  • Taking on the technical responsibility of applications throughout the life cycle as part of a DevOps team

  • Driving improvements of the automation level of our operations towards self-service

  • Close collaboration with external software vendors for managing, developing, and maintaining IT systems

  • Building and maintaining disaster recovery and business continuity plans for mission-critical applications and infrastructure

  • Ensuring compliance with security policies and standards, working with security and compliance teams as necessary

Your Qualifications

  • University degree in (business) informatics or alternative training with relevant professional experience in this field

  • At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in this field

  • Strong automation and infrastructure as code mindset backed by proven experience in using Terraform and CI/CD technologies like Jenkins or GitHub Actions

  • Experience with DevOps workflows for infrastructure management and automated incident response

  • Proven experience in installing, configuring, maintaining and managing support operations with third party software in secured and enterprise ready private cloud environments

  • Profound knowledge about common patterns for secure service-to-service connectivity and modern authentication protocols

  • Familiarity with common monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions

  • Hands-on experience working with managed cloud services (AWS or Azure preferred), including compute, storage, databases, and AI services

  • Strong understanding of latest AI technology, like AI Agents, in combination with AI process automation

  • Experience with an additional programming language such as Python

  • Fluency in both Polish and English, with a minimum of B2 level proficiency

  • Knowledge of German is a plus

  • Ability and willingness to coach and to take responsibility for services

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy

  • Eager to learn new technologies and skills (T-Shape philosophy)

  • Proficiency in agile methodologies, with experience working effectively within agile teams and environments, fostering an agile mindset in daily work

  • Willingness to travel up to 10% of the time for work

Our Offer

  • Be a part of a global company & international team with a diverse variety of backgrounds, skills and views.

  • As part of our IT team, you will actively shape the technology and solutions used by Schaeffler

  • Grow with us! Get access to training platforms, internal & external trainings, supporting experts and the real-life challenges, where you will put all your skills in practice.

  • We work in a hybrid working model (or a fully remote in a special cases) with flexible working hours. Our modern office is located in the center of Wroclaw.

  • We offer attractive benefits package, such as medical and dental care, sports card, life insurance for you and your family. We are also providing access to our Mental Comfort Program.

  • Our Cafeteria Platform allows you to choose from various benefit options with points monthly added to your account. Haven’t found what you are looking for? Our concierge will be happy to help!

  • Join our CSR activities, such as tree planting, riverside cleanup, or participate in other charity events.

  • Spend some time with your work colleagues during integrational events such as mountain trekking, city games and workshops. You can join also one of our many Passion Clubs like Foodies, Sports Team and Language Clubs as well!

title: Junior Linux Administrator
description:
Chcesz rozwijać się w administrowaniu systemami Linux? Dołącz do nas!

O projekcie

  • Wsparcie w projektowaniu i dokumentacji: 30%

  • Implementacja nowych rozwiązań (pod nadzorem seniorów): 10%

  • Praca nad narzędziami (skrypty, proste automatyzacje): 20%

  • Obsługa zgłoszeń i pierwsza linia wsparcia: 40%

Czym będziesz się zajmować?

  • wspieraniem w administrowaniu serwerami Linux i urządzeniami sieciowymi pod okiem doświadczonych administratorów;

  • uczestnictwem w obsłudze narzędzi do monitorowania i statystyk;

  • stopniowym wdrażaniem się w administrowanie bazami danych: konfigurację replikacji, tworzenie kopii zapasowych (backupy/dumpy) i inne zadania związane z utrzymaniem baz;

  • wdrażaniem i zarządzaniem systemami z wykorzystaniem Ansible (zdobędziesz umiejętności w zakresie orkiestracji i automatyzacji);

  • współpracą przy utrzymaniu bezpieczeństwa systemów/sieci (HIDS, VPN IPSec/SSL) – nabędziesz wiedzę o zasadach i narzędziach bezpieczeństwa;

  • zdobywaniem doświadczenia w rozwiązaniach wirtualizacyjnych, chmurowych i konteneryzacyjnych;

  • współtworzeniem środowisk proxy i usług o wysokiej dostępności (klastry usług);

  • wdrażaniem rozwiązań CI/CD i integracją z CDN;

  • wsparciem różnych działów IT w rozwiązywaniu bieżących problemów;

  • uczeniem się optymalizacji wydajności, bezpieczeństwa oraz jakości usług zgodnie z potrzebami organizacji.

Pasujesz do nas jeśli:

  • posiadasz podstawowe doświadczenie w administrowaniu systemami Linux (mile widziane 1-2 lata praktyki lub doświadczenie projektowe/prywatne);

  • masz podstawową wiedzę z zakresu bezpieczeństwa teleinformatycznego i chcesz ją pogłębiać;

  • jesteś osobą zaangażowaną, chętną do nauki i otwartą na nowe technologie;

  • cechuje Cię analityczne myślenie i umiejętność rozwiązywania problemów – nawet jeśli czasem potrzebujesz wsparcia bardziej doświadczonego zespołu;

  • jesteś dyspozycyjny w razie awaryjnych sytuacji (choć główna odpowiedzialność za działania w sytuacjach awaryjnych leży po stronie bardziej doświadczonych administratorów, wciąż zależy nam na Twojej gotowości do współpracy);

  • fascynuje Cię IT – chcesz stale rozwijać się w obszarach Linux, DevOps i bezpieczeństwa.

Dlaczego warto dołączyć do #TeamWazdan?

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Industry: pharmaceutical

Remote work: 100%

Project language: English

Project length: 24 months contracts + prolongations.

Start: 02.11.2026

Assignment type: B2B

Summary: The primary objective of the Senior Full Stack Engineer is to contribute to the development of a web portal and mobile-ready website, along with backend APIs and integration services, within an Azure environment. The role emphasizes both frontend and backend development skills, enabling collaboration across various teams to create secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions in a regulated setting.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain responsive web applications using React and/or Angular with TypeScript.

  • Design, build, and operate backend services and REST APIs using C# and .NET on Azure.

  • Implement API integrations, JSON processing, and data transformation across enterprise and data platforms.

  • Integrate applications with Azure Databricks and other data APIs.

  • Build secure cloud solutions using Azure Functions, App Service, API Management, Storage, Key Vault, and Entra ID.

  • Create unit, integration, and automated tests, and contribute to CI/CD using GitHub actions.

  • Monitor and troubleshoot applications using Application Insights, structured logging, and operational diagnostics.

Key Requirements:

  • Strong full stack development experience combining React and/or Angular with TypeScript on the frontend and C#/.NET on the backend.

  • Practical experience designing and integrating REST APIs, working with JSON, and implementing data transformation logic.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure Functions, App Service, API Management, Storage, Key Vault, and Entra ID.

  • Good SQL skills and basic experience with NoSQL databases.

  • Experience integrating applications with Azure Databricks and data APIs.

  • Strong understanding of unit, integration, and automated testing practices.

  • Experience implementing CI/CD using GitHub actions.

  • Working knowledge of Docker and container fundamentals.

  • Experience with Application Insights, logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.

  • Ability to contribute across frontend and backend workstreams, including web portals, mobile-ready websites, APIs, and integration services.

  • Understanding of secure application development and cloud-based identity and access management.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working in regulated environments with strong compliance and quality requirements.

title: India Partnerships & Operations Consultant (Part-Time)
description:
About Cascade

Join Cascade Climate, a philanthropy-backed nonprofit helping overlooked climate solutions with outsized potential move from early promise to durable scale. Cutting emissions remains essential, but it is no longer enough on its own. We diagnose what promising climate solutions need to take hold, then lead ambitious initiatives across science, data, markets, finance, industry, and policy. Our flagship focus is Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW), a carbon removal approach that accelerates natural weathering processes to durably remove CO₂ while benefiting agricultural productivity.

Since launching in 2023, Cascade has earned the support of leading philanthropic organizations including the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Grantham Foundation, Quadrature Climate Foundation, and others. We are a distributed team of accomplished scientists, entrepreneurs, policy strategists, community builders, artists, and operators who lead with humility and intellectual curiosity. We have an unusually high tolerance for sitting with complex, unresolved questions in climate, and little tolerance for leaving them that way.

About the Role

Cascade is seeking a part-time consultant to lead partnerships and operations for a coordinated research network (CRN) on Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in India. The role is responsible for ensuring that ERW field trials are well executed, produce high-quality evidence, and are relevant to agricultural policy and practice in India. The network will connect to Cascade's global research on ERW's carbon removal and agronomic impacts.

The consultant will coordinate field trials with host research institutions, their Principal Investigators and research team, Indian national and local government agencies, and ERW industry partners, as well as working with Cascade's global team. This includes managing the operational requirements of field research, such as importation, transport of lab equipment and materials, and institutional approvals. The consultant will also represent Cascade with research, policy, and industry stakeholders across India.

About You

The ideal candidate is excited to zoom out and see the big picture, but is eager to dive into the operational details. That might look like presenting at stakeholder events and meetings one day, then working through permits, shipments, and approvals the next. They have experience building partnerships and effective systems that move work forward. They bring working knowledge of Indian agriculture, research institutions, and government agencies, and a practical, resourceful approach to operating within them.

A demonstrated record of delivering results on the ground is valued above years of experience. Relevant backgrounds may include policy or agricultural support organizations such as NITI Aayog or PxD, research roles at Indian agricultural universities or agri-startups, coordination of cross-institutional research projects, or research partnership management at an agribusiness.

Major Roles and Responsibilities

  • Build India's ERW research network: Support the establishment of ERW field trial sites with leading government and academic research institutions, in partnership with Cascade's operations and science teams based in the United States. Prioritize soils and cropping systems where trials can most expand knowledge of ERW efficacy and complement state and national agriculture and climate goals. Support site identification, diligence, and operational planning.

  • Keep field trials on track: Monitor and support the launch and execution of field research. Identify challenges and risks to project quality or timeliness, then recommend and carry out solutions with partners in India and Cascade's global team.

  • Make the logistics work: Navigate agricultural input selection, scientific testing, domestic transport, and international importation of equipment and materials, so that the work between the field and scientific laboratories is done according to rules and regulations, and in a timely and cost-effective manner.

  • Build and sustain partnerships: Develop relationships with the Indian Council of Agricultural Research, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare, national and state research and policy stakeholders, agricultural universities, ERW project developers, and industry partners to draw on their varied expertise and facilitate data and insight sharing.

Desired Skills and Experiences

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in the agriculture, agricultural research and/or climate research space in India.

  • Preferred: experience coordinating multi-institutional research projects or partnerships; working with agricultural field research stations, soil science or agricultural research laboratories in India; understanding of Indian agricultural research systems, funding mechanisms, and institutional structures. Particularly valued are agriculture research and/or agricultural policy experience and connections in Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, and/or West Bengal.

  • Languages: English and Hindi fluency required; Bengali fluency preferred.

  • Partnership building: Demonstrated ability to build trust-based relationships and steward joint initiatives with national and state government agencies, policy stakeholders, NGOs, and/or leadership and researchers at scientific institutions. The ability and excitement to build new relationships is essential, and an existing network in Indian agriculture is preferred.

  • Operational follow-through: Experienced project manager who can oversee partners' work planning and logistics, including domestic and international transport and importation. Strong attention to detail to enable coordinating multi-site field trials is essential.

  • Communication and public speaking: Experience presenting program objectives or scientific findings to senior stakeholders, and demonstrated comfort and respect working with people from farmers, field managers, and laboratory technicians to university and government leadership.

  • Interest in the evidence: Understanding of and interest in the evidence for agriculture and/or carbon removal is highly valued. Familiarity with India's agriculture policy landscape, carbon markets, or financing schemes that support farmer adoption of inputs is preferred.

  • Preferred background: A background in soil science, agronomy, climate-smart agriculture, or geochemistry and familiarity with carbon removal, ERW, or soil amendment research is valued but not required.

More broadly, we’re looking for someone who embodies the curiosities and mindsets at the heart of Cascade’s culture:

  • Empathy, humility, and contagious curiosity: evident in how you approach your work and relationships

  • Comfort with complexity: you can embrace tension and hold space for multiple perspectives simultaneously

  • Uncommonly strong self-driven learning habits: evidenced from your past education, work experience, hobbies, and interests

  • Ease with ambiguity: you’re comfortable navigating uncertainty and can chart a path forward without any definite answer

  • High standards with pragmatism: you have naturally high expectations of yourself, and you avoid letting “perfect get in the way of really good” so you can deliver strong work quickly

  • Climate solutions enthusiasm: you're energized to explore diverse approaches to the climate crisis

Cascade is looking for someone to start as soon as possible. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis through November 13, 2026.
Compensation: Cascade offers a competitive monthly retainer and/or hourly rate commensurate with experience and scope. Consultants invoice monthly and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and insurance. As a consultant, this role is not eligible for Cascade’s employee benefits.
Time Commitment: The anticipated commitment is an estimated 50% of time (approximately 20 hours/week or 80 hours/month) for an initial term of 12 months with the possibility of extension. Time allocation will need to flex as work evolves, and we expect open, proactive communication about other commitments.

Location: Cascade is headquartered in the United States. This role will be remote with a preferred location of New Delhi or Kolkata. Frequent travel is expected within India to partner research centers, policy stakeholders, and agricultural field sites with some frequency. Ability and willingness to work across time zones with Cascade employees in the US is required.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in India at the time of application.

title: Senior IT Analyst
description:
General info:
Model of work: hybrid (3x per week work from office Warsaw or Gdańsk or Gdynia

Type of contract: B2B contract, long-term cooperations

Rate: 135 PLN net + vat/ hour

Overview

Join our Channels-Business unit and help shape the future of digital business banking across the Nordic region. Our teams are delivering innovative web and mobile banking solutions used by customers in Denmark, Finland, Sweden, and Norway, while continuously evolving the next generation of digital banking services.

You will be part of a vibrant Channels-Business technology team mainly located in Warsaw, working within one of six agile teams and collaborating across disciplines to design, develop, test, and enhance customer-facing digital products. We are looking for someone who is open and transparent, enjoys working in a team and collaborating with others.

Main Responsibilities

1. Analyze and document business needs, and translate them into clear IT requirements that support scalable and sustainable solutions.

2. Lead delivery in close collaboration with stakeholders across Business, IT and Design, in an agile setup.

3. Actively coordinate with external vendors to ensure aligned requirements and high-quality deliveries.

4. Support manual testing of business or maintenance features in accordance with the priorities.

5. Proactively resolve blockers and manage dependencies across teams to keep work progressing smoothly.

Key Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in IT and/or business analysis within the banking industry.

  • Proven experience defining features and user stories based on business needs, and partnering with Product Owners to plan product and release roadmaps.

  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively with IT teams and business stakeholders.

  • Experience using tools such as JIRA and Confluence.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of digital banking or web application architecture.

  • Familiarity with design and prototyping tools, such as Figma.

title: Commercial Relationship Specialist
location: Sarasota, FL - Downtown Sarasota Ringling Boulevard Office
description:
Thank you for your interest in a career at Regions. At Regions, we believe associates deserve more than just a job. We believe in offering performance-driven individuals a place where they can build a career --- a place to expect more opportunities. If you are focused on results, dedicated to quality, strength and integrity, and possess the drive to succeed, then we are your employer of choice.

Regions is dedicated to taking appropriate steps to safeguard and protect private and personally identifiable information you submit. The information that you submit will be collected and reviewed by associates, consultants, and vendors of Regions in order to evaluate your qualifications and experience for job opportunities and will not be used for marketing purposes, sold, or shared outside of Regions unless required by law. Such information will be stored in accordance with regulatory requirements and in conjunction with Regions’ Retention Schedule for a minimum of three years. You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system.

Job Description:

At Regions, the Commercial Relationship Specialist provides general administrative support to Relationship Managers within Commercial Banking to include Commercial Banking and/or specialized business segments of Agricultural Banking (AG), Government and Institutional Banking (GIB), Small Business Administration (SBA), and Franchise Lending.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Assists Relationship Manager(s) by performing daily support activities related to client relationships and keeps respective Relationship Manager informed when appropriate
  • Acts as a point of contact for Commercial Banking clients for all servicing requests related to client relationships
  • Attends weekly scheduled meetings with Relationship Manager(s) to discuss workflow items such as renewals, new pipeline items, servicing requests, past due reports, etc.
  • Provides reports for Relationship Manager(s) such as 360 Report, Weekly Sales Report, OneView Pipeline Report, Maturities, Past Due and Exception Reporting
  • Facilitates and manages credit application workflow as it applies to the appropriate credit channel including collecting financial information from clients, submitting facility applications and managing loan workflows to closing
  • Manages post-closing requirements including tickler requirements and exception citing's
  • Manages Relationship Manager(s) loan maturity pipeline, ensuring that renewals are approved and closed in a timely manner
  • Acts as a liaison between Credit Products and the Commercial Team with both underwriting and loan fulfillment processes and procedures and manages due diligence requirements from the field
  • Assists Relationship Manager(s) with sales support functions to include marketing requests, client and prospect presentations and building prospect information files
  • Opens new deposit products for clients
  • Works closely with the Treasury Management team to successfully onboard new Treasury Management clients as well as provide the clients with guidance and aid in locating appropriate resources for servicing
  • Maintains consistent data integrity for relationship team’s client accounts within all source systems
  • Maintains OneView administrative data to include updating client contact information, merging client records, managing pipeline reports for renewals and creating prospect/centers of influence (COIs) records
  • Manages data organization within Relationship Grouping Application (RGA) to ensure client records are properly grouped for accurate 360 reporting
  • Provides support if assigned for clients in specialized business segments such as GIB, SBA, AG, and Capital Markets within Commercial Banking
  • Supports Relationship Manager(s) with miscellaneous administrative tasks as assigned
  • May serve as a mentor for new associates

This position requires the tracking of time and is eligible for overtime for hours worked in excess of 40 per week under the Fair Labor Standards Act.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of banking or client support experience
  • Or High School Diploma or GED and three (3) years of general banking experience

Preferences

  • College degree

Skills and Competencies

  • Ability to partner with various internal partners across the organization
  • Ability to research, analyze data and derive facts
  • Advanced verbal, written communication, and organizational skills
  • Advanced work ethic and self-motivation
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

This position may be filled at a higher level depending on the candidate’s qualifications and relevant experience.

Position Type

Full time

title: Program Manager
description:

Are you ready to support critical USSF missions and make a lasting impact?


Amentum is seeking a Program Manager to join our team to support the USSF COBRA DANE Operations and Sustainment (CDOS) in Colorado Springs, CO.


In this pivotal role you will contribute to mission readiness and operational excellence by providing strategic leadership, technical oversight, and innovative solutions advancing enduring mission objectives.


If you excel in collaborative, high-impact environments and are passionate about driving mission success, we want to hear from you. Join Amentum and be part of a team dedicated to innovation, excellence, and delivering mission critical program outcomes.

  • Organizing, directing, and managing contract operations-support functions
  • Leading teams operating across multiple locations;
  • Maintaining senior-level customer and Government interfaces
  • Managing cost, schedule, staffing, risk, technical performance, and contract performance
  • Establishing and maintaining technical and financial reporting;
  • Assigning responsibilities and overseeing task completion;
  • Managing subcontractors and suppliers;
  • Managing contract changes and responding to contract-administration actions;
  • Planning and scheduling program resources;

title: Expert Application Security – Identity & Access Management
description:
B2B, 140-165 pln/h + VAT
Location: Gdynia, Gdansk, Warsaw.
Preferred 3 days per week at the office, but remote work can be accepted

We are looking for an Expert Application Security Specialist to join an ongoing project focused on Identity & Access Management (IAM). This role requires a profile with substantial experience in managing Access groups, User accounts, and Service accounts in the IAM system SailPoint IIQ. You will play a key role in the onboarding and cleanup of access groups, collaborating with stakeholders from both Business and IT to ensure seamless integration with SailPoint IIQ.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Access review and analysis of application security and user access management.

  • Analyze access-related data to identify inactive, excessive, or unnecessary user permissions.

  • Assess findings and recommend appropriate actions based on business requirements.

  • Engage, collaborate, and facilitate dialogues with stakeholders to gather necessary information.

  • Engage with RACF/IAM subject matter experts to formulate suggestions for actions and mitigations.

  • Facilitate the onboarding to SailPoint IIQ or cleanup of access groups, user access, and service accounts.

  • Facilitate discussions to resolve conflicting requirements and priorities.

  • Assist in prioritizing efforts and managing scope changes.

  • Identify risks and propose mitigation strategies.

Key Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, or a related field.

  • Proven experience as an Identity Application Security Specialist, Application Manager, or User admin in IIQ.

  • Good understanding of applications and Identity Access Management.

  • Self-driven and motivated with a collaborative mindset.

  • Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with project support and change management concepts.

  • Experience with stakeholder coordination in access management projects.

title: Junior/Mid Business Owner (Decision Experience)
description:
Invia x x is one of the largest travel groups in Europe. Every year we help more than 6 million people plan their trips. Behind that sit teams in IT, Product, Data, Marketing, HR, Finance, Sales and Customer Experience, who build the tools and services those travelers use. Whichever team you join, your work shows up in how people plan and experience their holidays.

Your next stop:

We are looking for a Business Owner to take ownership of the Decision Experience area and develop solutions that support customers when they are choosing an offer. This role combines business, operational and technology perspectives, with a focus on process optimisation, the quality of the data presented and the effectiveness of lead generation.

What lis ahead on your journey

  • Developing and optimising the Decision Experience area, which is responsible for presenting offers and supporting lead generation,

  • Ensuring that the offer selection process is as intuitive as possible for customers and free of technical barriers,

  • Overseeing the quality, completeness and consistency of the data presented on the website,

  • Monitoring application performance, identifying issues and coordinating corrective actions,

  • Analysing the root causes of errors and initiating actions to prevent them from recurring,

  • Defining business requirements and working with IT teams and Product Owners to deliver improvements,

  • Evaluating the impact of implemented changes against business goals and user experience,

  • Preparing analyses and recommendations that support product development and process optimisation.

What to pack in your suitcase:

  • At least 2 years of experience in the travel industry in a similar role or in a position related to Business Analysis, Product Development, Process Optimisation or business area management,

  • Knowledge of the processes and mechanisms that drive the travel industry,

  • Analytical thinking and the ability to draw conclusions from data,

  • Very good command of Excel, especially pivot tables and working with large datasets,

  • Ability to monitor KPIs and identify areas for improvement,

  • Good understanding of technology topics and the ability to work with IT teams,

  • Understanding of the relationships between systems, data and business processes,

  • Independence, a sense of responsibility and a proactive attitude in your day-to-day work,

  • Fluent Polish,

  • Good communication skills in English, allowing you to work comfortably in an international environment.

Extra baggage of experience:

  • Familiarity with the e-commerce environment and user experience processes,

  • Hands-on experience with analytics tools such as Google Analytics or Power BI.

What you will find on board:

  • Possibility to work in a remote model with occasional visits to the Gdańsk and Wrocław offices,

  • Opportunities for professional development aligned with current business needs and your individual career goals

  • A benefits cafeteria platform – we do not decide what siuts for you, you can choose from life insurance, a sports card, and lunch and shopping vouchers,

  • Cooperation in international environment,

  • Access to Audioteka and Pilot WP, helping you balance personal development with moments of relaxation,

  • An openness to innovation and AI-powered tools that support our daily work and help us achieve even better results,

  • Discounts on our products for you, your family, and friends,

  • Comfortable offices in convenient locations (Gdańsk – Alchemia, Wrocław – Legnicka Business Garden, Warsaw – Business Garden Włochy), along with a friendly and informal atmosphere that encourages collaboration,

  • Option to join International educational trips, so you can see the destinations and hotels from our portfolio for yourself,

  • A culture built on trust, open communication, feedback, and appreciation (because the best journeys begin with a great team),

  • Team where #Explore #Engage #Enjoy build our travel mindset.

Get to know us better and see what our everyday journey looks like: Instagram, LinkedIn, Tiktok, Facebook.

title: Commercial Plumbing Technician
description:
Location: Durham, NC


Who We Are

At JD Service Now, we've been serving Durham and the surrounding areas for over 20+ years. We're a team that takes pride in quality work, great customer service, and taking care of our people. We believe in working hard, supporting each other, and creating opportunities to grow. We want to be the last place you call home!


What We Offer

  • Competitive weekly pay with bonus opportunities
  • 85% company-paid medical insurance
  • 100% company-paid dental, vision, and life insurance
  • Company-matched 401(k)
  • 8 paid holidays and accrued PTO
  • Company-provided truck with gas, maintenance, and tolls covered
  • Ongoing training and career development
  • Uniforms provided

As a Commercial Plumbing Technician, we're looking for someone who can:

  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain commercial plumbing systems.
  • Perform plumbing installations and service work safely and efficiently.
  • Communicate findings and solutions clearly to customers.
  • Complete accurate job notes and service documentation.
  • Work independently while collaborating with dispatch and other team members.
  • Maintain a clean, organized truck and professional appearance.
  • Participate in an 24/7 on-call rotation of one week every five weeks.
  • Show up on time, ready to work, and consistently deliver quality service.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 3 years of plumbing experience required.
  • Commercial plumbing experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license with a good driving record.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Reliable, punctual, and able to manage time effectively.
  • Professional attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn.
  • Ability to pass a pre-employment background check and drug screening.

If you want to make a splash in your career, take pride in your work, show up when you're needed, and want to be part of a team that has your back, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!

Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Teacher we will:

  • Invest in you and your career at KinderCare as you create a world-class experience in our classrooms
  • Reward your commitment to our children and families as your journey continues with us

When you join our team as a Teacher you will:

  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Physically able to lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $16.55 - $16.55 Hourly

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.


.

KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

title: Senior Network Engineer (Cisco)
description:
Be | Shaping the Future Poland, part of the Engineering Group, is a technology and business consulting company founded in 2013. We help organisations in financial services and other industries turn complex requirements into reliable, end-to-end solutions, drawing on expertise in software engineering, cloud and infrastructure, data, and quality assurance.

Location: Remote

On-call / maintenance activities outside business hours

Responsibilities

  • Planning customer networks in the ACI and legacy environment for new and existing customers

  • Planning the infrastructure based on ticket information (creation of low-level design documents)

  • Coordination of the necessary steps with the various infrastructure areas such as Windows, Unix, Database and Storage

  • Creation of service requests for the implementation of the design documents

  • Carrying out the planned configurations

  • Quality assurance of the configurations as well as analysis and troubleshooting according to company's process specifications

  • Creation and implementation of changes

  • Definition of the network concept (HLD/LLD)

  • Documentation in accordance with the company's documentation guidelines

Requirements

  • Cisco Networking, Cisco ACI, load balancer F5

  • Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills

  • Experience working in complex enterprise or banking environments

  • Understanding of change management and production support processes

  • High attention to detail and strong ownership mindset

  • Good communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Fluent English

  • Availability to participate in evening and weekend maintenance activities on a regular basis

Why join us

  • Competitive B2B rate, aligned with your experience and the project

  • Long-term projects for leading international organisations

  • Continuous growth through internal DevTalks, online and onsite

  • A collaborative, international team within the Engineering Group

  • Optional Medicover, Multisport and Mindgram packages at preferential rates

  • Free access to the gym at our Q22 office

  • Referral program: a bonus for every successful recommendation
