title: Specjalista/Specjalistka ds. Cyberbezpieczeństwa
description:
Dołącz do naszego zespołu InfoSec w renomowanej firmie IT!

Czym będziesz się zajmować?

  • Monitorowaniem i analizą zagrożeń cybernetycznych oraz podejmowaniem działań zapobiegawczych.

  • Współpracą z zespołami IT w zakresie poprawy bezpieczeństwa systemów i aplikacji.

  • Uczestniczeniem w audytach bezpieczeństwa oraz rekomendowaniem usprawnień.

  • Wspieraniem w implementacji i przestrzeganiu norm bezpieczeństwa (np. ISO27001).

Pasujesz do nas, jeśli:

  • Masz dobre rozeznanie w ogólnych zagadnieniach IT (software i hardware).

  • Posiadasz wiedzę z zakresu InfoSec, w tym znajomość aktualnych zagrożeń w cyberbezpieczeństwie.

  • Dążysz do samodzielnego poszerzania wiedzy w obszarze cyberbezpieczeństwa i jej praktycznego zastosowania.

  • Masz proaktywne podejście do realizowanych zadań oraz pozytywne nastawienie.

  • Posiadasz umiejętność współpracy zespołowej oraz budowania relacji w zespole.

  • Jesteś osobą komunikatywną – jasno wyrażasz myśli i potrafisz aktywnie słuchać.

  • Myślisz kreatywnie oraz potrafisz podjąć inicjatywny przy rozwiązywaniu problemów.

  • Jesteś osobą odpowiedzialną i starannie wykonujesz powierzone zadania.

Mile widziane:

  • Posiadasz znajomość systemów operacyjnych Linux i Windows.

  • Masz wykształcenie wyższe na kierunku informatycznym.

  • Masz roczne doświadczenie w pracy na podobnym stanowisku.

  • Znasz język angielski w stopniu umożliwiającym swobodną komunikację.

  • Masz wiedzę z zakresu norm bezpieczeństwa, takich jak ISO27001.

  • Posiadasz umiejętność przeprowadzania testów penetracyjnych aplikacji webowych.

Dlaczego warto dołączyć do #TeamWazdan?

  • Podejmiesz współpracę z międzynarodową firmą, będącą jednym z liderów w swojej branży na rynku polskim i znaczącym graczem na rynku globalnym.

  • Oferujemy stabilne zatrudnienie w oparciu o preferowaną przez Ciebie formę współpracy oraz atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie, uzależnione od Twojej wiedzy i kwalifikacji.

  • Będziesz współpracować z doświadczonym zespołem przy użyciu nowoczesnych technologii, dzięki czemu podniesiesz swoje kwalifikacje.

  • Otrzymasz szeroki pakiet benefitów, .: kartę Medicover, prywatną opiekę medyczną LuxMed, kartę Pyszne Pay, paczki świąteczne.

  • Dbamy o dobrą atmosferę, oferując pracę w zintegrowanym i kreatywnym zespole z poszanowaniem równowagi między pracą i życiem prywatnym.

Jeśli Twoje CV wpisze się w nasze oczekiwania spodziewaj się:

1. Telefonu lub maila od zespołu HR.

2. Technicznego spotkania online z szefem działu i reprezentantem działu HR.

3. Jeśli pozytywnie przejdziesz rozmowę możesz się spodziewać: zadania do wykonania w domu lub pogłębionej rozmowy technicznej.

4. W ostatnim etapie możesz spodziewać się oferty, bądź podziękowania za udział w rekrutacji.

Uprzejmie informujemy, że skontaktujemy się tylko z wybranymi kandydatami.

title: Producer I, News
description:
The News Producer produces daily newscast items, decides the order in which stories will be told, writes teases and other content, times news programs, edits video, and posts video to the website.

  • Produces newscasts for broadcast across all platforms
  • Writes and orders news stories
  • Approves scripts
  • Balances news and feature content to create compelling broadcasts
  • Edits video
  • Writes stories for the website and other eMedia platforms
  • Interacts with viewers and users on social media sites
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Requirements & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience
  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
  • Minimum two years’ experience in news operations (Depending on market size)
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Flexibility to work any shift

Pay Range: $33,280-$35,360 salary plan

Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, life insurance, Paid Parental Leave and more.

title: MLOps Engineer
description:
Kogo szukamy:

Szukamy osoby, która lubi porządkować sprawy, zwraca uwagę na szczegóły i dobrze odnajduje się w codziennych wyzwaniach. Ważne jest dla nas, żebyś potrafił/a w prosty sposób wyjaśniać techniczne zagadnienia i szukać rozwiązań, które ułatwiają pracę zespołom data science i machine learning.

Rola i zespół:

Nasz zespół tworzy i utrzymuje infrastrukturę oraz procesy, dzięki którym modele machine learning i rozwiązania oparte na AI mogą sprawnie działać na produkcji. Blisko współpracujemy z zespołami, pomagając im przejść od eksperymentów do gotowych rozwiązań, które działają stabilnie, bezpiecznie i nie generują niepotrzebnych kosztów.

Co będziesz robić:

  • Dbać o to, żeby infrastruktura wykorzystywana do trenowania i uruchamiania modeli działała sprawnie, była dostępna i dobrze wykorzystywała zasoby. Będziesz pracować zarówno z GPU, chmurą, jak i infrastrukturą on-prem, dopasowując je do potrzeb zespołów.

  • Tworzyć i rozwijać procesy CI/CD dla modeli ML, obejmujące trening, walidację, wdrażanie i wycofywanie modeli.

  • Zarządzać rejestrem modeli, śledzeniem eksperymentów oraz wersjonowaniem artefaktów i cech.

  • Wdrażać modele na produkcję i tworzyć narzędzia, szablony oraz rozwiązania self-service, które pozwolą zespołom szybciej i samodzielnie przechodzić od pomysłu do wdrożenia.

  • Monitorować działanie modeli na produkcji, w tym zmiany jakości, drift i wykorzystanie zasobów. Wprowadzać rozwiązania, które pomagają szybko reagować na problemy, takie jak alerty czy automatyczny rollback.

  • Rozwijać standardy i dokumentację MLOps, a także wspierać infrastrukturę dla rozwiązań GenAI i modeli LLM. Obejmuje to . bramki do modeli, routing zapytań, kontrolę kosztów, systemy agentowe.

Czego od Ciebie oczekujemy?

  • Doświadczenia: praktycznej znajomości procesów CI/CD dla modeli ML, wdrażania i utrzymywania modeli na produkcji.

  • Technologii i narzędzi: znajomości Pythona, SQL, Dockera, Kubernetesa/EKS oraz usług AWS wykorzystywanych w ML, takich jak S3 i zasoby obliczeniowe. Przydadzą Ci się również narzędzia do śledzenia eksperymentów i zarządzania modelami, np. MLflow, orkiestracji pipeline’ów ML, np. Dagster, Airflow lub Kubeflow, oraz obsługi modeli LLM, np. LiteLLM. Ważna jest także znajomość Snowflake, szczególnie w kontekście wydajnego i ekonomicznego pobierania danych i cech, a także Gita, Terraforma i narzędzi do monitorowania usług oraz jakości modeli.

  • Podejścia do pracy: umiejętności tłumaczenia technicznych zagadnień w prosty sposób, reagowania na nieprzewidziane problemy i dokładności w konfiguracji środowisk. Zależy nam również na osobie, która jest otwarta na potrzeby innych zespołów i potrafi szukać rozwiązań ułatwiających im codzienną pracę.

  • Języków: znajomości polskiego i angielskiego na poziomie co najmniej B2.

Możliwości rozwoju:

  • Praca w zespole, który stawia na eksperymentowanie i innowacje, dając Ci przestrzeń do wdrażania własnych pomysłów i rozwiązań, u nas masz realny wpływ na rozwój projektów, produktów i usług.

  • Rozwój umiejętności w pracy z nowoczesnymi narzędziami AI – inwestujemy w najnowsze technologie i doskonalimy procesy wewnętrzne, abyś zawsze był na bieżąco w branży technologicznej.

  • Budżety zespołowe na specjalistyczne szkolenia i kursy dostosowane do Twoich potrzeb.

  • Wymiana wiedzy w ramach tematycznych gildii organizowanych przez współpracowników – dzięki temu możesz być na bieżąco w swojej dziedzinie lub zdobywać nowe umiejętności.

Co najbardziej doceniają Twoi przyszli współpracownicy:

  • Prywatna opieka LuxMed, bezpłatne badania profilaktyczne oraz masaże odciążające kręgosłup.

  • Budżet na doposażenie stanowiska pracy zdalnej oraz vouchery podarunkowe.

  • Śniadania w formie bufetu przygotowywane na miejscu.

  • Wyjazdy integracyjne i rodzinne do prywatnego ośrodka nad jeziorem.

  • Dofinansowanie karty Multisport.

title: IT Inspector / Auditor
company: BNP Paribas SA oddział w Polsce
description:
We are BNP Paribas S.A. (Branch in Poland), a part of BNP Paribas Group with 200 years of experience in banking. Since 2008, we are at the heart of Warsaw, and now we are also in a brand-new location in Krakow. As Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB), we offer financial solutions for corporate and institutional clients in a number of locations globally.

Join our team as an IT Inspector / Auditor and play a key role in ensuring IT and cybersecurity compliance of BNP Paribas Group entities worldwide.

IT Inspector / Auditor


Requirements:

  • Master's degree in IT, computer science, mathematics, or a related field.

  • Minimum 2 years of professional experience in IT audit/IT control.

  • Fluency in English – min. C1 level.

  • Basic knowledge of IT management processes (IT governance, IT application development, IT production, IT continuity, cybersecurity, IT third party management),

  • Basic knowledge of main IT technology solutions (DBMS, OS, LAN/WAN/WLAN/SAN etc.),

  • Basic knowledge of technical solutions in the field of cybersecurity, including IAM, firewall, SIEM, and SOAR systems.

  • Knowledge of main standards of IT audit, IT control and IT security, such as COBIT, ITIL, ISO 27000, and MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

  • Accuracy, reliability and credibility.

  • A strong commitment to business travel abroad (minimum 4-5 weeks, 3 times a year, mostly in Europe).

Responsibilities:

  • Perform audit assignments in the IT/cybersecurity area as part of the 3rd line of defence in BNP Group entities worldwide, identify risks and prepare audit plans, scopes and methodologies.

  • Present audit approach to auditees, conduct audit tests and formulate findings and recommendations.

  • Prepare and verify post-audit documentation, including audit reports, to ensure accuracy and completeness.

  • Conduct annual risk analyses in relation to the IT/cybersecurity area in dedicated audit units of the BNP Group.

title: Wellness Mentor | Community Drop-In

description:
CSPNJ, a mental health nonprofit agency, is looking for a part-time Wellness Mentor(s). Under the direction of the Wellness Center Manager, the Wellness Mentor acts as a leader and role model for members, visitors, and community members. This position works directly with the Center Manager and in collaboration with the members to plan, implement, and maintain Wellness Center operations.


HIGHLIGHTS

  • Work with the manager to support the Agency mission by meeting and identifying needs of the local community and make connections with other relevant organizations and agencies.

  • Offer information and referral to members regarding wellness and recovery, peer support and community services.


Part Time | 35 Hours p/w | Benefit Eligible (Medical, free DMO dental & free vision) including PTO & 11 Holidays

description:

  • Umiejętność skutecznego delegowania zadań, egzekwowania rezultatów i rozliczania realizacji zobowiązań.

  • Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu wielu równoległych inicjatyw projektowych.

  • Umiejętność zarządzania priorytetami, ryzykiem i zależnościami pomiędzy zespołami.

  • Doświadczenie we współpracy z biznesem oraz kadrą menedżerską.

  • Praktyczna znajomość Agile oraz nowoczesnych praktyk zarządzania organizacjami technologicznymi.

  • Otwartość na wykorzystanie AI w zarządzaniu, wytwarzaniu oprogramowania oraz optymalizacji procesów.

  • Silne kompetencje liderskie, organizacyjne i komunikacyjne.

  • Orientacja na rezultat i umiejętność przejmowania odpowiedzialności za wynik pracy zespołu.

Kluczowe wskaźniki sukcesu na stanowisku

  • Terminowa realizacja projektów i inicjatyw przez zespoły frontend i backend.

  • Wysoka przewidywalność delivery oraz realizacja uzgodnionych zobowiązań.

  • Efektywne wykorzystanie capacity zespołów.

  • Wysoka satysfakcja interesariuszy biznesowych i klientów.

  • Rozwój kompetencji liderów technicznych i programistów.

  • Realizacja celów budżetowych oraz operacyjnych.

Oferujemy

  • Poczucie stabilności – zatrudnienie na umowę o pracę w firmie, która od lat konsekwentnie buduje swoją pozycję w branży finansowo – technologicznej,

  • Realny wpływ na projekty i inicjatywy, które wspierają funkcjonowanie rynku finansowego w Polsce i za granicą – bezpośrednia współpraca z zarządem,

title: Cabinet Installer
description:
Cabinet Installer


$30–$38/hr | $1,500 Sign-On Bonus Nashua, NH | Full-Time | Year-Round Work


Build Your Career With Norfolk!


The Norfolk Companies is looking for an experienced Cabinet Installer to join our residential remodeling team.

We're a fourth-generation, family-owned company established in 1934. We take pride in quality craftsmanship, great customer service, and creating an environment where skilled tradespeople can grow.


Why Join Norfolk?

  • Competitive pay: $30–$38/hour, based on experience.
  • $1,500 sign-on bonus.
  • Steady, year-round employment.
  • Full-time hours.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) with company match.
  • Opportunities for career growth.
  • Work with an established, family-owned company.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and perform residential kitchen and bath remodeling projects.
  • Install cabinetry, trim, and finish carpentry components.
  • Coordinate jobsite activities and keep projects on schedule.
  • Read and interpret plans, measurements, and installation drawings.
  • Ensure quality workmanship and customer satisfaction.
  • Troubleshoot installation challenges.
  • Coordinate with project managers, team members, and homeowners.
  • Maintain a clean and safe jobsite.

What We're Looking For

  • 7-10+ years of professional carpentry or residential remodeling experience.
  • Strong cabinet installation and finish carpentry skills.
  • Previous experience leading projects or working with installation teams.
  • Ability to read construction drawings and work independently.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Reliable transportation and willingness to travel to residential job sites.

Ready for Your Next Opportunity?

Bring your skills to a company that values craftsmanship and the people behind every project.


If you have a strong background in carpentry, kitchen and bath remodeling, or cabinet installation, we'd love to meet you!


The Norfolk Companies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Software Development Engineer with uArch Expertise (Temporary position)
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Join a team developing Fleet and Scale software solutions that are critical to Data Center customers. You will work with internal and external teams to enable high-quality Intel server product launches and improve the in-fleet customer experience. This role is well suited to a quick learner who is results-oriented and comfortable in a dynamic environment.


As a Software Development Engineer with microarchitecture expertise, you will develop, validate, maintain, and debug customer fleet health capabilities and cloud-scale software for platform monitoring, telemetry, diagnostics, and fleet screening. Intel and hyperscale cloud customers use these solutions to improve Xeon platform quality, reliability, and deployment readiness.


Throughout the server product lifecycle, you will collaborate with architecture, platform validation, manufacturing, and customer engineering teams. You will also build customer consumable software that provides visibility into system state, platform telemetry, hardware health indicators, and Intel Architecture internals to help solve in-field and at-scale operational challenges.


Please consider this is a Temporary position (2 years).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain scalable screening and automation software that supports customer fleet health, platform quality, validation, deployment readiness, monitoring, defect detection, and operational efficiency.
  • Design, develop, and optimize telemetry collection, diagnostics, observability, and health monitoring software, primarily using Python and C/C++.
  • Extend existing frameworks and integrate software libraries, services, and infrastructure components to improve visibility into platform state and Intel Architecture internals.
  • Analyze large-scale telemetry and debug data to identify defect signatures, reliability trends, and opportunities for continuous quality improvement.
  • Reproduce, debug, and resolve platform, firmware, and software issues in collaboration with customer-facing engineering teams.
  • Perform root-cause investigations and develop screening methodologies across validation and customer environments.
  • Support customer engagements through validation, deployment, and in-fleet operations.
  • Collaborate across architecture, platform, validation, manufacturing, and customer enablement teams to deliver fleet-ready solutions and drive continuous quality improvements.

What You Bring

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience in software development and debugging using C/C++ and Python within Linux environments, including the development of multithreaded applications, and building solutions for complex server, cloud, high-performance computing, or distributed systems. Familiarity with x86 Architecture and system-level software interactions is also required.

Additionally, the candidate should demonstrate solid knowledge of software development best practices, including Agile methodologies, requirements definition, unit, and regression testing, as well as a strong foundation in data structures, operating systems, and software engineering fundamentals.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications, you must possess the minimum qualifications below to be initially considered for this position.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 6+ years of combined experience in:

    • Developing and debugging software in C/C++ and Python.
    • Developing software in Linux environments.
    • Developing and debugging multithreaded applications.
    • Building solutions for complex server, cloud, high-performance computing, or distributed systems.
    • Working with x86 Architecture systems and system-level software interactions.
    • Applying software development practices, including Agile development, requirements definition, unit testing, and regression testing.
    • Applying data structures, operating systems, and software engineering fundamentals.

Must have unrestricted, permanent authorization to work in Mexico. This position is not eligible for visa or immigration sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

  • Experience developing and debugging in x86 assembly language.
  • Knowledge of Intel Xeon platform and Uncore architecture.
  • Understanding Linux internals, drivers, and runtime environments.
  • Experience with GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, or comparable CI/CD platforms.
  • Experience with cloud-native technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience developing telemetry analytics, diagnostics, platform monitoring, or fleet management solutions.
  • Experience identifying customer needs and translating them into technical improvements that deliver measurable value.
  • Experience working directly with enterprise or hyperscale cloud customers.


We encourage you to bring your unique perspectives, skills, and ideas to Intel as we shape the future of technology together. Explore this incredible opportunity to make an impact, grow technically, and work alongside industry-leading professionals.

Job Type:

Intel Contract Employee

Shift:

Shift 1 (Mexico)

Primary Location:

Mexico, Guadalajara

Additional Locations:

Posting Statement:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.

Position of Trust

N/A

Work Model for this Role

This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change.

*

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.

title: Senior Data Scientist (Procurement Analytics)
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Your role

As a Data Scientist, you will own the data and analytics agenda that underpins strategic decisions across Group Procurement. You will lead the design and delivery of advanced analytics, predictive models and executive dashboards built on procurement systems (iValua, S/HANA, Oracle), while setting standards for data quality and governance. Acting as a trusted advisor to Procurement leadership – Category Managers, Procurement Excellence and Finance – you will combine technical expertise, leadership and business acumen to turn complex data into executive-level decisions and shape how Procurement uses data and AI at scale.

Your tasks

  • Design, build and deploy statistical and machine-learning models, including spend forecasting, supplier risk scoring, price and savings analytics and anomaly detection and translate complex procurement questions into analytical solutions and own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, from hypothesis and development to production and value tracking.

  • Define the KPI framework and Procurement Dashboard roadmap, delivering decision-ready insights and recommendations to senior leadership; support sourcing, supplier management and category strategies through fact-based analysis.

  • Set and enforce data standards, classifications and quality controls across procurement platforms; define data ownership and governance processes and lead the root-cause resolution of systemic data issues together with IT and data owners.

  • Lead business requirements definition for Procurement Dashboard streams and analytics initiatives, prioritizing the backlog according to business value; ensure that analytics and reporting solutions are well documented, scalable and adopted by the business.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of data analysts and/or data scientists, while defining best practices and code and model review standards; manage team workload, priorities and delivery quality and contribute to the development of the data and analytics capability strategy.

  • Partner with senior stakeholders across Category Management, Procurement Excellence, Finance and IT; challenge assumptions and influence decisions through clear data storytelling, while driving continuous improvement and digital and AI initiatives across Group Procurement.

Your profile

  • Expert analytical and problem-solving skills, with the judgment to prioritize business impact.

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python or R, including statistical modeling and machine learning.

  • Expert-level knowledge of Power BI and advanced Excel, with experience designing enterprise-grade dashboards and data models.

  • Deep understanding of procurement data, spend analytics, and procurement or supply chain processes.

  • Proven experience leading analysts or data scientists and delivering analytics programs end to end.

  • Strong executive communication, data storytelling, and senior stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience with data governance, data quality frameworks, and master data management.

  • Knowledge of iValua, SAP S/4HANA, and Oracle R12.

  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms and AI or GenAI use cases would be an advantage.

  • 8+ years of experience in analytics or data science, including at least 3 years in a lead or management role.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field, such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or Economics, or equivalent professional experience.

What You'll love about working here

  • Practical benefits: yearly financial bonus, private medical care with Medicover with additional packages (e.g., dental, senior care, oncology) available on preferential terms, life insurance and access to NAIS benefit platform.

  • Access to over 70 training tracks with certification opportunities (e.g., GenAI, Excel, Business Analysis, Project Management) on our NEXT platform. Dive into a world of knowledge with free access to Education First languages platform, TED Talks and Udemy Business materials and trainings.

  • Cutting-Edge Technology: Position yourself at the forefront of IT innovation, working with the latest technologies and platforms. Capgemini partners with top global enterprises, including 145 Fortune 500 companies.

  • Enjoy hybrid working model that fits your life - after completing onboarding, connect work from a modern office with ergonomic work from home, thanks to home office package (including laptop, monitor, and chair). Ask your recruiter about the details.

Get to know us

Capgemini is committed to diversity and inclusion, ensuring fairness in all employment practices. We evaluate individuals based on qualifications and performance, not personal characteristics, striving to create a workplace where everyone can succeed and feel valued.

Do you want to get to know us better? Check our Instagram — @capgeminipl or visit our Facebook profile — Capgemini Polska. You can also find us on YouTube.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.

Make it real |

title: IT Support Team Leader
description:
Invia x x is one of the largest travel groups in Europe. Every year we help more than 6 million people plan their trips. Behind that sit teams in IT, Product, Data, Marketing, HR, Finance, Sales and Customer Experience, who build the tools and services those travelers use. Whichever team you join, your work shows up in how people plan and experience their holidays.

Your next stop:

We are looking for an experienced IT Support Team Leader to take ownership of our Service Desk operations and ensure exceptional technical support across the organization. You will work at the intersection of IT operations and business, leading a team of support specialists and partnering with internal stakeholders and external vendors to maintain service continuity, optimize support processes, and drive measurable improvements in service quality.

What lies ahead on your journey:

  • Managing the team, including planning, delegating, and monitoring tasks,

  • Ensuring high-quality user support and escalating tickets to higher support tiers when necessary,

  • Coordinating the team's actions during critical incidents,

  • Collaborating with other IT and business departments to ensure service continuity,

  • Monitoring and reporting on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and service quality,

  • Training, mentoring, and developing the skills of team members,

  • Managing relationships with external vendors and ensuring favorable cooperation terms,

  • Participating in documenting and optimizing company-wide processes,

  • Managing documentation processes and continuously improving Service Desk procedures,

  • Ensuring team activities comply with the organization's security policies,

  • Participating in operational meetings, preparing reports, and providing recommendations for improvements.

What to pack in your suitcase:

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in a Service Desk or similar environment, including at least 1 year in a Team Leader role,

  • Practical IT knowledge, including troubleshooting skills related to operating systems, networks, and hardware,

  • Hands-on experience with operating systems such as Microsoft Windows, Linux, and macOS,

  • Ability to work with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including tracking performance and preparing reports,

  • Experience with ticketing and documentation systems (e.g., Jira, Confluence),

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders, including the Business side,

  • Proactive attitude towards challenges and excellent organizational skills,

  • High level of self-reliance, along with strong teamwork skills,

  • Ability to work under pressure and effectively manage the team during critical situations,

  • Good command of English,

  • Valid category B driving license.

Your extra baggage of experience:

  • Knowledge of ITIL processes and Service Desk tools,

  • Experience in internal systems administration,

  • Familiarity with IT security policies and regulatory compliance,

  • Practical experience in working with external vendors and optimizing business processes.

What you will find on board:

  • A hybrid working model, with a commitment to work from the office at least 3 days per week,

  • Opportunities for professional development aligned with current business needs and your individual career goals,

  • A benefits cafeteria platform – we do not decide what siuts for you, you can choose from life insurance, a sports card, and lunch and shopping vouchers,

  • Cooperation in international environment,

  • Access to Audioteka and Pilot WP, helping you balance personal development with moments of relaxation,

  • An openness to innovation and AI-powered tools that support our daily work and help us achieve even better results,

  • Discounts on our products for you, your family, and friends,

  • Comfortable office in convenient location (Gdańsk – Alchemia; Wrocław - Legnicka Business Garden), along with a friendly and informal atmosphere that encourages collaboration,

  • Option to join International educational trips, so you can see the destinations and hotels from our portfolio for yourself,

  • A culture built on trust, open communication, feedback, and appreciation (because the best journeys begin with a great team),

  • Team where #Explore #Engage #Enjoy build our travel mindset.

title: Executive Communications Specialist
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

About the Role

We are hiring an executive communications specialist to help shape the voice and strategic narrative of Intel's Client Computing and Physical AI Group leadership.


This person will be responsible for driving high-impact internal and external communications and translating complex business and technology strategies into clear narratives for key audiences.


This person will work directly with business unit leaders, their Chief of Staffs, marketing, sales, and additional stakeholders to drive business impact. The person that thrives in this role has executive presence, is a strategic thinker, juggles competing priorities with ease, and possesses strong writing skills.


Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

  • Develop and execute communications strategies that advance business priorities, technology strategy, and organizational goals.
  • Translate complex business, technology and organizational topics into a clear, cohesive narrative for internal and external audiences.
  • Influence communication approaches across teams and align stakeholders on key narratives and priority messaging.
  • Serve as the single point of accountability for executive communications, proactively identifying opportunities, risks and communications needs and orchestrating support across internal and external communications partners.
  • Collaborate across HR, Corporate and Product Communications, Analyst Relations, Marketing, Investor Relations, and other functions to align narratives and priorities to deliver cohesive, clear executive communications recommendations.
  • Serve as a trusted communications advisor to senior business and technical leaders.
  • Develop thought leadership and executive communications across internal and external engagements, including presentations, op-eds, talking points, employee memos, videos, and Q&A materials.
  • Prepare executives for high-impact internal and external moments through strategic briefs, messaging, speeches, presentations, Q&A, scenario planning, and stakeholder preparation, while maintaining an authentic executive voice.
  • Shape employee engagement strategies for senior leaders, including all-hands meetings, quarterly group syncs, open forums, site visits, leadership meetings and other employee listening and engagement moments.
  • Lead communications for business units, organizational change, business transformation, and leadership transitions.
  • Use sentiment, engagement, and effectiveness measures to assess communications impact and adjust accordingly.

A successful candidate should possess the following behavioral traits:

  • Technically fluent, effectively communicating complex business and technology topics for broad audiences
  • A clear, concise writer with strong executive judgment and audience awareness.
  • Business-minded, outcome-oriented and comfortable connecting communications to business priorities.
  • Highly collaborative and influential across functions, leaders, and stakeholder groups.
  • Adaptable and effective in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with shifting priorities.
  • Curious, proactive, and effective operating independently while building trust with senior leaders.
  • Skilled at managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum Qualifications, you must possess the minimum qualifications below to be initially considered for this position

title: Teachers at Wall KinderCare
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Teacher we will:

  • Invest in you and your career at KinderCare as you create a world-class experience in our classrooms
  • Reward your commitment to our children and families as your journey continues with us

When you join our team as a Teacher you will:

  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Physically able to lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $17.00 - $17.00 Hourly

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.

description:
O nas

Społeczność Edge One Solutions powstała z miłości do nowych technologii. Liczymy ponad 350 ekspertów, a w Grupie Euvic, której jesteśmy częścią, jest nas już 5500. Indywidualne podejście pozwala na dopasowanie projektów do umiejętności, przez co realnie wspieramy się w rozwoju kompetencji.

O kliencie

Nasz klient to jeden z trzech największych polskich banków uniwersalnych, jak również jedna z największych instytucji finansowych w obszarze Europy Środkowo-Wschodniej. Jako pierwszy polski bank uruchomił bankomat i wydał kartę kredytową.

Model współpracy

Świadczenie usług odbywa się w trybie hybrydowym – 3 dni w miesiącu z biura klienta w Warszawie

Realizację projektu ułatwi Ci

  • Minimum 7 lat doświadczenia w delivery / Agile / transformacjach w środowisku złożonym

  • Doświadczenie w bankowości / finansach / fintech

  • Silne doświadczenie w obszarach: delivery produktów bankowych, delivery produktów cyfrowych, praca w środowisku regulowanym

  • Udokumentowane przypadki: poprawy przewidywalności delivery, skrócenia time-to-market, redukcji nieefektywności procesu

  • Biegłość w pracy z różnymi podejściami projektowymi i skalowalnymi frameworkami

  • Umiejętność pracy na poziomie zespołów (operacyjnie) i leadershipu (decyzyjnie)

  • Silne kompetencje w: współpracy z interesariuszami, facylitacji trudnych decyzji, upraszczaniu złożoności

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie w projektach opartych na danych i mierzalnych wskaźnikach

  • Znajomość modelu organizacyjnego Hubs & Spokes

Twój wkład do projektu

title: Teachers at Littleton Knowledge Beginnings
description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters.

When you join our team as a Teacher we will:

  • Invest in you and your career at KinderCare as you create a world-class experience in our classrooms
  • Reward your commitment to our children and families as your journey continues with us

When you join our team as a Teacher you will:

  • Implement KinderCare's curriculum in a way that is consistent with the unique needs of each child
  • Create a safe, nurturing environment where children can play and learn
  • Partner and connect with parents, with a shared desire to provide the best care and education for their children
  • Support your center’s success; partner with center staff and leadership to achieve goals around enrollment, accreditation, and engagement
  • Cultivate positive relationships with families, teachers, state licensing authorities, community contacts and corporate partners

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to multi-task and handle multiple situations effectively
  • Meet state specific qualifications for the role or willingness to obtain
  • CPR and First Aid Certification or willingness to obtain
  • Physically able to lift a minimum of 40 pounds, and work indoors or outdoors
  • Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity with children
  • Read, write, understand, and speak English to communicate with children and their parents in English
Range of pay $17.20 - $17.20 Hourly

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits. - Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.
- … and much more.


We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.


.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

title: Technical Architect | f/m/d
description:
About Us

ERGO Technology & Services S.A. (ET&S), a member of the Munich Re and ERGO Group, is delivering integrated IT and business services to international markets. Our expertise lies in providing advanced IT services, with a focus on modern, business-driven technology solutions. On the business side, we also support the Group in various end-to-end insurance processes, including finance, operations, and underwriting. With offices in Warsaw and Gdansk, and strong global partnerships, we foster a dynamic, multicultural environment that promotes diversity and international opportunities.

About the role

As a Technical Architect, you will be responsible for designing and evolving secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-effective technical and data solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards and technology roadmaps. You will lead technical design decisions, define architecture patterns and best practices, and provide architectural governance and guidance throughout the product lifecycle to ensure high-quality, future-ready solutions.

How you will get the job done

  • owning the technical architecture, solution design, and architecture governance for cloud-based business solutions

  • defining and maintaining architecture blueprints, design patterns, integration standards, and reusable solution building blocks

  • evaluating business and technical requirements while ensuring alignment with target architecture, security standards, and technology roadmaps

  • driving continuous improvements in security, performance, scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency across solutions

  • providing architectural leadership and guidance to engineering teams and supporting architecture reviews and governance processes

  • defining integration approaches, API strategies, and data architecture patterns across interconnected systems

  • leading architecture initiatives across Azure Cloud, BDAP, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Python, PySpark, Flask, REST APIs, Angular, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native data and integration platforms

Skills and experience you will need

  • fluency in English

  • university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

  • several years of experience in Software Engineering, Solution Architecture, or Technical Architecture, with strong end-to-end knowledge of the software development lifecycle

  • proven experience designing and governing cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, including data and integration platforms

  • strong expertise in Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Python, PySpark, API-based integrations, CI/CD pipelines, and modern application architectures

  • experience defining architecture standards, conducting architecture reviews, and guiding development teams within complex enterprise environments

  • solid understanding of security architecture, DevSecOps principles, scalability, performance optimization, operational resilience, and cloud governance

  • strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively bridge business, architecture, and engineering teams

Perks & Benefits

Let's be healthy

Medical package, sports card, and numerous sports sections – these are some of the beneﬁts that help our employees stay in good shape.

Let's be balanced

Work-life balance is a key aspect of a healthy workplace. We offer our employees flexible working hours, a confidential employee assistant program, as well as the possibility of remote working. However, staying at home with our in-office gaming room and dog-friendly office in Warsaw won’t be easy.

Let's be smart

We organize numerous workshops and training courses. Thanks to hackathons and meetups, our specialists share their expertise with others. Additionally, we have a wide range of digital learning platforms and language courses.

Let's be responsible

Each year, we participate in several CSR activities, during which, together with our colleagues, we do our best to create a better future.

Let's be fun

Company-wide bike races and soccer matches, ﬁlm marathons in our cinema room or other engaging team-building activities – we got it covered!

Let's be diverse

Every team member is valued, regardless of gender, nationality, religious beliefs, disability, age, and sexual orientation or identity. Your qualiﬁcations, experience, and mindset are our greatest beneﬁt!

title: Controls Engineer / Automation Engineer - PLC / SPS (m/w/d)
description:
We are seeking Junior, Intermediate, and Senior Controls Engineers to join a Manufacturing Engineering team. In this role, you will support the design, development, implementation, and optimization of industrial control systems, automation equipment, and manufacturing machinery. Depending on your experience level, you will contribute to automation projects, troubleshoot production systems, and drive continuous improvement initiatives across our manufacturing operations.

Start: ASAP

Location: Marktheidenfeld (100% on site, No remote)

Duration: 6 Months

Core Competencies:

  • Collaboration: Builds partnerships and works collaboratively to achieve shared objectives.

  • Communication: Communicates effectively across different formats and audiences.

  • Health and Safety Fundamentals: Promotes proactive health and safety practices to support an injury-free workplace.

  • Controls Engineering Knowledge: Applies controls hardware and software knowledge to new equipment and upgrades across manufacturing systems.

  • Controls Networking: Implements technologies and methods that transfer information between production processes, machines, and databases.

  • Controls Safety: Recognises electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic hazards and incorporates safe practices into daily work.

  • Controls System Security: Supports secure controls and manufacturing systems through appropriate equipment and upgrade designs.

  • Electrical System Troubleshooting: Analyses and resolves electrical control-system issues to restore proper operation.

  • Factory Automation and Control Systems: Implements automation improvements using suitable technologies, programming methods, materials, and resources.

  • Sensor Technology and Measurement: Selects and applies sensor technologies and analyses measurement data to distinguish conforming from non-conforming products.

  • Machine Programming: Creates factory-floor machine programs and solutions that improve machine utilisation and overall operation.

  • Manufacturing Knowledge: Applies manufacturing knowledge to improve processes, equipment, and applications.

  • Values Differences: Recognises the value of different perspectives and cultures.

Qualifications:

  • Education: College or university degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics), a related field, or equivalent experience

  • Experience: Basic / Intermediate / Senior level of relevant work experience required

  • Controls Engineering & PLC Programming Skills: Development, programming, and troubleshooting of control and automation systems

  • Troubleshooting, Production Support & Industrial Manufacturing Experience: Providing technical support, resolving production issues, and working within industrial/manufacturing environments.

  • German (min. B2 Level) & English (min. B2 Level)

Junior - Key Responsibilities:

  • Assists with control-system development and design and the implementation of bench tests.

  • Modifies software and equipment to ensure sensors and actuators function according to specification.

  • Supports and troubleshoots basic problems and change requests.

  • Assists with cost estimates, compiles cost and equipment information, and drafts appropriation requests.

  • Investigates project requirements and develops proposed solutions for review by more experienced Controls Engineers or the Controls Engineering Manager.

  • May install and provide technical support for Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) hardware and software.

Senior - Key Responsibilities:

  • Develops and designs control systems and implements bench tests.

  • Modifies software and equipment to ensure sensors and actuators function according to specification.

  • Supports and troubleshoots complex problems and change requests.

  • Prepares cost estimates, compiles cost and equipment information, and writes and reviews appropriation requests.

  • Investigates project requirements and develops solutions considering economic, personnel, and environmental factors.

  • May install and provide technical support for Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) hardware and software.

  • Coaches and mentors less experienced Controls Engineers.

title: Senior Data/Information Manager
description:
Location: Predominantly on-site (3–5 days/week)
Start Date: As soon as possible (maximum 30 days' notice period)
Duration: Maximum 6 months
Allocation: 100% (full-time)
Language: Fluent English required; Swedish is advantageous

Description

We are looking for three highly experienced Senior Data/Information Managers to support the client’s transformation from traditional Data Management towards AI-ready Data Management.

The assignment focuses on strengthening Data Management capabilities across the organization, ensuring that data is properly governed, trusted, understood, and ready to support AI, advanced analytics, and future digital capabilities.

In this role, you will work closely with business areas and cross-functional stakeholders to develop practical frameworks, principles, standards, and ways of working. A key part of the assignment is to bridge the gap between strategic Data Management objectives and practical implementation, helping business areas adopt new approaches and build sustainable capabilities.

You will also play an important role in developing enterprise data and information models, establishing semantic and context layers, and ensuring that business concepts, metadata, and data structures are aligned to support consistent interpretation and reuse of information.

We are looking for a senior, hands-on, pragmatic, and delivery-oriented professional who can challenge traditional approaches, simplify complex topics, and drive meaningful improvements across business and IT.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support the transition from traditional Data Management towards AI-ready Data Management.

  • Define and implement practical Data Management frameworks, principles, standards, and ways of working.

  • Support and coach business areas throughout their Data Management transformation and adoption journey.

  • Provide expertise in Data Governance, Data Quality, Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, Information Architecture, and data ownership.

  • Define, govern, and continuously improve enterprise data models, information models, and conceptual models.

  • Establish semantic and context layers that provide consistent business meaning to data and enable reuse across business processes, analytics, and AI solutions.

  • Connect business concepts, terminology, metadata, ontologies, and technical data structures to improve data discoverability, interoperability, and AI readiness.

  • Identify gaps between existing Data Management practices and future requirements for AI and advanced analytics.

  • Translate strategic objectives and frameworks into practical implementation across business and IT.

  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and alignment between business, IT, architecture, data, and AI teams.

  • Drive knowledge sharing, coaching, and capability development to establish sustainable Data Management practices within the organization.

Education

Must Have

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Management, Data Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

Meriting

  • Advanced degree or relevant professional certifications in Data Management, Data Governance, Enterprise/Information Architecture, or AI/Data.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

Data Management & Transformation

  • Minimum 7 years of professional experience in Data Management, Information Management, Data Governance, or related fields.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience leading or supporting enterprise-level Data and Information Management transformation in complex organizations.

  • Proven experience establishing and implementing Data Management frameworks, principles, standards, and operating models.

  • Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, and Information Architecture.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate Data Management strategies and frameworks into practical implementation and adoption.

Data Modelling, Semantics & Information Architecture

  • Strong experience developing and governing enterprise data models, information models, conceptual models, business glossaries, taxonomies, or ontologies.

  • Demonstrated expertise in semantic modelling and context layers, including connecting business meaning, terminology, metadata, relationships, and technical data structures.

  • Ability to establish consistent business definitions and improve data discoverability, interoperability, and reuse across different business and technical environments.

AI-Ready Data Management

  • Strong understanding of AI-ready data requirements and how traditional Data Management practices must evolve to support AI and advanced analytics.

  • Ability to identify gaps between current Data Management capabilities and future AI requirements.

  • Experience aligning Data Governance, data quality, metadata, information architecture, and business context with the needs of AI-driven solutions.

Stakeholder Management & Implementation

  • Experience collaborating across business, IT, architecture, data, and AI teams in complex enterprise environments.

  • Proven ability to move from strategic concepts and frameworks to hands-on implementation and organizational adoption.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, coaching, and communication skills.

  • Ability to explain complex Data and Information Management concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience supporting business areas in adopting new frameworks, standards, roles, and responsibilities.

Language Requirements

  • English: Fluent professional proficiency, both written and spoken (required).

  • Swedish: Advantageous, particularly for collaboration with local business and organizational stakeholders.

Who You Are

You are a senior, analytical, and pragmatic professional with a strong understanding of Data and Information Management and its evolving role in enabling AI and advanced analytics.

You have a transformation mindset and are comfortable challenging traditional approaches, identifying opportunities for improvement, and introducing new ways of working. You understand that successful Data Management transformation requires both technical expertise and organizational adoption.

You are an excellent communicator and facilitator who can simplify complex topics and build alignment across business, IT, architecture, data, and AI teams. You enjoy coaching others and helping stakeholders understand how improved Data Management practices create business value.

You take a collaborative and cross-functional approach, building strong relationships and influencing stakeholders across organizational boundaries.

You are hands-on, proactive, and delivery-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. You can translate strategic objectives into practical solutions while navigating competing priorities and complexity in a large enterprise environment.

description:
Location:

8305 Main St, Osoyoos, British Columbia, V0H 1V0

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.
With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

Why this role is important?

SUMMARY:
To manage resources of the Beauty department in order to maximize and achieve sales targets.

The ideal Beauty Manager will:
Drive a Passion for Results – Provide Thought Leadership – Analyze and solve problems - Engage our People – Build collaborative relationships - Demonstrate Personal Leadership and Build trust

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
SALES EXPECTATIONS:

  • Utilizes corporate Sales Tracking Tools and Dashboard to set sales goals and to meet targets
  • Sells to customers and coaches / mentors staff in selling skills
  • Ensures sales maximized through developing effective sales techniques
  • Ensures staff achieve productivity objectives


CUSTOMER SERVICE:

  • Always put the Customer first and provides superior customer service
  • Monitors and communicates CSI survey results and objectives with team members
  • Actively models the desired behavior with eClienteling to provide superior customer service
  • Books appointments for events and manages annual incremental event schedule
  • Promotes products through marketing and encourages use of the PC Optimum program
  • Ensures staff are trained to beauty sales standards


TEAM LEADERSHIP:

  • Mentors, coaches, trains, and motivates staff
  • Creates an environment where “selling is fun”
  • Prepares performance appraisals in association with Front Store Manager
  • Articulates and demonstrates “Blue Culture Principles” and C.O.R.E Values”
  • Fosters an environment that supports “Blue Culture Principles” and “C.O.R.E Values”


OPERATIONS:

  • Utilizes corporate sales tools to continuously track Sales
  • Ensures Cosmetic Operating Standards are in place
  • Identifies “peak hours” and schedules shifts accordingly


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Planning, Judgment and Decision Making
  • Independent thinking and decision making when dealing with issues related to customer’s needs
  • This position requires the ability to act upon tasks and goals outlined by management
  • Develops a yearly plan for personal development
  • Work in conjunction with the Associate-Owner and Front Store Manager


EXPERIENCE:

  • Sales experience with a proven track record of achieving sales goals
  • Cosmetic experience
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Customer service oriented
  • Previous experience in leading a team

title: Control Manager – Governance & Frameworks (f/m/x)
description:
Join a global organization operating in a highly regulated environment, where effective risk and control management is key.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, maintaining, and improving Technology Risk & Control processes, ensuring they are consistent, measurable, and aligned with organizational standards.

Your tasks

  • Design and maintain risk and control management processes

  • Monitor effectiveness using KPIs, KRIs, and KCIs

  • Ensure consistent execution of governance and control activities

  • Support internal and external reporting

  • Identify gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across different functions

  • Escalate issues and support decision-making when needed

Requirements

  • Min. 5 years of experience in technology risk/ control/ governance

  • Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks

  • Experience with metrics and performance monitoring (KPI/KRI/KCI)

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business language

  • Proactive mindset, attention to detail, and focus on improvement

  • Good communication skills in English

  • Visit the Krakow office twice a month

title: New Logo Hunter (Business Development Manager)
description:
Location: Pune, India
Department: Sales / Business Development
Employment Type: Full Time

About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and results-driven New Logo Hunter to identify, engage, and acquire new customers. The ideal candidate will have a strong track record in B2B sales, excellent prospecting skills, and the ability to build relationships with decision-makers across target organizations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities within assigned territories and industries.
  • Generate and manage a healthy pipeline of prospective clients through cold calling, email outreach, social selling, networking, and referrals.
  • Drive the complete sales cycle from prospecting to contract closure.
  • Conduct client meetings, presentations, and solution demonstrations.
  • Understand customer business challenges and position relevant solutions effectively.
  • Collaborate with recruitment, delivery, and leadership teams to create compelling customer proposals.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity tracking and forecasting in CRM systems.
  • Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual new business revenue targets.
  • Develop strategic account plans for high-potential prospects.
  • Keep abreast of market trends, competitor activities, and emerging business opportunities.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3-8 years of experience in B2B sales, staffing, IT services, recruitment solutions, or consulting services.
  • Proven success in acquiring new logos and meeting revenue targets.
  • Experience engaging with CXOs, HR Leaders, Procurement, and Business Heads.
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Dynamics.

Preferred Skills

  • Strong hunter mindset with a passion for new client acquisition.
  • Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Consultative selling and solution-oriented approach.
  • Strong business acumen and commercial negotiation skills.

title: Tester QA (Mid/Senior) | Branża Bankowa
company: Edge One Solutions Sp. z o.o
description:
O nas

Społeczność Edge One Solutions powstała z miłości do nowych technologii. Liczymy ponad 350 ekspertów, a w Grupie Euvic, której jesteśmy częścią, jest nas już 5500. Indywidualne podejście pozwala na dopasowanie projektów do umiejętności, przez co realnie wspieramy się w rozwoju kompetencji.

O kliencie

Nasz klient to jeden z trzech największych polskich banków uniwersalnych, jak również jedna z największych instytucji finansowych w obszarze Europy Środkowo-Wschodniej. Jako pierwszy polski bank uruchomił bankomat i wydał kartę kredytową.

O projekcie

Projekt realizowany jest w ramach strategicznego programu rozwoju nowoczesnej bankowości elektronicznej dla klientów korporacyjnych. Jego celem jest stworzenie bezpiecznej, intuicyjnej i skalowalnej platformy, która usprawni codzienne zarządzanie finansami przedsiębiorstw oraz zapewni wygodny dostęp do usług bankowych. Rozwijane rozwiązania obejmują . obsługę rachunków, realizację płatności, zarządzanie uprawnieniami użytkowników, wielopoziomową autoryzację transakcji, raportowanie finansowe oraz integrację z systemami finansowo-księgowymi klientów. Kluczowymi aspektami programu są bezpieczeństwo, zgodność z regulacjami, wysoka jakość oprogramowania oraz niezawodność systemów. Rekrutacja prowadzona jest do długoterminowego programu obejmującego kilka powiązanych projektów, których wspólnym celem jest rozwój cyfrowych usług bankowych dla klientów biznesowych.

Model współpracy

Świadczenie usług odbywa się w modelu hybrydowym - średnio 1 dzień w tygodniu z biura klienta w Warszawie

Oczekiwane kompetencje

  • Komercyjne doświadczenie w testowaniu oprogramowania oraz zapewnianiu jakości systemów informatycznych

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość metod, technik i procesów testowania oprogramowania

  • Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi Jira i Confluence

  • Znajomość narzędzi wspierających testowanie, takich jak HP QC, UTP, Katalon lub ALM

  • Znajomość aplikacji i systemów wykorzystywanych w sektorze bankowym lub maklerskim

  • Certyfikat ISTQB/ISEB

  • Umiejętność analizy wymagań biznesowych i technicznych oraz projektowania przypadków testowych

  • Samodzielność, dokładność, analityczne podejście do rozwiązywania problemów i dobra organizacja pracy

  • Komunikatywność i umiejętność efektywnej współpracy w zespole

  • Zakres realizowanych usług

  • Przeprowadzanie testów funkcjonalnych systemów IT zgodnie z wymaganiami biznesowymi i technicznymi

  • Przygotowywanie planów testów, scenariuszy oraz przypadków testowych

  • Weryfikacja zgodności oprogramowania z dokumentacją i wymaganiami projektowymi

  • Identyfikowanie, zgłaszanie i monitorowanie defektów oraz współpraca z zespołami developerskimi przy ich usuwaniu

  • Analiza wyników testów, raportowanie postępów i dokumentowanie rezultatów

  • Współpraca z analitykami biznesowymi, zespołami projektowymi i innymi zespołami QA

  • Tworzenie i aktualizowanie dokumentacji testowej oraz technicznej

Co oferujemy w ramach współpracy

  • Co zyskujesz, współpracując z Edge1S w modelu B2B?

  • W Edge1S stawiamy na przejrzyste zasady współpracy oraz dostęp do różnorodnych możliwości projektowych, dopasowanych do Twojego doświadczenia, specjalizacji i preferencji.

  • Opiekun kontraktu: Dedykowany Opiekun Kontraktu jest Twoim głównym punktem kontaktu w Edge1S w sprawach związanych z realizacją projektu, organizacją współpracy oraz możliwościami udziału w kolejnych projektach.

  • Szkolenia, certyfikaty i konferencje: Możesz uczestniczyć w wybranych szkoleniach, certyfikacjach i konferencjach związanych z realizowanymi projektami albo zakresem współpracy. Zasady udziału i finansowania ustalamy indywidualnie.

  • #SmartChange: Gdy zbliża się koniec planowanego okresu projektu Klienta albo interesuje Cię inna rola projektowa, możesz zgłosić gotowość do udziału w kolejnym procesie kwalifikacji. Przedstawiamy dostępne propozycje współpracy B2B odpowiadające Twojemu doświadczeniu, specjalizacji i preferencjom. Zakres Usług oraz warunki każdego nowego SOW uzgadniamy odrębnie.

  • Społeczność Edge1S: Możesz brać udział w webinarach #edge1talks oraz innych dobrowolnych inicjatywach budujących relacje w społeczności Edge1S.

  • Aktywność fizyczna: Możesz uczestniczyć w inicjatywach sportowych organizowanych przez społeczność Edge1S oraz korzystać z udostępnianych sal treningowych.

Dostępność, ceny oraz zasady przystąpienia określają dokumenty dotyczące poszczególnych usług.
